translations.source: Sexually transmitted infections (STIs) Overview: Sexually transmitted infections (STIs) are spread predominantly by unprotected sexual contact. Some STIs can also be transmitted during pregnancy, childbirth and breastfeeding and through infected blood or blood products. STIs have a profound impact on health. If untreated, they can lead to serious consequences including neurological and cardiovascular disease, infertility, ectopic pregnancy, stillbirths, and increased risk of Human Immunodeficiency Virus (HIV). They are also associated with stigma, domestic violence, and affects quality of life. The majority of STIs have no symptoms. When they are present common symptoms of STIs are vaginal or urethral discharge, genital ulcer and lower abdominal pain. The most common and curable STIs are trichomonas, chlamydia, gonorrhoea and syphilis. Rapidly increasing antimicrobial resistance is a growing threat for untreatable gonorrhoea.
translations.reference: Cututtukan da ake kamuwa da su ta hanyar jima'i (STIs) Cututtukan da ake kamuwa da su ta hanyar jima'i suna ƙara yaɗuwa ta hanyar jin jima'i ba tare da kariya ba. Wasu cututtukan ma su kan samuwa ne a lokacin ɗaukan ciki, haihuwa, da kuma sayarwa kuma ta hanyar jinin da ke ɗauke da cutar ko kuma abinda jinin ya haifar. Cututtukan su ma da matuƙar tasiri ga lafiya. Idan ba'a magance ba, ya kan iya kaiwa ga matsaloli masu girma wanda ya yaɗa da cututtukan da su ka shafi ƙwaƙwalwa da na zuciya, rashin haihuwa, cikin da ke zama a bayan mahaifa, ɓari, da kuma ƙaruwar barazana ga kamuwa da ƙwayoyin da ke hadda cutar ƙanjamau (HIV). Su na haɗe da ƙyama, cin zarafin cikin gida, kuma yana haifar da lalacewar ingantaccen lafiya. Mafi yawan waɗannan cututtuka ba su da alamun da za'a iya ganewa. Idan an kamu da su, gama-garin alamun STIs su ne zubar zuwa daga mafitsara ko mahaifa, gyanbon al'aura, da kuma ciwon ƙasan mara. Cututtukan da aka fi magancewa na STIs su ne trichomonas (zubar ruwa a mafitsaran mace), Chlamydia, gonoriya da sifilis. Samun ƙaruwar magungunan da ke tasiri akan ƙwayoyin cututtuka na yin barazana ga cututtukan da ba za'a gonoriya wanda ba za'a iya magance ta ba.
translations.hypothesis: Cututtukan da ake ɗauka ta hanyar jima'i (STIs) Gamsashshen bayani: Cututtukan da ake ɗauka ta hanyar jima'i (STIs) suna yaduwa ta hanyar jima'i marar tsaro. Wasu cututtukan da ake ɗauka ta hanyar jima'i (STIs) suma za su iya yaɗuwa lokacin ɗaukar ciki, haihuwa da shayarwa da kuma ta hanyar jinin da ya kamu da cutar ko kayan da aka sarrafa jini. Cututtukan da ake ɗauka ta hanyar jima'i (STIs) suna da babban tasiri ga lafiya. Idan ba a yi maganin ba, suna iya haifar da sakamako masu muni da suka haɗa da cututtukan ƙwaƙwalwa da zuciya, rashin haihuwa, ɗaukar ciki a wuri ba daidai ba, haifar jarirai da ba su kai lokacin haihuwa ba, da kuma ƙara haɗarin kamuwa da cuta mai karya garkuwar jiki (HIV). Hakanan suna da alaƙa da nuna tsana, cin zarafin cikin gida, da kuma illata ingancin rayuwa. Mafi yawancin cututtukan da ake ɗauka ta hanyar jima'i (STIs) ba su da alamun cuta. Idan suna nan, gama garin alamun cututtukan da ake ɗauka ta hanyar jima'i (STIs) su ne fitar da ruwan mahaifa ko daurin maza, ciwon mahaifa da ƙarancin ciwon ciki. Mafi yawan cututtukan da ake ɗauka ta hanyar jima'i (STIs) da za a iya warkewa su ne trichomonas, chlamydia, gonorrhoea da syphilis. Saurin ƙaruwar juriya ga magunguna barazana ce mai girma ga gonorrhoea da ba za a iya magancewa ba.

translations.source: Viral STIs including HIV, genital herpes simplex virus (HSV), viral hepatitis B, human papillomavirus (HPV) and human T-lymphotropic virus type 1 (HTLV-1) lack or have limited treatment options. Vaccines are available for hepatitis B to prevent infection that can lead to liver cancer and for HPV to prevent cervical cancer. HIV, HSV and HTLV-1 are lifelong infections: for HIV and HSV there are treatments that can suppress the virus, but currently there are no cures for any of these viral STIs. Condoms used correctly and consistently are effective methods to protect against STIs and HIV. Screening with early diagnosis of people with STIs and their sexual partners offers the best opportunity for effective treatment and for preventing complications and further transmission. Symptoms: A person can have an STI without having obvious symptoms of disease. When present, common symptoms of STIs include: abnormal vaginal discharge, urethral discharge, genital ulcers and lumps, and lower abdominal pain. Symptoms of specific STIs are: Gonorrhoea and chlamydial infection These STIs cause cervicitis in women, urethritis in men and extra-genital infections, including rectal and oropharyngeal manifestations.
translations.reference: Ƙwayoyin cutar virus da ake kamuwa da su ta hanyar jima'i sun haɗa da ƙwayar cutar mai karya garkuwar jiki wato HIV, ƙwayar cutar da ke zama a matantaka mace wato HSV, Hepatitis B, HPV, da kuma Human T-lymphotropic virus type 1(HTLV-1). rashin ko samun ƙarancin magani. Ana samun riga-kafin Hepatitis B a ko ina don bada kariya ga cutar sankarar hanta, da kuma HPV don bada kariya ga sankarar mahaifa. HIV, HSV da HTLV-1 cututtuka ne da kan iya zama na tsawon rayuwa, HIV da HSV na da magungunan da za su iya disashe ƙarfin ƙwayoyin cutar, amma a yanzu haka dai babu maganin da zai iya kawar da waɗannan cututtuka. Amfani da kororon roba akan kari kuma bisa ƙa'ida kan iya bada cikekken kariya daga kamuwa da cututtukan jima'i. Yin gwaji da wuri da kuma binciken mutanen da su ke ɗauke da wannan cututtuka tare da abokan hulɗar su kan iya samar da kyakkyawan dama don samun ingantaccen magani da kuma kariya daga rikitarwa da kuma ci gaba da yaɗawa. Alamomi: Mutum zai iya kamuwa da cututtukan ba tare da ƙwaƙƙwaran wasu alamun cutar ba. Idan ya kasance akwai, gama-garin alamu cutukan sun haɗa da: zubar ruwa na ba gaira ba dalili daga matantaka, zubar ruwa daga mahaifa, gyanbon al'aura da ƙuraje da kuma ciwon ƙasan mara. Alamun cututtukan na musamman su ne: Cutar Gonoriya da Chlamydia Waɗannan cututtuka su na kama mahaifa a mata, mafitsara ga maza da kuma wasu cututtukan da su ke kama al'aura, wanda ya haɗa da cutar da ke zazzago da dubura waje.
translations.hypothesis: Cututtukan da ake ɗauka ta hanyar jima'i masu yaduwa da suka haɗa da HIV da genital herpes simplex virus (HSV) da viral hepatitis B da human papillomavirus (HPV) da kuma human T-lymphotropic virus type 1 (HTLV-1) ba su da ko kuma suke da iyaka wajen zaɓin yin magani. Akwai allurar rigakafi don ciwon hanta B don hana kamuwa da cuta wanda zai iya haifar da ciwon hanta da kuma don HPV don hana ciwon mahaifa. HIV da HSV da HTLV-1 cututtuka ne na rayuwar mutum: ga HIV da HSV da akwai magunguna da zasu iya rage ƙarfin ƙwayar cutar, amma a halin yanzu babu wani magani ga kowane ɗaya daga cikin waɗannan cututtukan da ake ɗauka ta hanyar jima'i. Amfani da kwaroron roba yadda ya dace da ci gaba da amfani da shi hanyoyi ne masu inganci don kariya daga cututtukan da ake ɗauka ta hanyar jima'i da HIV. Gwaje-gwaje da gano mutanen da ke da cututtukan da ake ɗauka ta hanyar jima'i da abokan taraddadansu na jima'i suna ba da damar yin magani mai inganci da kuma don hana matsaloli da kuma ci gaba da yaɗuwa. Alamomi: Mutum zai iya kamu da STI ba tare da sanannun alamun cuta ba. Idan ya kasance, gama garin alamun cututtukan da ake ɗauka ta hanyar jima'i sun haɗa da: fitar da ruwan mahaifa da ba a zahiri ba da fitar da ruwan ƙarfar da ba a zahiri ba da ciwon gaɓoɓin jima'i da kumburi da kuma ciwon ciki. Alamun cututtukan da ake ɗauka ta hanyar jima'i na musamman sune: Gonorrhea da cutar chlamydia Waɗannan cututtukan da ake ɗauka ta hanyar jima'i suna haifar da ciwon mahaifa ga mata da ciwon ƙofar ƙarfi ga maza da kuma wasu ciwukan da ba a jikin mahaifa ba, da suka haɗa da ciwon ƙofar ciki da na baki.

translations.source: Common symptoms include vaginal or penile discharge and burning with urination. Infants of infected mothers can contract neonatal conjunctivitis (red eyes) due to exposure to the STIs during vaginal delivery. Rectal and pharyngeal infections can be asymptomatic. Syphilis: Syphilis is often asymptomatic, when symptoms occur, primary syphilis presents as a solitary, painless ulcer. Secondary syphilis may manifest as generalized lesions affecting skin, mucous membranes and lymph-node including a classic rash on the palms of the hands and soles of the feet. Latent syphilis is asymptomatic and characterized by positive syphilis serology. Trichomoniasis: The predominant symptoms include abnormal vaginal discharge with redness of the vulva, itching and painful intercourse. Genital herpes simplex virus (HSV) HSV most commonly presents as painful sores, vesicles or ulcerations on the external genitalia and mouth. Symptomatic genital HSV is a lifelong condition that can be characterized by frequent symptomatic recurrences.
translations.reference: Alamomin da aka saba gani sun haɗa da zubar ruwa daga al'auran mata da na maza, jin zafi yayin yin fitsari. Jariran iyayen da su ke ɗauke da cutar za su iya kamuwa da cutar ciwon ido dalilin gamuwa da cutar yayin haihuwan da ba na tiyata ba. cutar da ke zazzago da dubura kan iya rasa alamun kamuwa da cututtuka. Sifilis: Sifilis ma yawanci baya bayyana alamu , a lokacin da alamu ya bayyana a farkon matakin sifilis zai nuna wani gyanbo ne maras zafi da ciwo. sifilis a mataki na biyu na iya bayyana a matsayin ciwo kawai wanda ke samun fata, jiki da kuma ƙulkutu ko ƙari wanda ya yaɗa da ƙuraje a tafin hannu da kuma tafin ƙafa. Sifilis a matakin ƙarshe kuma ba ya nuna ko bayyana wasu alamu amma ya na nuni da cewa sifilis ne ta hanyan gwajin jini. Cutar Trichomoniasis: babban alamomin wannan cuta sun haɗa da zuban ruwan da babu dalili tare da jan kan fatar al'aura, ƙaiƙayi da kuma jin zafi yayin saduwa. Ƙurajen cikin matantaka (Genital Herpes Simplex Virus, HSV) Mafi yawanci wannan cuta na bayyana ne a ƙuraje masu matuƙar zafi da ciwo, masu ruwa, ko kuma mai kamar gyanbo a kan fatar al'aura da kuma cikin baki. Alamomin wannan cuta na tsawon rayuwa ne, wanda ke faruwa akai akai(idan wasu sun mutu wasu su ƙara fitowa).
translations.hypothesis: Alamomin cutar sun haɗa da fitar da ruwan mahaifa ko ƙanƙara da zafi yayin yin bayan gida. Jarirai 'yan mata da suka kamu da cutar za su iya kamuwa da cutar ido bayan haihuwa (red eyes) saboda bayyanar cutar da ake ɗauka ta hanyar jima'i yayin haihuwa. Cututtukan da ake ɗauka ta ƙofar bayan gida da makogwaro ba lallai su bayyana alamun ba. Sakamako: Sakamako cuta ce da yawanci ba ta nuna alamun ta, idan aka samu alamun cutar, cutar ta nuna alamun da ke nuna ciwon da ba zafi ba. Sakamako na biyu na cutar za su iya bayyana a matsayin ciwuka na bai ɗaya da ke shafar fata, da kuma sassan jiki da ke fitar da ruwa da kuma kumburin ɓangarorin jiki da suka haɗa da ciwon da ke fitowa a ƙarƙashin hannu da ƙafa. Sakamako na farko ba shi da alamun cutar, kuma ana iya gano shi ta hanyar gwajin jini. Cutar Trichomoniasis: Alamomin cutar sun haɗa da fitar da ruwan mahaifa da yawa da kuma ƙuraje da ƙurajen mahaifa da zafi yayin yin jima'i. Cutar da ake ɗauka ta hanyar jima'i (HSV) Cutar da ake ɗauka ta hanyar jima'i (HSV) yawanci tana bayyana a matsayin ciwon ƙuraje da kumburi ko ciwon da ke fitowa a wajen mahaifa da baki. Alamomin cutar da ake ɗauka ta hanyar jima'i (HSV) cuta ce da mutum ke da ita har abada wanda za a iya gane ta ta hanyar sake kamuwa da cutar.

translations.source: Human T-lymphotropic virus type 1 (HTLV-1) Generally asymptomatic, the chronic form of HTLV-1 can cause severe disease, including adult T-cell leukaemia/lymphoma (ATL) and a progressive nervous system condition known as HTLV-1-associated myelopathy or tropical spastic paraparesis (HAM/TSP). Treatment: Effective treatment is currently available for several STIs. Three bacterial STIs (chlamydia, gonorrhoea and syphilis) and one parasitic STI (trichomoniasis) are usually curable with existing, effective single-dose or multiple-dose regimens of antibiotics. For viral STIs (HIV, HSV and HTLV-1), the most effective medications available are antivirals or anti-cancer drugs (in the case of HTLV-1), that can modulate the course of the diseases, though they cannot cure these three diseases. Antimicrobial resistance (AMR) to antibiotics used to treat STIs, in particular gonorrhoea, has increased rapidly in recent years and has reduced successful treatment outcomes. Results from the current Gonococcal AMR Surveillance Programme (GASP) show trends of high rates of quinolone resistance, increasing azithromycin resistance and emerging resistance of extended-spectrum cephalosporins. The emergence of decreased susceptibility of gonorrhoea to extended-spectrum cephalosporins, together with established high-levels of resistance to penicillins, sulphonamides, tetracyclines, quinolones and macrolides make gonorrhoea a multidrug-resistant organism. AMR for other STIs, though less common, also exists, making prevention and prompt treatment critical. To adequately treat STIs it is important to take the appropriate antimicrobials, with the correct dose and duration for the specific STI to ensure adequate treatment or cure, and to prevent the development of antimicrobial resistance.
translations.reference: Cutar sankarar jini (HTLV-1) Gabaɗaya ba shi da wasu alamu, matsanancin matakin cutar kan iya jawo matsanancin ciwon wanda ya haɗa da sankarar jini ga manya (ATL) da cigaban matsalar ƙwaƙwalwa. Magani: yanzu haka akwai ingantattun magunguna da su ke nan don magance waɗannan cututtuka dayawa. Ƙwayoyin bacteria guda uku na STIs( Chlamydia, gonoriya da kuma sifilis) da kuma ƙwayar cutar Trichomoniasis, yawanci akan samu waraka ta hanyar amfani da ingantattun ƙwayoyin magunguna na antibiotics wanda ake bayarwa sau ɗaya ko fiye da ɗaya. Game da ƙwayoyin cutar Virus( HIV, HSV, da HTLV-1) maganungunan da su ka fi tasiri a wadace su ne antiviral ko kuma magungunan da su ke daƙusar da cutar daji wato anti-cancer ( idan aka duba abinda ya shafi HTLV-1) da zai iya canza tsarin cututtukan, duk da basa warkar da waɗannan cututtuka uku. Ana amfani da magungunan da su ke jure antibiotics wajen warkar da STIs, musamman gonoriya, da ya ƙaru a ƴan shekarun nan an samu nasarar raguwarsa sosai ta dalilin magance shi. A sakamakon wani bincike da aka yi na sa ido akan cutar gonoriya wato Gonococcal AMR Surveillance Programme a turance (GASP) ya nuna jerin gwanon juriya ga ƙwayar quinone, ƙarin juran azithromycin, da kuma bayyanar juran ƙarin rukunonin cephalosporins. Bayyanar raguwar sauƙin kamuwa gonoriya ga ƙarin rukunonin cephalosporins tare da gina tsantsan juriya ga penicillin, sulphonamides, ja da yalo, quinolones, da kuma macrolides ya sanya ƙwayoyin gonoriya jure magunguna dayawa. Juriyar magunguna ga sauran STIs, duk da bai cika yawa ba, amma kuma yana faruwa, wanda ya ke sanya kariya da waraka da ya kamata cikin halin ƙaƙanikayi. Don samun cikekken magance STIs, yana da matuƙar amfani a samu ƙwayoyin da su ka dace , tare da samun adadin da ya kamata a ɗauka da lokaci , musamman na STIs don tabbatar da samun cikekken magancewa da warkarwa da kuma bada kariya ga samuwar cigaba da jure ƙwayoyin magani.
translations.hypothesis: Ƙwayar cutar T-lymphotropic iri na 1 (HTLV-1) Yawanci ba su da alamun cuta, amma yanayin cutar mai naci na HTLV-1 na iya haifar da matsanancin cuta, wanda ya haɗa da T-cell leukemia/lymphoma (ATL) da kuma ci gaba da ciwon da ake kira HTLV-1-associated myelopathy ko tropical spastic paraparesis (HAM/TSP). Magani: Akwai ingantaccen magani na yawancin cututtukan da ake yaɗuwa ta hanyar jima'i. Cututtuka uku masu yaɗuwa ta hanyar jima'i (chlamydia, gonorrhoea da syphilis) da kuma cuta ɗaya mai rayuwa a jikin wani (trichomoniasis) yawanci ana iya warkewa da su ta hanyar amfani da magungunan kashe cuta na yau da kullum. Don cututtukan da ake yaɗuwa ta hanyar jima'i na bairos (HIV, HSV da HTLV-1), mafi inganci magunguna da ake samu sune magungunan da ke yaƙar bairos ko magungunan da ke yaƙar kansa (idan ana magana ne na HTLV-1), waɗanda za su iya daidaita yanayin cututtukan, duk da cewa ba za su iya warkar da waɗannan cututtuka ba. Antimicrobial resistance (AMR) ga magungunan kashe cuta da ake amfani da su wajen magance cututtukan da ake yaɗuwa ta hanyar jima'i, musamman gonorrhoea, ya ƙaru cikin sauri a cikin 'yan shekarun nan kuma ya rage sakamakon nasarar yin magani. Sakamakon daga Gonococcal AMR Surveillance Programme (GASP) na yanzu sun nuna yanayin ƙaruwar adadin masu jurewa na quinolone, ƙaruwar jurewa na azithromycin da kuma jurewa na cephalosporins masu faɗaɗa-spectrum. Ɓullar ƙarancin jurewa na gonorrhoea ga cephalosporins masu faɗaɗa-spectrum, tare da kafa babban matakin jurewa ga penicillins, sulphonamides, tetracyclines, quinolones da macrolides suna mai son gonorrhoea a matsayin mai jurewa magunguna da yawa. AMR don sauran STIs, duk da yake bai shahara ba, kuma yana da shi, yana mai da riga-kafi da kulawa da magani abubuwa masu mahimmanci. Don magance cututtukan da ake yaɗuwa ta hanyar jima'i yadda ya dace yana da mahimmanci a sha maganin kashe cuta da ya dace, tare da daidaitaccen adadi da tsawon lokacin cutar da ake magancewa don tabbatar da isasshen magani ko warkewa, da kuma hana ci gaba da jurewa maganin kashe cuta.

translations.source: Smallpox Overview: Smallpox is an acute contagious disease caused by the variola virus, a member of the orthopoxvirus family. It was one of the most devastating diseases known to humanity and caused millions of deaths before it was eradicated. It is believed to have existed for at least 3000 years. The smallpox vaccine, created by Edward Jenner in 1796, was the first successful vaccine to be developed. He observed that milkmaids who previously had caught cowpox did not catch smallpox and showed that a similar inoculation could be used to prevent smallpox in other people. The World Health Organization launched an intensified plan to eradicate smallpox in 1967. Widespread immunization and surveillance were conducted around the world for several years. The last known natural case was in Somalia in 1977. In 1980 WHO declared smallpox eradicated – the only infectious disease to achieve this distinction.
translations.reference: Cutar Agana (Smallpox) Bayani: Agana cuta ce mai saurin yaɗuwa ta hanyar ƙwayar cuta ta variola, ɗaya daga cikin dangin cututtukan orthopoxvirus. Tana ɗaya daga cikin cututtuka mafi muni da dan'adam ya taɓa fama da su kuma ta yi sanadiyyar mutuwar miliyoyin mutane kafin a samu nasarar kawar da ita. Ana ganin cutar ta ci zamani a duniyar nan na kusan shekara 3000. Allurar riga-kafin agana, wadda Edward Jenner ya ƙirƙira a shekara ta 1796, ita ce riga-kafin farko da aka samu nasara. Ya nuna cewa masu sana’ar tatsar nonon da a da suka kamu da cutar aganar shanu ba sa kamuwa da cutar agana (smallpox) kuma ya nuna cewa za a iya yin amfani da irin wannan rigakafin cutar a kan wasu mutane. Ƙungiyar Lafiya ta Duniya (WHO) ta ƙaddamar da wani gagarumin shiri na kawar da cutar agana a shekara ta 1967. An gudanar riga-kafi sosai tare da sa ido a duk duniya tsawon shekaru da dama. Mutum na ƙarshe da aka sani ya kamu da cutar haka kawai a Somalia ne a 1977. A shekarar 1980, WHO ta ayyana ceyan kawar da ƙwayar cutar - watau ita ce kawai cuta mai yaɗuwa da aka samu wannan nasara a kanta.
translations.hypothesis: Ƙurajen farankama Gamsashshen bayani: Ƙurajen farankama cuta ce mai saurin yaɗuwa da ƙwayar cutar farankama ke haddasawa, wadda take cikin dangin ƙwayar cutar (orthopoxvirus). Ɗaya daga cikin cututtukan da suka fi addabar al'umma ne, inda suka jawo asarar rayukan miliyoyin mutane kafin a magance su. An yi imanin cewa ta kasance a duniya na tsawon shekaru 3000. Allurar rigakafin ƙurajen farankama, wadda Edward Jenner ya ƙirƙire ta a shekarar 1796, ita ce allurar rigakafin da ta fara samun nasara. Ya gano cewa mata masu bayar da madara da a baya suka kamu da cutar (cowpox) ba su kamu da cutar ƙurajen farankama ba, wanda hakan ya nuna cewa za a iya amfani da irin wannan allurar don hana mutane cutar ƙurajen farankama. Hukumar Lafiya ta Duniya ta ƙaddamar da wani shirin ƙara wa cutar ƙurajen farankama hari a shekarar 1967. An gudanar da yaɗa allurar rigakafi da sa ido a sassan duniya da dama na tsawon shekaru da dama. Cutar ƙurajen farankama ta ƙarshe da aka sani cewa ta faru a Somaliya ne a shekarar 1977. A shekarar 1980 Hukumar Lafiya ta Duniya ta sanar da kawar da cutar ƙurajen farankama - cutar da ta kamuwa da cutar da ta samu irin wannan bambanci.

translations.source: This remains among the most notable and profound public health successes in history. Symptoms: Early symptoms of smallpox include high fever, fatigue and severe back pain, and less often, abdominal pain and vomiting. Two to 3 days later the virus produces a characteristic rash with bumps full of a clear liquid, which later fill with pus and finally develop a crust that dries and falls off. The rash begins on the face and hands, then spreads to the rest of the body. Lesions develop in the mucous membranes of the nose and mouth and ulcerate soon after formation. Smallpox is transmitted from person to person via infective droplets during close contact with infected people who have symptoms of the disease, or in some cases through contaminated clothing and bedding. It has an incubation period of 7–17 days after exposure and only becomes infectious once a fever develops. People remain infectious until the last scabs fall off. Smallpox was fatal in up to 30% of cases.WHO smallpox recognition card WHO response: The period since eradication has been defined by a lengthy and complex debate focussed on the destruction of the last remaining stocks of live variola virus.
translations.reference: Wannan ya kasance daga cikin fitattun nasarorin da aka samu a fannin kiwon lafiyar jama'a a tarihi. Alamomi: Alamomin farko na cutar agana sun haɗa da zazzabi mai zafi, gajiya da ciwon baya mai tsanani, sai kuna akan samu ciwon ciki da amai. Bayan kwana biyu zuwa 3 ƙwayar cutar tana haifar da wani nau'i na kurji mai cike da ruwa, wanda daga baya yake cika da ɗiwa sannan a ƙarshe ya fitar da ɓawo mai bushewa, sannan sai ya faɗi. Ƙurajen suna farawa ne ta fuska da hannaye, sannan daga baya su bazu zuwa sauran sassan jiki. Za a fara samun raunuka a cikin baki da hanci da sauran wurare, sannan sai su fara raɗaɗi. Ana kamuwa da cutar agana (Smallpox) daga mutum zuwa mutum ta hanyar ɗigo-ɗigon cutar a lokacin kusanci da masu ɗauke da alamomin cutar, ko kuma a wasu lokuta ta hanyar tufafi da wajen kwanciyar mai cutar. Bayan kamuwa da cutar, alamominta suna fara bayyana ne tsakanin kwanaki 7- zuwa 17. Bayan bayyanarsa kuma, da zarar zarar an ga zazzabi, shi ke nan abu ya tabbata. Cutar za ta zauna a jikin mutum har sai ɓawo na ƙarshe ya faɗi. Cutar agana ta kashe mutane kusan kaso 30 na masu ɗauke da ita. Katin gane cutar ta WHO Matakin WHO: Tun bayan kawar da cutar agana, an ta samun muhawarorin da suka mayar da hankali kan yadda za a kawar da ɓirɓishin ƙwayoyin cutar variola.
translations.hypothesis: Wannan ya kasance cikin nasarorin kiwon lafiyar al'umma mafi shahara da zurfi a tarihi. Alamomi: Alamun farko na farankama sun haɗa da zazzabi mai zafi, gajiya da zafi mai tsanani a baya, kuma ba ofito ba, ciwon ciki da kuma amai. Kwana biyu zuwa uku bayan haka ƙwayar cutar tana haifar da ƙuraje masu wani yanayi tare da ƙuraje masu cike da ruwa mai kyau, wanda daga baya ke cika da ƙuraje kuma daga ƙarshe suna haifar da ƙasa da ke bushewa da faɗawa. Kuraje sun fara a fuska da hannaye, sannan su yaɗu zuwa sassan jiki. Ciwuka suna tasowa a cikin mucous membranes na hanci da baki kuma suna ciwo bayan ƙirƙira. Ana yaɗa farankama daga mutum zuwa mutum ta hanyar ɗigar ruwa yayin da ake kusa da masu cutar da ke da alamun cutar, ko kuma a wasu lokutan ta hanyar tufafi da kayan dakai marasa tsafta. Yana da lokacin da ya ɓuya na kwanaki 7-17 bayan bayyanar cutar kuma yana zama mai yaɗuwa ne kawai da zarar zazzabi ya ɓullo. Mutane suna kasancewa masu yaɗuwa har sai ƙuraje su faɗi. Farankama tana da mutuwa har zuwa kashi 30% na masu kamuwa da cutar. Katin gano farankama na WHO Amsar WHO: Lokacin tun bayan kawar da cutar an bayyana shi ta hanyar tattaunawa mai tsawo da sarƙaƙiya wanda ya mayar da hankali kan lalata sauran sauran ƙwayar cutar farankama.

translations.source: In 1996, at the 49th World Health Assembly, Member States decided to have this stock destroyed in June 1999, and only to allow small samples to be kept for research purposes at two designated secure laboratories – one in the United States and one in the Russian Federation. Temporary retention of the existing stocks of variola virus are used for further essential research, which is overseen by the Advisory Committee for Variola Virus Research. This group meets on an annual basis. The WHO Smallpox Secretariat based in WHO Headquarters coordinates all smallpox eradication-related and post-eradication activities. These include overseeing permitted research with live variola virus for the development of countermeasures such as vaccine and antivirals. Since the eradication era, safer vaccines and specific treatments have been developed for smallpox and related diseases such as monkeypox. The Secretariat is also responsible for emergency preparedness and manages a smallpox vaccine emergency stockpile in the unlikely event that the disease re-emerges. The Secretariat manages the biosafety and biosecurity inspections of the authorized variola virus repositories as mandated by the World Health Assembly, and ensures annual reporting to WHO Governing Bodies. The Smallpox Secretariat supports WHO Archives in preserving the global history of smallpox and documenting the lessons learned from successful eradication of smallpox. The WHO Smallpox Secretariat's current roles and responsibilities include:
translations.reference: A cikin 1996, a Majalisar Kiwon Lafiya ta Duniya ta 49, ƙasashe mambobi sun yanke shawarar lalata wannan cuta a watan Yunin 1999, sai dai kawai za a ba da damar adana samfurinta don dalilai na bincike a ɗakunan gwaje-gwaje guda biyu da aka keɓe - ɗaya a ciki a Amurka da wani kuma a Rasha. Ana amfani da waɗannan samfuran ƙwayoyin cuta na variola da aka ajiye na ɗan lokaci ne don ƙarin bincike mai muhimmanci, wanda Kwamitin Ba da Shawarwari don Binciken Cutar Variola ke kulawa. Wannan rukunin kwamitin suna haɗuwa ne duk shekara. Sakatariyar cutar agana ta WHO da ke hedikwatar WHO tana tsara duk ayyukan da suka shafi kawar da cutar da kuma abubuwan da kan zo bayan kawar da cutar. Waɗannan sun haɗa da sa ido kan binciken da aka ba da izinin yi tare da ƙwayar cutar variola mai rai don haɓaka matakan riga-kafin kamar sinadaran hana yaɗuwar ƙwayoyin cuta. Tun lokacin da aka kawar da ita wannan cuta, an samar da rigakafi da takamaimun magunguna don cutar agana da cututtukan da ke da alaƙa, kamar cutar ƙyandar biri. Sakatariyar kuma ita ce ke da alhakin shirye-shiryen gaggawa da sarrafa lamurran gaggawa na riga-kafin cutar agana a lokacin da ta ɓulla, wanda ba a yi tsammanina cutar za ta sake ɓulla ba. Sakatariyar tana kula da binciken lafiyar halittu da nazarin halittu na ma'ajiyar ƙwayoyin cuta ta variola da aka ba da izinin yin hakan, kamar yadda Majalisar Kiwon Lafiya ta Duniya ta umarta; kuma tana tabbatar da an ba da rahoton shekara-shekara ga hukumomin gudanarwa na WHO. Sakatariyar Cutar Agana taimaka wa WHO wajen adana tarihin cutar a duniya da kuma rubuta darussan da aka koya daga nasarar kawar da cutar ta agana. Ayyukan Sakatariyar WHO a yanzu sun haɗa da:
translations.hypothesis: A shekarar 1996, a taron Hukumar Lafiya ta Duniya na 49, ƙasashe mambobi sun yanke shawarar lalata wannan kaya a watan Yuli 1999, kuma kawai a ba da izinin a adana ƙananan samfura don dalilai na bincike a ɗakunan gwaje-gwaje guda biyu da aka zaɓa masu aminci - ɗaya a Amurka da ɗaya a Tarayyar Rasha. Ajiye na wucin gadi na akwai na ƙwayar cutar (variola) ana amfani da su don ƙarin bincike mai mahimmanci, wanda Kwamitin Ba da Shawara kan Bincike kan Cutar Farankama ke sa ido a kai. Wannan rukunin yana haɗuwa a kowace shekara. Sakatariyar Cutar Mai Ruwa da ke haɗa da Hukumar Lafiya ta Duniya WHO ke da alhakin daidaita dukkan ayyukan da suka shafi kawar da cutar mai ruwa da na bayan kawar da cutar. Waɗannan sun haɗa da sa ido kan bincike da aka ba da izini tare da ƙwayar cutar (variola) don haɓaka matakan kariya kamar allurar rigakafi da magungunan rigakafi. Tun lokacin kawar da cutar, an samar da alluran rigakafi masu aminci da kuma hanyoyin magance cutar don cutar mai ruwa da cututtukan da ke da alaƙa da su kamar ƙyandar biri. Sakatariyar ta kuma ta damu da shiri don buƙatu na gaggawa da kuma kula da allurar rigakafin cutar mai ruwa a yanayin da ba a yi tsammani ba da cutar ta sake bayyana. Sakatariyar ta kula da tsaron da kuma duba da biyonin da aka ajiye na ƙwayar cutar (variola) kamar yadda Majalisar Lafiya ta Duniya ta umarta, kuma tana tabbatar da rahoton shekara-shekara ga Hukumar Gudanarwar WHO. Sakatariyar Cutar Mai Ruwa tana tallafawa Hukumar Lafiya ta Duniya WHO wajen adana tarihin cutar mai ruwa na duniya da kuma rubuta darussan da aka koya daga nasarar kawar da cutar mai ruwa. A yanzu ayyukan da ke aljihun Sakatariyar Cutar Mai Ruwa sun haɗa da:

translations.source: Snakebite envenoming Overview: Snakebite envenoming is a potentially life-threatening disease caused by toxins in the bite of a venomous snake. Envenoming can also be caused by having venom sprayed into the eyes by certain species of snakes that have the ability to spit venom as a defence measure. Inadequate past efforts to control snakebite envenoming has produced fragmented, inaccurate epidemiological data. Many victims do not attend health centres or hospitals and instead rely on traditional treatments. However, available data show 4.5–5.4 million people get bitten by snakes annually. Of this, 1.8–2.7 million develop clinical illness and 81 000 to 138 000 die from complications. High-risk groups include rural agricultural workers, herders, fishermen, hunters, working children, people living in poorly constructed houses and those with limited access to education and healthcare. Morbidity and mortality occur most frequently among young people and children suffer higher case fatality. Furthermore, women experience increased barriers to accessing medical care in some cultures and pregnant women are extremely vulnerable.
translations.reference: Dafin cizon maciji Bayani: Dafin cizon maciji cuta ce mai yiwuwar cutar da rayuwa wadda ke haifar da guba idan mutum ya gamu da cikin cizon maciji. Haka kuma cutar dafin cizon tana iya samuwa ta hanyar fesa yawu da wani nau’in macizai ke yi a cikin idanuwa a matsayin matakin kare kansu. Rashin ƙoƙarin da aka yi a baya don shawo kan cutar dafin maciji ya haifar da rashin cikakku da ingantattun bayanan yaɗuwar cututtuka. Yawancin waɗanda suka taɓa samun cizon maciji ba sa zuwa cibiyoyin lafiya ko asibitoci; maimakon haka sukan dogara da magungunan gargajiya. Duk da cewa bayanan da aka tattara sun nuna cewa maciji yana sarar mutane miliyan 4.5 zuwa 5.4 a duk shekara. Daga cikin waɗannan, miliyan 1.8 zuwa 2.7 suna samun rashin lafiya kuma 81 000 zuwa 138 000 suna mutuwa daga saboda wannan cizo. Mutanen da suka fi hatsarin fuskantar wannan sun haɗa da masu aikin gona na karkara, makiyaya, masunta, mafarauta, yara masu aiki, mutanen da ke zaune a gidajen da ba a gina su da kyau ba, da kuma waɗanda ke da ƙarancin damar samun ilimi da kiwon lafiya. Kamuwa da cutar da mace-mace na faruwa a-kai-a-kai tsakanin matasa sannan yara kanana sun fi fama da yawan mace-mace. Bugu da ƙari, mata ba sa samun kulawar asibiti a wasu al'adu kuma mata masu juna biyu sun fi zama masu rauni a wannan fannin.
translations.hypothesis: Cizon jijiya da gubar halittar da ke tattare da jikin jinsin jijiya. Gamsashshen bayani: Cizon jijiya da gubar halittar da ke tattare da jikin jinsin jijiya cuta ce mai hatsari ga rayuwa da gubar jikin jinsin jijiya ke haddasawa. Cizon jijiya da gubar halittar da ke tattare da jikin jinsin jijiya za ta iya faruwa ne ta hanyar samun gubar halittar da ke tattare da jikin jinsin jijiya a idanu daga wasu jinsin jinsin jijiya da suke da ikon fitar da gubar halittar da ke tattare da jikin su a matsayin matakin kariya. Rashin isasshen ƙoƙarin da aka yi a baya na kawar da cizon jijiya da gubar halittar da ke tattare da jikin jinsin jijiya ya haifar da rarrabuwa, da rashin daidaiton bayanai na cutar. Da yawan waɗanda suka kamu da cutar ba sa zuwa cibiyoyin lafiya ko asibitoci, sai dai su dogara ne a kan magungunan gargajiya. Duk da haka, bayanan da ake da su sun nuna mutane miliyan 4.5 zuwa miliyan 5.4 suna gamuwa da cizon jijiya a kowace shekara. Daga cikin waɗannan, miliyan 1.8 zuwa miliyan 2.7 suna kamuwa da cututtuka, yayin da 81,000 zuwa 138,000 suke mutuwa sakamakon matsaloli. Manyan rukunin masu haɗari sun haɗa da ma'aikatan noma, masu aikin noma, masu aikin kiwo, masu aikin bera, masu aikin sa ran, masu aikin koyar da yara, mutanen da ke zaune a gidaje marasa inganci da waɗanda ke da ƙarancin samun ilimi da kiwon lafiya. Kamuwa da cuta da mutuwa yana faruwa akai-akai a tsakanin matasa da yara suna kamuwa da matsanancin cutar. Bugu da ƙari, mata suna fuskantar ƙarin ƙalubale wajen samun kulawar lafiya a wasu al'adu, kuma mata masu juna biyu suna cikin haɗari sosai.

translations.source: An ongoing crisis restricting access to safe, effective antivenom treatment in many regions, and particularly sub-Saharan Africa, is one factor that contributes to the predisposition for seeking help through traditional medicine. Symptoms: Bites or sprayed venom from venomous snakes can cause a range of acute and serious medical emergencies. Envenoming from different types of snakes can cause different symptoms, some more serious than others. This makes the preparation of correct antivenoms an ongoing problem. Envenoming can cause severe paralysis that may prevent breathing, making immediate medical attention critical. People may also experience bleeding disorders that can lead to fatal haemorrhages or irreversible kidney failure. Severe local tissue destruction may also occur, which can lead to permanent disability and even limb amputation. Children are at higher risk of severe effects due to lower body mass than adults. Most deaths and serious consequences from snake bites are entirely preventable by making safe and effective antivenoms more widely available and accessible, particularly in high-risk areas. High quality snake antivenoms are the only effective treatment to prevent or reverse most of the venomous effects of snake bites.
translations.reference: Rikicin da ke ci gaba da hana samun kulawar lafiya, ingantaccen maganin riga-kafi a yankuna da yawa, musamman ma yankin kudu da hamadar Sahara, wani abu ne da ke ba da gudummawa wajen yiwuwar neman taimako ta hanyar maganin gargajiya. Alamominta: Cizo ko fesa dafin da macizai masu dafi ke yi na iya haifar da mummunan yanayin gaggawa na rashin lafiya. Saka dafin nau'ikan macizai daban-daban na iya haifar da alamomi daban-daban, sai dai wasu sun fi wasu tsanani. Wannan ya sa shirye-shiryen neman ainihin maganin riga-kafi ya zama cike da matsaloli a halin yanzu. Dafin cizon maciji na iya haifar da shanyewar jiki mai tsanani wanda zai iya hana numfashi, kuma yana haifar da matsananciyar kulawar likita cikin gaggawa. Sannan kuma mutane na iya fuskantar matsalar zubar jini mai kisa ko matsalar ƙoda da ba za a iya maganinta ba. Har ila yau, za a iya samun mummunar lalacewar tsoka, wanda zai haifar da nakasu na dindindin har ma da yanke gaɓoɓin jiki. Yara sum fi samun kansu cikin wannan yanayi mai tsanani saboda rashin nauyin jiki. Yawancin mace-mace da munanan lamurran saran maciji ana iya yin riga-kafinsu gaba ɗaya ta hanyar samar da amintattun magungunan kashe ƙwayoyin cuta da kuma samun dama, musamman a wuraren da ke da haɗarin macizai. Magani masu inganci na macizai su ne kawai ingantaccen magani don hanawa ko karkatar da mafi yawan illolin cizon maciji.
translations.hypothesis: Matsalar da ake ciki a halin yanzu ta hana samun ingantaccen maganin da ake samu a yawancin yankuna, musamman yankin kudu da Hamadar Afirka, wani dalili ne da ke ba da gudunmawa ga yiyuwar neman taimako ta hanyar magungunan gargajiya. Alamomi: cizon da ake samu ko kuma fitar da guba daga jikin makamin jinsin kishi zai iya haifar da matsalolin lafiya masu yawa. Kamuwa da cutar da ake samu daga jikin makamin jinsin kishi zai iya haifar da matsalolin lafiya daban-daban, wasu fi na sauran tsananin. Wannan ya sa shirya maganin da ya dace ya zama matsala mai ci gaba. Kamuwa da cutar da ake samu daga jikin makamin jinsin kishi zai iya haifar da matsanancin ciwon kasala wanda zai iya hana numfashi, wanda hakan zai sa aiki da gaggawa na likita zai zama dole. Mutane zasu iya fuskantar matsalar zubar jini wanda zai iya haifar da matsalar zubar jini mai kisa ko kuma matsalar ƙoda da ba za a iya magance ta ba. Matsalar lalacewar ƙarancin tsokar mutum zai iya faruwa, wanda zai iya haifar da nakasa ta dindindin ko kuma yanke wani ɓangare na jiki. Yara suna cikin haɗari sosai na matsalar sakamakon ƙarancin jiki idan aka kwatanta da manya. Mafi yawanci mace-mace da matsalolin da ake samu sakamakon cizon da ake samu daga kallo gaba ɗaya ana iya magance su ta hanyar samar da ingantaccen maganin da zai rage tasirin gubar kallo, musamman a wuraren da ake da haɗarin kamuwa da cutar. Ingantattun magungunan da ke rage tasirin gubar kallo sune kawai ingantaccen magani don hana ko kawar da yawancin illolin da ake samu sakamakon cizon kallo.

translations.source: Treatment: Snake antivenoms are effective treatments to prevent or reverse most of the harmful effects of snakebite envenoming and are included in the WHO list of essential medicines. The availability and accessibility of these antivenoms, along with raising awareness on primary prevention methods among communities and health workers, are the best ways to limit serious consequences and deaths from snakebite envenoming. After a bite by a snake suspected of being venomous, follow these steps: Immediately move away from the area where the bite occurred. Remove anything tight from around the bitten part of the body to avoid harm if swelling occurs. Reassure the victim, as most venomous snake bites do not cause immediate death. Immobilize the person completely and transport the person to a health facility as soon as possible Applying pressure at the bite site with a pressure pad may be suitable in some cases. Avoid traditional first aid methods or herbal medicines. Paracetamol may be given for local pain (which can be severe).
translations.reference: Yin magani: Magungunan dafin maciji sun kasance suna da inganci wajen hanawa ko sauƙaƙa mafi yawan illolin cutar saran maciji kuma suna cikin jerin mahimman magunguna na WHO. Samuwar waɗannan magungunan kashe dafin, tare da wayar da kan jama'a kan hanyoyin riga-kafin farko a tsakanin al'ummomi da ma'aikatan kiwon lafiya, su ne mafi kyawun hanyoyin da za a iya maganin mace-mace saboda cizon maciji. Bayan saran maciji da ake zargin yana da dafi, to a bi waɗannan matakan: Nan da nan mutum ya tashi daga wajen da aka yi masa cizon. A cire duk wani abu da zai iya tamke kewayen sashen jikin da aka ciz don gujewa cutarwa idan aka samu kumburi. Ka kwantar da hankalin wanda abin aka cizan, saboda yawancin saran maciji ba ya kashe mutum nan-take. A hana mutum motsi gaba ɗaya kuma a kai shi asibiti da wuri-wuri Wasu lokutan idan aka ɗan mammatsa wurin cizon, ana iya dacewa. A guji hanyoyin taimakon gaggawa na gargajiya ko magungunan itace. Ana iya ba da paracetamol don kashe zafin wajen (wanda zai iya zama mai tsanani).
translations.hypothesis: Magani: Magungunan da ake samu na cutar da jijiya ke haddasawa suna taimakawa wajen magance ko kawar da mafi yawan illolin da jijiya ke haddasawa sannan suna cikin jerin magunguna masu mahimmanci na hukumar lafiya ta duniya WHO. Samun waɗannan magungunan da sauƙin samun su, da wayar da kan al'umma da ma'aikatan lafiya game da hanyoyin kariya daga farko, sune mafi kyawun hanyoyin rage yawan illoli da mace-mace daga jijiya. Bayan kamuwa da cizon jijiya mai guba, sai a bi waɗannan matakan: A ɗauki matakin barin wajen da aka samu cizon nan da gaggawa. A cire duk wani abu da ke daɗaɓa wajen da aka cizon jikin don a gujewa matsala idan aka samu kumburi. A yi wa wanda ya kamu da ciwon alƙawarin cewa ba shi ne dole ya mutu nan da nan, saboda yawancin cizon jijiya masu guba ba sa haddasa mutuwa nan da nan. A tsare mutumin gaba ɗaya sannan a kai shi asibiti cikin gaggawa. A yi amfani da wani abu mai tauri a wajen da aka cizon don rage yawan gudanar jinin a wasu lokutan. A gujewa amfani da hanyoyin agajin farko na gargajiya ko magungunan shuke-shuke. Za a iya ba wa mutum paracetamol don rage raɗaɗin ciwon (wanda zai iya zama mai tsanani).

translations.source: Vomiting may occur, so place the person on their left side in the recovery position. Closely monitor airway and breathing and be ready to resuscitate if necessary

translations.source: Soil-transmitted helminthiases Overview: Soil-transmitted helminth (STH) infections are among the most common infections worldwide and affect the poorest and most deprived communities. They are transmitted by eggs present in human faeces which in turn contaminate soil in areas where sanitation is poor. The main species that infect people are the roundworm (Ascaris lumbricoides), the whipworm (Trichuris trichiura) and the hookworms (Necator americanus and Ancylostoma duodenale). Intestinal worms produce a wide range of symptoms including intestinal manifestations (diarrhoea, abdominal pain), general malaise and weakness. Hookworms cause chronic intestinal blood loss that result in anaemia. Soil-transmitted helminths are transmitted by eggs that are passed in the faeces of infected people. Adult worms live in the intestine where they produce thousands of eggs each day. In areas that lack adequate sanitation, these eggs contaminate the soil. This can happen in several ways: eggs that are attached to vegetables are ingested when the vegetables are not carefully cooked, washed or peeled;
translations.reference: Cutar tsutsotsi Bayani: Cututtukan tsutsotsi (wato STH a taƙaice) suna daga cikin cututtukan da aka fi sani a duk duniya kuma suna shafar al'ummomin da suka fi talauci da rashin ƙarfi. Suna samuwa ne ta hanyar ƙwai da ke cikin najasar ɗan'adam wanda hakan ke gurɓata ƙasa a wuraren da tsaftar muhalli ta ti ƙaranci. Manyan nau'ukan da ke cutar da mutane su ne roundworm (Ascaris lumbricoides), whipworm (Trichuris trichiura) da hookworm (Necator Americanus da Ancylostoma duodenale). Tsutsotsi na hanji suna fitar da alamomi iri-iri da suka shafi hanji (zawo, ciwon ciki), rashin lafiya da mutuwar jiki. Hookworms suna haifar da asarar jini na hanji na yau da kullun wanda ke haifar da cutar da ake kira anemia a Turance. Ana samar da waɗannan tsutsotsi ne ta hanyar ƙwai waɗanda ke fitowa a cikin najasar mutanen da suka kamu da cutar. Tsutsotsi na manya suna rayuwa ne a cikin hanji inda suke samar da dubban ƙwai kowace rana. A wuraren da ba su da isasshen tsafta, waɗannan ƙwai suna gurɓata ƙasa. Wannan na iya faruwa ta hanyoyi da yawa: ana cin wannan ƙwan da ke maƙala da kayan lambu ne a lokacin da ba a dafa kayan lambun da kyau ba, ko ba a wanke ko an ɓare bawon da kyai ba;
translations.hypothesis: Ƙwayoyin cutar tsutsar ciki da ke yaɗuwa ta hanyar ƙasa Gamsashshen bayani: cututtukan tsutsar ciki da ke yaɗuwa ta hanyar ƙasa (STH) suna daga cikin gama-garin cututtuka a faɗin duniya kuma suna shafar mutane mafi talauci da kuma al'ummomi mafi raunin rayuwa. Ana yaɗa su ne ta hanyar ƙwai da ke cikin najasar mutum wanda ke gurɓata ƙasa a wuraren da ba su da tsafta. Manyan nau'ukan da ke yaɗuwa ga mutane su ne tsutsar 'yan-kumburi (Ascaris lumbricoides), tsutsar 'yan-ƙurji (Trichuris trichiura) da tsutsar 'yan-baki (Necator americanus da Ancylostoma duodenale). Tsutsotsi na hanji suna samar da alamomi masu yawa da suka haɗa da alamun da ke nuna ciwon ciki (zawo, ciwon ciki), rashin lafiya gaba ɗaya da kuma raunin jiki. Tsutsotsi na 'yan-baki na haifar da matsalar zubar jini a cikin hanji wanda ke haifar da matsalar rashin jini. Tsutsotsi na ƙasa da ake yaɗuwa ta hanyar ƙasa ana yaɗa su ne ta hanyar ƙwai da ake fitarwa a cikin najasar mutanen da suka kamu da cutar. Manyan tsutsotsi na rayuwa ne a cikin hanji inda suke samar da dubban ƙwai a kowace rana. A wuraren da ba su da tsafta, waɗannan ƙwai suna gurɓata ƙasa. Hakan na iya faruwa ta hanyoyi da yawa: ƙwai da ke haɗe da kayan lambu ana ci lokacin da ba a dafa kayan lambu ko a wanke ko a shafa fatarsa;

translations.source: eggs are ingested from contaminated water sources; eggs are ingested by children who play in the contaminated soil and then put their hands in their mouths without washing them. Symptoms: Morbidity is related to the number of worms harboured. People with infections of light intensity (few worms) usually do not suffer from the infection. Heavier infections can cause a range of symptoms including intestinal manifestations (diarrhoea and abdominal pain), malnutrition, general malaise and weakness, and impaired growth and physical development. Infections of very high intensity can cause intestinal obstruction that should be treated surgically. S. stercoralis may cause dermatological and gastro-intestinal morbidity and is also known to be associated with chronic malnutrition in children. In case of reduced host immunity, the parasite can cause the hyperinfection/dissemination syndrome that is invariably fatal if not promptly and properly cured and is often fatal despite the treatment. In 2001, delegates at the World Health Assembly unanimously endorsed a resolution (WHA54.19) urging endemic countries to start seriously tackling worms, specifically schistosomiasis and soil-transmitted helminths. The strategy for control of soil-transmitted helminth infections is to control morbidity through the periodic treatment of at-risk people living in endemic areas.
translations.reference: ana cin ƙwan a gurɓataccen ruwa; yaran da ke wasa a gurɓataccen wuri suna cin ƙwan ne idan sun sanya hannayensu a cikin bakinsu ba tare da wankewa ba. Alamunta: kamuwa da cutar yana da alaƙa da adadin tsutsotsi da suka yi wa mutum katutu. Mutanen da ke ɗauke tsutsotsin ƙaɗan yawanci cutar ba ta kama su. Idan kuma suka yi yawa, suna iya haifar da alamomi iri-iri da suka danganci hanji (zawo da ciwon ciki), rashin nuna cewa mutum yana cin abinci mai gina jiki, raunin jiki da rashin girma da haɓakar jiki. Lokacin da cutar ta yi tsanani sosai, tana iya haifar da toshewar hanji wanda ya kamata a ce an yi tiyata. S. stercoralis na iya haifar da cututtuka na fara da hanji kuma an san yana da alaƙa da rashin abinci mai gina jiki na yau da kullum a tsakanin yara. Idan ma mai ɗauke da cutar garkuwar jikinsa ta ragu, ƙwayar cuta na iya karaɗe masa jiki, wadda tana iya kisa a koyaushe idan ba a yi magani da sauri ba kuma sau da yawa mutum yana iya mutuwa duk da an masa jinya. A shekarar 2001, wakilai a Majalisar Kiwon Lafiya ta Duniya sun amince da wani kuduri (WHA54.19) wanda yake kira ga ƙasashe masu fama da cutar da su fara yaƙar tsutsotsi, musamman schistosomiasis da helminths. Dabarar yaƙar cututtukan tsutsotsin ita ce sarrafa cututtuka ta hanyar jinya na lokaci-lokaci na mutanen da ke fama da abin waɗanda kuma ke zaune a yankunan da ke fama da cutar.
translations.hypothesis: Ana shan ƙwai daga wuraren da ke ɗauke da ƙwayar cutar a ruwa; Yara ne ke ci ƙwai da suke wasa a cikin ƙasa mai ɗauke da ƙwayar cutar sannan su shiga hannunsu a baki ba tare da wanke su ba. Alamomi: Rashin lafiya yana da alaƙa da yawan tsutsotsin da ke ɗauke da cutar. Mutanen da ke ɗauke da cutar mai raunin ƙarfi (ƙalilan tsutsotsi) yawanci ba sa fama da cutar. Masu tsananin cutar na iya haifar da alamomi da yawa da suka haɗa da ciwon ciki (ciwon ciki da ciwon ciki), rashin abinci mai gina jiki, rashin lafiya gaba ɗaya da raunin jiki, da kuma matsalar girma da ci gaba na zahiri. Cututtukan masu tsananin raunin zafi na iya haifar da toshewar hanji wanda ya kamata a yi masa tiyata. S. stercoralis na iya haifar da cututtukan fata da na hanji kuma an san shi da alaƙa da rashin abinci mai gina jiki na yau da kullum a cikin yara. Idan an rage kariyar jikin mai ɗaukan cutar, ƙwayar cutar za ta iya haifar da cutar/ƙwayar cutar da ke yaɗuwa wanda a kowane hali tana kisa idan ba a warkewa cikin gaggawa da kyau ba kuma yawanci tana kisa duk da yin magani. A cikin shekarar 2001, wakilai a taron lafiya na duniya sun amince da ƙuduri (WHA54.19) tare da buƙatar ƙasashen da ke fama da cutar da su fara magance tsutsotsi da gaske, musamman tsutsotsi da ke yaɗuwa ta hanyar ƙasa. Dabarar kawar da cututtukan tsutsotsi na ƙasa shi ne ta hanyar magance cutar ta hanyar kula da mutanen da ke cikin haɗari a wuraren da ke fama da cutar.

translations.source: People at risk are: preschool children school-age children women of reproductive age (including pregnant women in the second and third trimesters and breastfeeding women) adults in certain high-risk occupations such as tea-pickers or miners. TreatmentThe WHO recommended medicines –albendazole (400 mg) and mebendazole (500 mg) – are effective, inexpensive and easy to administer by non-medical personnel (e.g. teachers). They have been through extensive safety testing and have been used in millions of people with few and minor side-effects. Both albendazole and mebendazole are donated to national ministries of health through WHO in all endemic countries for the treatment of all children of school age. Ivermectin for the control of S. stercoralis is expected to be available at affordable price from 2021.
translations.reference: Mutanen da za su iya daukar cutar: Yaran da ba su shiga makaranta ba tukunna Yara ƴan makaranta matan da suka kai shekarun haihuwa (ciki har da mata masu juna biyu da ke tsakanin wata 6 zuwa 9 da mata masu shayarwa) mutane a wasu sana'o'i masu haɗarin ɗaukar wannan cutar akwai masu noman ganyen shayi ko masu haƙar ma'adinai. Magani: Magungunan da WHO ta ba da shawarar aiki da su -albendazole (400 MG) da mebendazole (500 MG) - suna da tasiri, ba su da tsada kuma ga sauƙin gane yadda za a yi amfani da shi ko ga ma'aikatan da ba likita ba (misali malamai). An duba magungunan sosai ta hanyar gwaji mai yawa kuma an yi amfani da su a kan miliyoyin mutane, kuma ba a ga wata illa tare da su ba. Duka albendazole da mebendazole ana ba da su gudummawa ga ma'aikatun lafiya na ƙasa ta ƙarƙashin WHO a duk ƙasashen da ke fama da cutar don kula da duk yaran da suka isa shiga makaranta. Ivermectin wanda ake sa ran zai rage yaɗuwar S. stercoralis zai kasance a farashi mai araha daga 2021.
translations.hypothesis: Mutanen da ke cikin haɗari sune: yara 'yan makarantar ƙuruciya yara 'yan makaranta mata masu shekarun haihuwa (ciki har da mata masu juna biyu a watanni shida na biyu da na uku da mata masu shayarwa) manya a wasu sana'o'i masu haɗari da suka haɗa da masu yin shaye-shaye ko ma'aikatan ma'adanai. Magani Magungunan da WHO ta ba da shawara - albendazole (400 mg) da mebendazole (500 mg) - suna aiki, ba tsada kuma masu sauƙin gudanarwa daga ma'aikatan da ba na likitanci ba (misali, malamai). An gwada su sosai a kan aminci kuma an yi amfani da su a miliyoyin mutane tare da ƙarancin illoli. Duka albendazole da mebendazole an ba da gudunmawa ga ma'aikatun lafiya na ƙasa ta hanyar WHO a duk ƙasashen da ke fama da cutar don maganin duk yara 'yan makaranta. Ana sa ran Ivermectin don sarrafa S. stercoralis zai samu a farashi mai araha daga 2021.

translations.source: Stillbirth Overview: A baby who dies after 28 weeks of pregnancy, but before or during birth, is classified as a stillbirth.There are nearly 2 million stillbirths every year – one every 16 seconds. Over 40% of all stillbirths occur during labour – a loss that could be avoided with improved quality and respectful care during childbirth including routine monitoring and timely access to emergency obstetric care when required. Experiencing a stillbirth during pregnancy or childbirth is a tragedy insufficiently addressed in global agendas, policies and funded programmes. There are psychological costs, especially to women and their families, such as maternal depression, financial consequences and economic repercussions, as well as stigma and taboo.In 2014, the World Health Assembly endorsed the Every Newborn Action Plan (ENAP), which includes a global target of 12 or fewer third trimester (late) stillbirths per 1,000 total births in every country by 2030. In 2021, 139 mainly high-income and upper middle-income countries had met this target, but 56 countries will not each the ENAP target by 2030 if further efforts are not made. If current trends continue, 15.9 million babies will be stillborn; nearly half of these (7.7 million, 48%) will occur in sub-Saharan Africa. Causes: With quality health care throughout pregnancy and childbirth, most stillbirths are preventable. The major causes of stillbirth include pregnancy and childbirth-related complications, prolonged pregnancy, maternal infections such as malaria, syphilis and HIV, maternal conditions especially hypertension, and diabetes, and fetal growth restriction (when an unborn baby is unable to achieve its growth potential and therefore smaller than it should be). Congenital abnormalities are responsible for less than 10% of stillbirths reported nationally in high-income countries and the exact proportion in low-income settings is unknown due to limitations in diagnostics.
translations.reference: Haihuwar jariri a mace Bayani: Jaririn da ya mutu bayan makonni 28 a ciki, kafin ko lokacin haihuwa, ana ƙirga shi a matsayin wanda aka haifa a mace. Ana haihuwar jarirai kusan miliyan 2 a mace a kowace shekara - jariri ɗaya ke nan a cikin duk daƙika 16. Fiye da kashi 40 cikin 100 na jariran da ake haifa a mace suna mutuwa ne a lokacin naƙuda – asarar da za a iya guje wa ta hanyar ingantaccen tsari da nuna kulawa yayin haihuwa, ciki har da sa ido na yau da kullum da ba da kulawar haihuwa ta gaggawa lokacin da ya kamata. Mutuwar jarirai a lokacin juna biyu ko lokacin haihuwa wani bala'i ne wanda ba a magance shi ba a cikin ajandar duniya, manufofi da shirye-shiryen da aka ba wa kuɗi. Ana samun kaɗuwar zuciya, musamman ga mata da danginsu, kamar shiga damuwa lokacin jego, matsalolin kuɗi, da kuma nuna ƙyama da ƙiyayya. A shekarar 2014, Majalisar Kiwon Lafiya ta Duniya ta amince da Tsarin Hidima ga Jarirai (ENAP), wanda ya haɗa da burin rage adadin mace-macen jarirai a cikin mahaifa da guda 12 ko ƙasa da haka a wata na huɗu zuwa shida lokacin rainon ciki a jimillar haihuwa 1,000 a kowace ƙasa nan da 2030. A shekarar 2021, ƙasashe 139 galibi masu ƙarfin tattalin arziki da masu tattalin arziki dama-dama sun cimma wannan manufa, amma ƙasashe 56 ba za su cimma wannan manufa ta ENAP ba nan da shekarar 2030 idan ba a ƙara yin kokari ba. Idan aka ci gaba a haka, za a haifi jarirai miliyan 15.9 a mace; kuma kusan rabin waɗannan (watau miliyan 7.7, 48%) duk a yankin ƙasashen kudu da Sahara. Abubuwan da ke jawo shi: Idan akwai ingantacciyar kulawar lafiya tun daga lokacin rainon ciki da haihuwa, ana iya kauce wa mafi yawan haihuwar jarirai a mace. Manyan abubuwan da ke haifar da haihuwar jarirai a mace sun haɗa da matsalolin rainon ciki da haihuwa, doguwar naƙuda, cututtuka kamar zazzabin cizon sauro, cutar sifilis da cutar sida, hawan jini, da ciwon sukari, da hana girman jaririn da ke ciki. Matsalolin da ake haifar mutum da su suna haddasa ƙasa da kaso 10 na mutuwar jarirai kafin a haife su kamar yadda aka ruwaito a ƙasashe masu ƙarfin tattalin arziki kuma ba a san ainihin adadin ba a ƙasashe masu ƙarancin tattalin arziki saboda rashin iya binciko waɗannan lamurran.
translations.hypothesis: Jarabar haihuwa Gamsashshen bayani: Jarabar haihuwa shi ne jariri da ya mutu bayan makwanni 28 na ciki, amma kafin ko lokacin haihuwa, ana kallo a matsayin jarabar haihuwa. Akwai kusan jarirai miliyan 2 da suke mutuwa a kowace shekara - ɗaya a kowace sakan 16. Sama da kashi 40% na dukkan jarirai da suke mutuwa a lokacin haihuwa - asara wanda za a iya gujewa tare da ingantacciyar kulawa da girmamawa yayin haihuwa wanda ya haɗa da sa ido na yau da kullum da samun kulawar da ta dace a kan lokaci yayin da ake bukata. Fuskantar jarabar haihuwa yayin ciki ko lokacin haihuwa abin takaici ne wanda ba a ba da isasshen kulawa ba a cikin ajandar duniya, da manufofi da shirye-shirye masu ɗaukar nauyi. Akwai farashin tunani, musamman ga mata da iyalansu, kamar ciwon damuwa na mata, sakamakon kuɗi da sakamakon tattalin arziƙi, da kuma nuna mu da tabo. A shekarar 2014, Majalisar Lafiya ta Duniya ta amince da shirin kowanne sabon haihuwa (ENAP), wanda ya haɗa da manufar duniya ta 12 ko ƙasa da haifar jarirai (matsalar) a kowace ƙasa nan da shekarar 2030. A shekarar 2021, ƙasashe 139 yawanci masu karfin siyan kaya da matsakaita ƙarfin siyan kaya sun cim ma wannan manufar, amma ƙasashe 56 ba za su iya cim ma manufar ENAP ba a shekarar 2030 idan ba a ƙara ƙoƙari ba. Idan yanayin da ake ciki yanzu ya ci gaba, jarirai miliyan 15.9 za su haifar da jarirai da ba su yi sa'a ba; kusan rabin su (7.7 miliyan, 48%) za su faru a Saharar Afirka. Abubuwan da ke haddasawa: Tare da ingantaccen kulawar lafiya a duk tsawin ciki da lokacin haihuwa, za a iya hana yawancin jarirai da ba su yi sa'a ba. Manyan abubuwan da ke haddasawa na jarirai sun haɗa da matsalolin da suka shafi ciki da haihuwa, da tsawon lokacin ciki, da cututtukan mata masu haihuwa kamar zazzaɓin cizon sauro, sifilis da HIV, da yanayin mata masu haihuwa musamman hawan jini, da ciwon siga, da kuma hana girman tayi (lokacin da jariri da ba a haifa ba ya kasa kaiwa ga girman da ya kamata don haka ya zama ƙanƙanta fiye da yadda ya kamata). Matsalolin da ake haifar mutum da su na da alhakin jarirai da ba su yi sa'a ba fiye da kashi 10% na jarirai da ba su yi sa'a ba da aka ruwaito a matakin ƙasa a cikin ƙasashe masu karfin siyan kaya da kuma ainihin adadin a cikin ƙananan ƙasashe ba a sani ba saboda iyakantattun gwaje-gwajen.

translations.source: Factors related to age of the mother and practicing smoking can also increase the risk of maternal disease and stillbirth. Stillbirths can be prevented through family planning to avoid unwanted pregnancies, good health and nutrition prior to and during pregnancy, quality and respectful antenatal and childbirth care including adequate skilled health personnel including midwives. Syphilis treatment in pregnancy could also prevent an estimated 200 000 stillbirths, while fetal heart rate monitoring and labour surveillance and prompt interventions when needed are crucial for preventing 832 000 intrapartum stillbirths and reducing neonatal deaths. Stillbirths are strongly linked to adverse social and economic determinants of health. Prevention and responsive care need to be integrated across the continuum of maternal health care, and beyond. This includes respectful and supportive care in the event of a death. Listening to the experiences and voices of women and their communities is essential to help address issues of stigma associated with stillbirth. WHO response: More needs to be done to integrate stillbirth prevention within global and national agendas for high quality health care for women, adolescents, and babies. Through the Global Strategy for Women's, Children's and Adolescents Health 2016–2030 and implementing the recommendations of the Every Newborn Action Plan (2014), WHO is working to end preventable stillbirths, as part of efforts to improve maternal, newborn, child and adolescent health. Most stillbirths do not receive a birth certificate and are not registered.
translations.reference: Abubuwan da suka danganci shekarun uwa da kuma shan taba suna iya ƙara yiwuwar kamuwa da cututtukan da ke da alaƙa da jego da kuma haihuwar jarirai a mace. Ana iya kauce wa haihuwar jarirai a mace ta hanyar tsarin iyali don hana samin haihuwar da ba a buƙata, samun cikakken kiwon lafiya da abinci mai gina jiki kafin da lokacin rainon ciki, samun ingantacciyar kulawa yayin haihuwa, ciki har da samar da ƙwararrun ma'aikatan kiwon lafiya, kamar da ungozoma. Maganin cutar sifilis a lokacin rainon ciki shi ma zai iya hana haihuwar kimanin jarirai 200 000 a mace, yayin da saka idanu kan bugun zuciya da sa ido a kan aiki da kuma kawo ɗauki lokacin da ake buƙata suna da mahimmanci don kauce wa mutuwar jarirai da ke cikin mahaifansu guda 832,000 tare da rage mutuwar jarirai. Haihuwar jariri a mace har yanzu tana da alaƙa mai ƙarfi da munanan al'amurran lafiya na zamantakewa da tattalin arziki. Riga-kafi da nuna kulawa ta hanyar kai agaji suna buƙatar a haɗa su a yi amfani da su a fannin kula da lafiyar mata da sauran fannoni. Wannan ya haɗa da kulawa da tallafi a yayin mutuwa. Sauraron abubuwan da suka faru mata da al'ummominsu da suka fito yana da mahimmanci don taimakawa wajen magance matsalolin ƙyama da ke da alaƙa da haihuwar jarirai a mace. Amsar WHO: Ana buƙatar ƙara zage damtse don ganin an sanya yaƙi da haihuwar jarirai a mace cikin ajandoji na duniya da na ƙasa don ingantaccen kiwon lafiya ga mata, matasa, da jarirai. Ta ƙarƙashin shirin Dabarun Lafiyar Mata, Yara da Matasa a Faɗin Diniya 2016-2030 da amfani da shawarwarin kowane Tsarin Hidima wa Jarirai a (2014), WHO na aiki don kawo ƙarshen haifuwar jarirai mace, a matsayin wani ɓangare na ƙoƙarin inganta lafiyar mata masu juna biyu, Jariri, yaro da lafiyar matasa. Yawancin jariran da ake haihuwa a mace ba sa samun takardar shaidar haihuwa kuma ba su da rajista.
translations.hypothesis: Abubuwan da ke da alaƙa da shekarun uwa da kuma amfani da taba na iya ƙara haɗarin kamuwa da cututtukan mata da haifar da jariri matacce. Za a iya hana haifar da jarirai matacce ta hanyar tsarin iyali don guje wa ɗaukar cikin da ba a so ba, da ingantacciyar lafiya da abinci kafin da lokacin ɗaukar ciki, da ingantacciyar kulawa da girmamawa na kafin haihuwa da haihuwa wanda ya haɗa da isassun ƙwararrun ma'aikatan kiwon lafiya da suka haɗa da ungozoma. Maganin cutar mai kama zuciya a lokacin ɗaukar ciki na iya hana kimanin haifar da jarirai matacce 200 000, yayin da sa ido kan bugun zuciyar tayi da sa ido kan haifar da saurin ɗauki matakai yayin da ake buƙata yana da mahimmanci don hana 832 000 haifar da jarirai matacce yayin haihuwa da rage mace-macen jarirai. Haifar da jarirai matacce suna da alaƙa da munanan abubuwan da ke da tasiri ga lafiya na zamantakewa da tattalin arziƙi. Riga-kafi da kulawa mai amfani da shi na buƙatar a haɗa su a duk faɗin ci gaba da kulawa da lafiyar mata, da kuma bayan haka. Wannan ya haɗa da kulawa mai girmamawa da tallafawa a lokacin mutuwa. Sauraron gogewa da muryoyin mata da al'ummominsu yana da mahimmanci don taimakawa wajen magance matsalolin nuna mu'amala da ke da alaƙa da haifar da jariri matacce. Amsar WHO: Ana buƙatar a yi fiye don haɗa rigakafin haifar da jarirai matacce a cikin tsare-tsaren duniya da na ƙasa don ingantacciyar kulawar lafiya ga mata, matasa, da jarirai. Ta hanyar Tsarin Duniya don Lafiyar Mata, Yara da Matasa na shekarar 2016 zuwa 2030 da aiwatar da shawarwarin shirin kowanne sabon haihuwa (2014), WHO na aiki don kawo ƙarshen haifar da jarirai matacce, a matsayin wani ɓangare na ƙoƙarin inganta lafiyar mata, jarirai, yara da matasa. Mafi yawanci haifar da jarirai matacce ba su da takardar shedar haihuwa kuma ba a yi musu rijista ba.

translations.source: Improving systems for reporting births and neonatal deaths is a matter of human rights and a prerequisite for reducing stillbirths. In addition, there is a need to strengthen routine health information systems to accurately capture and report stillbirths for monitoring and improving the quality of care. WHO provides tools to help countries improve their data on both stillbirths and neonatal deaths. WHO also has guidance to help countries review and investigate individual deaths so they can recommend and implement solutions to prevent similar ones in the future and a standard classification system for perinatal deaths (ICD-PM). WHO and UNICEF are supporting a call for collective action to end preventable stillbirths by: increasing awareness and reducing stigma supporting bereaved women and families strengthening health systems to provide high-quality care nationalizing and localizing stillbirth targets improving measurement of stillbirths to enhance evidence and knowledge.
translations.reference: Inganta tsarin bayar da rahoton haihuwa da mutuwar jarirai al'amari ne na 'yancin ɗan'adam kuma abu ne da ake buƙata don rage haifar jarirai a mace. Bugu da ƙari, akwai buƙatar ƙarfafa tsarin bayanan kiwon lafiya na yau da kullum don samar da sahihin rahoton haihuwa don sa ido da haɓaka ingancin ba da kulawar lafiya. WHO ta ba da kayan aiki don taimaka wa ƙasashe su inganta ɗaukar ƙididdigarsu game da haihuwa da kuma mutuwar jarirai. WHO ta kuma ba da hanyoyi don taimaka wa ƙasashe yin nazari da bincika mutuwar mutane don su iya ba da shawararda aiwatar da mafita don hana irin waɗannan a nan gaba da kuma samar da tsarin tantance mutuwa kafin haihuwa (ICD-PM). WHO da UNICEF suna goyan bayan kira ga matakin gama kai don kawo ƙarshen haifuwar jarirai a mace ta hanyar: ƙara wayar da kai da rage jin ƙyama taimaka wa mata da iyalan da aka mutu aka bari inganta harkar kiwon lafiya kallon matsalar mutuwar jarirai kafin haihuwa abin da ya shafi ƙasa da al'umma yunƙurin ƙara ƙaimi wajen ɗaukar ƙididdigar mutuwar jarirai a mace domin tabbatar da faruwar lamarin da kuma sanin halin da ake ciiki.
translations.hypothesis: Inganta tsare-tsaren bayar da rahoton haihuwa da mace-macen jarirai al'amura ne da suka shafi haƙƙin ɗan'adam da kuma wani abin da ake buƙata wajen rage yawan haifar da jarirai da ba su kai lokacin haihuwa ba. Bugu da ƙari, akwai buƙatar ƙarfafa tsare-tsaren bayanan lafiya na yau da kullum don samun daidaiton bayanan da rahoton haifar da jarirai da ba su kai lokacin haihuwa ba don sa ido da inganta kulawa. Hukumar Lafiya ta Duniya ta samar da kayan aiki don taimakawa ƙasashe su inganta bayanansu game da duka haifar da jarirai da ba su kai lokacin haihuwa ba da mace-macen jarirai. Hukumar Lafiya ta Duniya ta kuma samar da jagoranci don taimakawa ƙasashe su sake nazari da binciken mutuwar mutane don su iya ba da shawarwari da aiwatar da mafita don hana irin su a nan gaba da kuma tsarin rarrabawa mai ma'ana ga mutuwar haifar (ICD-PM). Hukumar Lafiya ta Duniya da Asusun Ƙasa da Ƙasa na Tallafa wa Ƙananan Yara na tallafawa wani kiran ɗaukar mataki na bai ɗaya don kawo ƙarshen haifar da jarirai da ba a yi tsammani ba ta hanyar: ƙara wayar da kai da rage nuna tsana tallafawa mata da iyalai da suka rasa rayuwa ƙarfafa tsare-tsaren lafiya don samar da kulawa mai inganci mai inganci sanya haifar da jarirai da ba a yi tsammani ba a matsayin manufa ta ƙasa da na gida inganta ma'aunin haifar da jarirai da ba a yi tsammani ba don haɓaka shaida da ilimi.

translations.source: Substandard and falsified medical products Overview: Up to two billion people around the world lack access to necessary medicines, vaccines, medical devices including in vitro diagnostics, and other health products, which creates a vacuum that is too often filled by substandard and falsified products. This problem is growing as global supply chains become more complex, meaning products manufactured in one country may be packaged in a second country and distributed across borders to be marketed or sold to consumers in a third. The growth of e-commerce also contributes to this trend by making it easier to purchase medicines online, often from unauthorized sources. WHO has identified this issue one of the urgent health challenges for the next decade given that more than one in ten medicines in low- and middle-income countries are estimated to be substandard or falsified. No country remains untouched from this issue, and WHO has received reports of substandard or falsified medical medicines, vaccines and in vitro diagnostics from all regions of the world. Both generic and innovator medicines can be falsified, ranging from very expensive products for cancer to very inexpensive products for treatment of pain. WHO Member States have agreed on a comprehensive global strategy focused on prevention, detection and response to move towards achieving increased access to quality, safe, effective and quality medical products. Impact: Substandard and falsified medical products create many problems for both the individual taking the medicine and for families, the larger society, health care system and supply chain. When medicines do not work the way they should, they can fail to treat or prevent disease, contribute to antimicrobial resistance, waste precious resources and lead to a loss of confidence in medicines and distrust of healthcare providers.
translations.reference: Kayan aikin jinya da magunguna marasa inganci da na bogi Bayyani: Kimanin mutane biliyan biyu a duniya ba su da damar samun ainihin magunguna, alluran riga-kafi, na'urorin likitanci da suka hada da na bincika rashin lafiya, da sauran kayayyakin kiwon lafiya, waɗanda saboda rashinsu sai dai kawai a yi amfani da marasa inganci kuma na bogi. Wannan matsala tana ta ƙaruwa ne yayin da salsalar samar da kayayyaki na duniya ke ƙara cika da sarƙaƙƙiya, ma'ana kayayyakin da aka ƙera a wata ƙasa ana iya tattara ninke su cikin fakiti a wata ƙasa kuma a tura su don a tallata ko a sayar da su ga masu siye a wata ƙasa daban. Bunƙasar kasuwancin zamani ya taimaka wajen wannan al'amari ta hanyar sauƙaƙawa wajen siyan magungunan ta intanet, yawanci ta hannun waɗanda ba su cancanta ba. . Hukumar Lafiya ta Duniya ta bayyana wannan matsalar da ɗaya daga cikin matsalolin lafiya da za a fuskanta nan da shekara goma, inda aka yi hasashen samun ɗaya daga cikin magunguna goma yakasance ba shi da inganci ko na jabu a ƙasashen da ke da ƙaranci da matsakaicin kuɗin shiga. Babu wata ƙasa da wannan al'amari bai shafa ba, in Hukumar Lafiya ta Duniya ta samu rahotanni game da magunguna da allurori marasa inganci ko na jabu da kuma gwaje-gwajen cututtuka daga kome lungu da saƙo na duniya. Wannan lamari na yin jabu ka iya shafar kowane nau'i na magani, kama daga magungunan kansa masu tsada zuwa magungunan kashe zafi masu sauƙi. ƙasashen da cikin Majalisar Ɗinkin Duniya sun amince da a ɗauki babban mataki da zai mayar da hankali wajen kawarwa da ganowa da kuma ɗaukar mataki wajen samun ƙaruwar kaiwa ga ingantacce, amintacce kuma gangariyar magani. Tasiri: Magunguna marasa inganci ko na jabu na haifar da matsaloli da dama ga ɗaiɗaikun mutane da iyalai da suke amfani da su da ma al'umma da tsarin kula da lafiya da kuma hanyoyin rarraba su. Yayin da maganunguna ba su yi aiki ba, za su gaza ne wajen yin maganin cuta, lamarin da ka iya haifar da tirjiyar ƙwayoyin cuta da ɓarnar dukiya da kuma daina amincewa da da magunguna da kuma masu samar da kulawa ta lafiya.
translations.hypothesis: Magunguna marasa inganci da ƙarya Gamsashshen bayani: Kusan mutane biliyan biyu a faɗin duniya basu da damar samun magunguna da alluran rigakafi da na'urorin kiwon lafiya da suka haɗa da gwaje-gwajen da ake yi a wajen jikin mutum da sauran kayan kiwon lafiya, wanda hakan ke haifar da giɓi da magunguna marasa inganci da ƙarya ke cika. Wannan matsalar tana ƙara girma yayin da hanyoyin samar da kayayyaki na duniya ke ƙara sarƙaƙiya, wanda hakan ke nufin kayayyakin da aka ƙera a ƙasa ɗaya za a iya saka su a ƙarace ta biyu sannan a rarraba su zuwa ƙasashen waje don sayarwa ko sayarwa ga masu amfani da su a ƙarace ta uku. Ƙaruwar kasuwancin intanet ya kuma ba da gudunmawa ga wannan yanayin ta hanyar sauƙaƙa sayen magunguna ta yanar gizo, wanda yawanci ana samunsa daga gurare marasa izini. Hukumar Lafiya ta Duniya ta gano wannan matsalar a matsayin ɗaya daga cikin matsalolin kiwon lafiya masu buƙatar kulawa ta musamman a shekaru goma masu zuwa, ganin yadda fiye da magunguna ɗaya daga cikin kowace goma a ƙasashe masu ƙaranci da matsakaicin arziƙi ke ƙiyasta kasancewa marasa inganci ko ƙarya. Babu wata ƙasa da ba ta shafa wannan matsalar ba, kuma Hukumar Lafiya ta Duniya ta sami rahoton samun magunguna marasa inganci ko ƙarya da alluran rigakafi da gwaje-gwajen da ake yi a wajen jikin mutum daga dukkan yankunan duniya. Duka biyun magunguna na gama gari da na sabon ƙirƙire-ƙirƙire za su iya zama ƙarya, wanda ya haɗa da daga samfurin da suke da tsada sosai don maganin cutar daji zuwa ga samfurin da ba su da tsada don maganin raɗaɗi. Ƙasashen da Hukumar Lafiya ta Duniya WHO ke lura da su sun amince da wani cikakken tsarin duniya wanda ya mai da hankali kan rigakafi da gano da kuma kai ɗauki don ci gaba da cimma ƙarin damar samun ingantattu da aminci da inganci na samfurin magunguna. Tasiri: Magunguna marasa inganci da ƙarya suna haifar da matsaloli da yawa ga duka mutum ɗin da ke shan maganin da kuma ga iyalai da al'umma baki ɗaya da tsarin kula da lafiya da kuma hanyoyin samarwa. Idan magunguna ba su yi aiki yadda ya kamata ba, za su iya ƙin warkarwa ko hana cuta, su ba da gudunmawa ga ƙin jin maganin ƙwayar cuta, su ɓata kayayyaki masu daraja kuma su janyo asarar ƙwarin gwiwa a cikin magunguna da rashin amincewa da masu ba da kulawar lafiya.

translations.source: This can have a negative socioeconomic impact, contributing to related loss in productivity and adding expenses to the individual and national health system. They are most likely to reach patients in situations where there is constrained access to quality and safe medical products, poor governance and weak technical capacity. Although this issue impacts all countries, countries where there are weak or non-existent regulatory systems bear the greatest burden of substandard and falsified medical products. In an increasingly globalized world, no one country has sufficient resources and capacity to deal with this issue in isolation. Through global systems and processes such as the WHO Global Surveillance and Monitoring System and WHO Member State Mechanism, Member States are working together to prevent, detect and respond to substandard and falsified medical products.
translations.reference: Wannan ka iya haifar da mummunan tasiri a kan tsarin tattalin arziki da zamantakewa, wanda shi kuma zai taimaka wajen daina samar da magungunan da ƙarin kashe kuɗin ga ɗaiɗaikun mutane da kuma tsarin lafiya na ƙasa. Wannan tasiri ka iya kaiwa ga marasa lafiya, a yayin da aka samu tarnaƙi wajen kaiwa wa ga ingantacce kuma amintaccen magani da rashin shugabanci mai nagarta da kuma rauni wajen amfani da fasaha. Kodayake wannan matsala ta shafi kafatanin ƙasashen duniya, to amma a ƙasashen da da suke da rauni ko rashin tsarin sa-ido, sun fi samun magunguna marasa inganci ko na jabu. Sakamakon yadda duniya ke ci gaba da kasancewa tamkar ɗaya, babu wata ƙasa da ke da ƙarfin tattalin arzikin da za ta tunkari wannan matsalar ita kaɗai. Ta hanyar tsare-tsare na duniya da kuma hukumomi irin su Hukumar Sa-ido ta Hukumar Llafiya ta Duniya da kuma Kwamitin Mambobin ƙasashe na Hukumar Lafiya ta Duniya, Mabobin ƙasashe na aiki kafaɗa da kafaɗa domin hana da gano da kuma ɗaukar matakai a kan magaunguna marasa inganci ko jabu.
translations.hypothesis: Wannan zai iya haifar da mummunar illa ga tattalin arziƙi da zamantakewa, wanda zai taimaka wajen samun asara a fannin samar da kaya da kuma ƙara kashe kuɗi ga ɗaiɗaikun mutane da tsarin kiwon lafiya na ƙasa. Akwai yiwuwar samun damar isa ga marasa lafiya a cikin yanayin da ake da ƙarancin damar samun ingantattun kayayyakin kiwon lafiya da rashin kulawa da kuma raunin fasaha. Duk da cewa wannan batun ya shafi dukkan ƙasashe, ƙasashen da ba su da tsarin sa ido na inganci ko kuma ba su da shi, su ne ke ɗaukar nauyin mafi girma na ƙarancin inganci da kayayyakin kiwon lafiya na ƙarya. A cikin duniya mai ƙaruwar ƙaruwa, babu wata ƙasa guda ɗaya da ke da isassun albarkatu da ƙarfi don magance wannan matsalar a waje. Ta hanyar tsare-tsare da matakai na duniya, kamar su Tsarin Sa ido da Lura na WHO da Hukumar WHO ta Mambobin Jihohi, mambobin jihohi suna aiki tare don hana, gano da kuma magance ƙarancin inganci da kayayyakin kiwon lafiya na ƙarya.

translations.source: Suicide prevention Overview: More than 700 000 people die by suicide every year. For each suicide, there are an estimated more than 20 suicide attempts. Suicide can occur at any stage of life and in all regions of the world. In 2019, suicide was the fourth leading cause of death among 15–29-year-olds globally, and 77% of all suicides happened in low- and middle-income countries. Almost 20% of global suicides were due to pesticide self-poisoning. While the link between suicide and mental health conditions (in particular, depression and alcohol use disorders) and a previous suicide attempt is well established in high-income countries, many suicides happen impulsively in moments of crisis. Further risk factors for suicide include experience of loss, loneliness, discrimination, a relationship break-up, financial problems, chronic pain and illness, violence, abuse, and conflict or other humanitarian emergencies. Stigma around mental health conditions and suicide means many people thinking about suicide do not seek help. Suicides and suicide attempts have a ripple effect that impacts on families, friends, colleagues, communities and societies.
translations.reference: Magance ƙunar-baƙin-wake/ksan-kai Sharhi: Fiye da mutane 700 000 ne suke rasa rayukansu a kowace shekara a sanadiyyar ƙunar-baƙin-wake/kisan-kai. Bisa faruwar kowane ƙunar-baƙin-wake, akwai hasashen yin ƙunar-baƙin-wake fiye da 20. ƙunar-baƙin-wake/kisank-kai kan iya aukuwa a kowane mataki na rayuwa, sannan kuma a kowane ɓangare na duniya. A 2019, ƙunar-baƙin-wake shi ne na huɗu a cikin abubuwan da suke haifar da mutuwa a tsakanin 'yan shekara 15-29 a duniya da kuma kaso 77% na ƙunar-baƙin-wake/kisan-kai na faruwa ne a tsakanin ƙasashe masu mafi qaranci da matsakaicin kuɗin shiga. Kimanin kaso 20% na ƙunar-baƙin-wake ko kisan-kai a duniya, na faruwa ne sakamakon shan guba bisa ra'in ƙashi-kai. A yayin da aka tabbatar da danganata ƙunar-baƙin-wake ko kisan-kai da yanayin matsalar ƙwaƙwalwa (Musamman damuwa da shan barasa ba tare da ƙaƙƙautawa ba) da kuma yunƙurin yin ƙunar-baƙin-wake/kisank-kai a baya a ƙasashen da yawan kuɗin shiga, inda yawan yin ƙunar-baƙin-wake ko kisan-kai ke faruwa a lokacin rigingimu. Abubuwan da ke haifar da ƙunar-baƙin-wake ko kisan-kai sun haɗa da karaya da damuwa da nuna bambanci da rabuwar wata alaƙa da matsalar kuɗi da matsanancin ciwo da cuta da keta haddi da rigingimu da sauran abubuwa da suka shafi keta haddin ɗan'adam. Matsalar yanayin hauka da na ƙunar-baƙin-wake ko kisan-kai shi ne mutane suna yin tunanin ƙunar-baƙin-wake ko kisan-kai ba neman taimako ba. ƙunar-baƙin-wake ko kisan-kai ko ƙoƙarin yin hakan yana da mummunan tasiri a kan iyalai da abokai da abokan aiki da al'umma gaba ɗaya.
translations.hypothesis: Riga-kafi me kashe kai Gamsashshen bayani: Fiye da mutane 700 000 ne ke kashe kansu a kowacce shekara. A kowanne me kashe kansa, akwai kimanin ƙoƙarin kashe kai fiye da 20. Kashe kansa na iya faruwa a kowane mataki na rayuwa da kuma a kowanne yanki na duniya. A shekarar 2019, kashe kansa shi ne babban abin da ke haddasa mutuwa a tsakanin matasa 'yan shekara 15 zuwa 29 a faɗin duniya, kuma kashi 77% na duk kashe kansa ya faru ne a ƙasashe masu ƙaranci da matsakaicin kudin shiga. Kusan kaso 20% na duk kashe kansa a duniya ya faru ne saboda amfani da maganin ƙwari. Yayin da alaƙa tsakanin kashe kansa da yanayin lafiyar ƙwaƙwalwa (musamman, damuwa da cututtukan shan giya) da ƙoƙarin kashe kai a baya ya samu inganci a ƙasashe masu karfin arziki, yawancin kashe kai suna faruwa ba tare da tsinkayen tunani ba a lokutan da ake fuskantar matsala.
