Wasu ƙarin abubuwan da ke janyo kashe kai sun haɗa da fuskantar asara, kadaici, wariya, karyewar dangantaka, matsalolin kuɗi, zafi mai tsanani da rashin lafiya, tashin hankali, cin zarafi, da rikici ko wasu lamuran da suka shafi jin dadin al'umma. Neman wariyar yanayin lafiyar ƙwaƙwalwa da kashe kai na nufin mutane da yawa da ke tunanin kashe kansa ba su nemi taimako ba. Kashe kai da ƙoƙarin kashe kai suna da tasiri wanda ke shafar iyalai, abokai, abokan aiki, al'ummomi da al'ummomi.

translations.source: Suicide: facts and figures globally Suicide worldwide in 2019 report LIVE LIFE: an implementation guide for suicide prevention in countries Prevention: Much can be done at individual, community and national levels to prevent suicide and suicide attempts. WHO’s LIVE LIFE approach recommends four effective, evidence-based key interventions which should be included in every national response to suicide: limit access to the means of suicide interact with the media for responsible reporting of suicide foster socio-emotional life skills in adolescents early identify, assess, manage and follow up anyone who is affected by suicidal behaviours. The foundational pillars of the interventions are situation analysis, multisectoral collaboration, awareness raising, capacity building, financing, surveillance, monitoring and evaluation.
translations.reference: ƙunar-baƙin-wake ko kisan-kai: Adadin faruwarsa a duniya Rahoton faruwar ƙunar-baƙin-wake ko kisan-kai a 2019 a duniya Gwagwarmayar Rayuwa: jagora wajen kawar da yin ƙunar-baƙin-wake ko kisan-kai a ƙasashe Kawarwa: Akwai matakai da dama da za a iya ɗauka a matakin ɗaiɗaikun mutane da al'umma da kuma matakin ƙasa wajen kawar da aukuwar ƙunar-baƙin-wake ko kisan-kai da kuma yunƙurin yin hakan. Hanyoyin da Hukumar Lafiya ta bayar ya kamata a yi amfani da su wajen yin maganin ƙunar-baƙin-wake ko kisan-kai a matakin kowace ƙasa, wanda ya haɗa da: hana kaiwa ga hanyoyin ƙunar-baƙin-wake ko kisan-kai mu'amala da kafafen sadarwa domin bayar da cikakken rahoto game da ƙunar-baƙin-wake ko kisan-kai koyar da dabarun jure damuwa ga matasa saurin ganowa da kimantawa da kulawa da kuma bibiyar duk wanda yake da ɗabi'un yin ƙunar-baƙin-wake ko kisan-kai . Abu muhimmi wajen daƙile wannan ta'ada shi ne bincike da haɗin gwiwar ɓangarori daban-daban da wayar da kai da bayar da horo da sa-ido a kan hada-hadar kuɗi da kulawa da kuma kimantawa.
translations.hypothesis: Kashe kai: gaskiya da alƙaluma a duniya Bakiɗaya a duniya a rahoton 2019 LIVE LIFE: jagorantar aiwatarwa don hana kashe kai a ƙasashe Riga-kafi: Za a iya yin abubuwa da yawa a matakin ɗaiɗaikun mutane, al'umma da ƙasa don hana kashe kai da ƙoƙarin kashe kai. Tsarin WHO na rayuwa da gaske ya ba da shawarar ayyuka guda huɗu masu inganci, masu tushe da aka tabbatar da su wanda ya kamata a haɗa su cikin kowane martani na ƙasa don hana kashe kai: iyakance samun damar hanyoyin kashe kai mu'amala da kafofin watsa labarai don ba da rahoton da ya dace game da kashe kai inganta ƙwarewar rayuwa ta zamantakewa da tunani ga matasa gano, kimantawa, sarrafawa da bin diddigi da kowa wanda ya kamu da halayyar kashe kai. Tushen ginshiƙan ayyukan sune nazarin yanayi, haɗin gwiwar ɓangarori da yawa, wayar da kan jama'a, ƙara ƙwarewa, ba da kuɗi, sa ido, sa ido da ƙididdige.

translations.source: Suicide prevention efforts require coordination and collaboration among multiple sectors, including health, education, labour, agriculture, business, justice, law, defence, politics and the media. Suicide prevention is often not adequately addressed because of stigma and lack of awareness that suicide is a major public health problem. Communities also play a crucial role in preventing suicide. The WHO community engagement toolkit guides communities in identifying priorities and implementing activities according to local contexts. WHO response: The urgency to act to prevent suicides has been recognized and prioritized at the highest levels. The reduction of suicide rates in countries is an indicator in the UN Sustainable Development Goals (the only indicator for mental health), WHO’s General Programme of Work and WHO’s Comprehensive Mental Health Action Plan 2013–2030. The first WHO world suicide report, Preventing suicide: a global imperative, published in 2014, aimed to increase awareness of the public health significance of suicide and suicide attempts and make suicide prevention a public health priority. Governments are encouraged to implement WHO’s LIVE LIFE package of effective and evidence-based key interventions for suicide prevention, and to develop or strengthen comprehensive national suicide prevention strategies in a multisectoral public health approach. National leadership and coordination on suicide prevention are further supported by the publication of National suicide prevention strategies: progress, examples and indicators. Recognizing that data and statistics are necessary for advocacy and decision-making, WHO published Suicide worldwide in 2019: Global Health Estimates.
translations.reference: Yunƙurin kawar da ƙunar-baƙin-wake ko kisan-kai na buƙatar haɗin-kai da haɗin gwiwa a tsakanin ɓangarori, waɗanda suka haɗa da ɓangaren lafiya da ilimi da ƙwadago da noma da kasuwanci da shari'a da doka da tsaro da siyasa da kuma kafafen watsa labarai. Ba kasafai ake kawar da ƙunar-baƙin-wake ko kisan-kai yadda ya kamata ba saboda damuwa da rashin wayar da kai, wanda shi ne babban ƙalubalen ɓangaren lafiya. Su ma al'ummomi suna da rawar da za su taka wajen kawar da ƙunar-baƙin-wake ko kisan-kai. Bayanan Hukumar Lafiya ta Duniya na yi wa al'ummomi jagoranci sun bayyana yadda al'ummomi za su gano abubuwan da suka fi muhimmanci wajen aiwatar da aiwatar da su bisa ga kowace al'umma. Bayanin Hukumar Lafiya ta Duniya: An ba wa ƙoƙarin gaggauta kawar da ƙunar-baƙin-wake ko kisan-kai matuƙar fifiko. Raguwar yawan aukuwar ƙunar-baƙin-wake ko kisan-kai a ƙasashe alama ce ta ayyukan Hukumar Ci-gaba ta Majalisar Ɗinkin Duniya (alama ce kawai a ɓabgaren lafiyar ƙwaƙwalwa) da Shirye-shiryen Ayyuka na Hukumar Lafiya ta Duniya da kuma Shirin Samar da Wadatacciyar Lafiyar ƙwaƙwalwa na 2013-2030. Rahoton Hukmar Lafiya ta Duniya a kan ƙunar-baƙin-wake ko kashe-kai na farko ya nuna cewa, kawar da ƙunar-baƙin-wake ko kashe-kai: rahoton da aka buga a 2014 da manufar ƙara wayar da kai a kan muhimmancin inganta lafiyar al'umma wajen daƙile aukuwar ƙunar-baƙin-wake ko kashe-kai ko kuma yunƙurin yin hakan da kuma da ba wa kawar da aukuwar ƙunar-baƙin-wake ko kashe-kai fifiko tamkar na kula da lafiyar al'umma. An ƙarfafar gwiyoyin gwamnatoci da su aiwatar da shirin Hukumar Lafiya na Rayuwa yadda ya kamata ta hanyar ɗaukar matakan kawar da ƙunar-baƙin-wake ko kashe-kai da kuma samar da dabarun kawar da ƙunar-baƙin-wake ko kashe-kai na ƙasa, ta hanyar dabarun kula da lafiya daban-daban. Ana ƙarfafar shugabannni da masu sa-ido a kan kawar da ƙunar-baƙin-wake ko kashe-kai ta hanyar buga rahotanni game da dabarun daƙile ƙunar-baƙin-wake ko kashe-kai, ta hanyar bayyana ci-gaban da aka samu da misalai da kuma alamomi. Sakamakon gamsuwa da muhimmancin da ke tattare da da bayanai da ƙididdiga wajen yanke shawara,Hukumar Lafiya ta Duniya ta buga rahoto aukuwar ƙunar-baƙin-wake ko kashe-kai a duniya a 2019: Hashen Lafiya na Duniya.
translations.hypothesis: Matakan hana kashe kai na buƙatar tsari da haɗin gwiwa a tsakanin ɓangarori da yawa, gami da kiwon lafiya, ilimi, aiki, noma, kasuwanci, shari'a, doka, tsaro, siyasa da kuma kafofin watsa labarai. Ana ƙalubalantar matakan hana kashe kai saboda nuna mu da rashin wayar da kai cewa kashe kai babban matsala ce ta lafiyar al'umma. Al'ummomi suma suna taka rawa wajen hana kashe kai. Tsarin shigar da al'umma na WHO yana jagorantar al'ummomi wajen gano abubuwan da suka fi muhimmanci da kuma aiwatar da ayyuka bisa yanayin da suke ciki. Amsar WHO: An gano buƙatar ɗaukar mataki don hana kashe kai kuma an ba shi fifiko a matakin koli. Rage yawan kashe kai a ƙasashe alama ce a cikin Manufofin Ci Gaba Mai Ɗorewa na Majalisar Ɗinkin Duniya (alamar lafiyar ƙwaƙwalwa), Shirin WHO na Gudanarwa da Shirin WHO na Cikakken Ayyukan Lafiyar Ƙwaƙwalwa na shekarar 2013 zuwa 2030. Rahoton farko na WHO na duniya game da kashe kai, Hana kashe kai: wani buƙatar duniya, wanda aka buga a shekarar 2014, ya yi niyyar ƙara wayar da kan al'umma game da mahimmancin kashe kai da ƙoƙarin kashe kai da kuma sanya hana kashe kai a matsayin fifiko na kiwon lafiya. An ƙarfafa gwamnatoci da su aiwatar da tsarin WHO na rayuwa da cikakken tsarin kiwon lafiya don hana kashe kai, da kuma haɓakawa ko ƙarfafa dabarun hana kashe kai na ƙasa a cikin tsarin kiwon lafiya na bai ɗaya. Jagorancin ƙasa da haɗin kai kan hana kashe kai sun sami ƙarin goyon baya ta hanyar wallafar dabarun hana kashe kai na ƙasa: ci gaba, misalai da alamomi. Sanin cewa bayanai da ƙididdiga suna da mahimmanci don bayar da shawarwari da yanke shawara, WHO ta buga kashe kai a duniya baki ɗaya a shekarar 2019: Ƙididdiga na Kiwon Lafiya na Duniya.

translations.source: WHO’s vision is a world where death by suicide is no longer a leading cause of death and where people who are attempting or thinking about suicide feel comfortable seeking help which is provided capably and respectfully to all.
translations.reference: Manufar Hukumar Lafiya ta Duniya ita ce, ya kasance ƙunar-baƙin-wake ko kashe-kai ba ya cikin abubuwan da suke sabbaba mutuwa a duniya, sannan kuma da tallafa wa waɗanda suka yi yunƙurin ƙunar-baƙin-wake ko kashe-kai.
translations.hypothesis: Manufar WHO ita ce duniya inda mutuwa ta hanyar kashe kai ba ta zama babban abin da ke haddasa mutuwa ba da inda mutanen da ke ƙoƙarin ko tunanin kashe kai ke jin daɗi wajen neman taimako wanda ake ba da kyau da gaggawa ga kowa.

translations.source: Sustainable development Overview: Sustainable development is a broad term to describe policies, projects and investments that provide benefits today without sacrificing environmental, social and personal health in the future. These policies are often described as green because they focus on limiting the impact of development on the environment. However, the benefits of sustainable development are also felt across a wide cross section of human health and well-being, including reductions in pollution- and environment-related disease, improved health outcomes and decreased stress. As the threats of climate change become increasingly important, win-win strategies for mitigation, health improvement and cost savings offer a range of advantages for various stakeholders. For example, greener health care operations can generate patient and worker health benefits while also saving energy, mitigating climate risks and creating long-term cost savings. The World Health Organization is committed to pursuing sustainable development in all its work to help protect the people of tomorrow from the health growing health risks of today. Impact: Many sustainable development strategies can offer significant wins for health, climate and the environment, and the benefits can be seen almost immediately. For example, many health and development goals can be achieved simultaneously by tackling air pollution, which is responsible for an estimated 7 million premature deaths annually. Polluting emissions include powerful short-lived climate pollutants (SLCPs)—particularly black carbon, ozone and methane—which are very harmful to health but have only brief atmospheric lifetimes.
translations.reference: Ci-gaba Mai Ɗorewa ƙarin bayani: Ci-gaba mai ɗorewa kalmomin fannu ne da ke bayyana dokoki da shirue-shirye da saka hannun jari da zai kai ga samun riba a yanzu ba tare da baddala muhalli ko tsarin zamantakewa ko lafiya a nan gaba ba. Ana bayyana waɗannan dokoki da koraye, saboda suna mayar da hankali ne wajen taƙaita tasirin ci-gaba a kan muhalli. Sai dai an amfana da ci-gaba mai ɗorewa a ko'ina a duniya, wanda ya haɗa da kowane ɓangare na lafiya da jin daɗin ɗan'adam, kama daga raguwar yawan gurɓatar yanayi da cututtuka masu nasaba da muhalli da ingantuwar lafiyar da raguwar wahalhalu. A yayin da barazanar sauyawar yanayi ke da muhimmanci, dabarun samun nasara ta kowane ɓangare wajen magancewa da inganta lafiya da rage kashe kuɗi na da matuƙar muhimmanci ga masu ruwa da tsaki. Alal misali, Shirin Lafiya na 'greener health care operations' zai samar da alfanu ga mara lafiya da ma'aikatan lafiya, da kuma rage amfani da makamashi, wanda shi kuma sauƙaƙa barazanar sauyin yanayi da kuma da kuma rage kashe kuɗi na tsawon lokaci. Hukumar Lafiya ta Duniya ta ƙudiri aniyar tabbatar da ci-gaba mai ɗorewa a duk wasu ayyuka da take aiwatarwa, domin taimakawa wajen kare mutane masu zuwa nan gaba daga barazanar lafiya da ake fuskanta a yanzu. Tasiri: Da dama daga cikin dabarun shirin ci-gaba mai ɗorewa za su matuƙar taimakawa wajen samuwar lafiya da sauyin yanayi da muhalli, sannan kuma za a ga kusan alfaninsu nan take. Alal misali, za a iya cim ma nasarar da dama daga cikin manufofin lafiya da na ci-gaba a lokaci guda, ta hanyar shawo kan matsalar gurɓatar iska, wadda ita ta yi silar kimanin mace-mace milyan 7 duk shekara. Abubuwan da suke cikin gurɓatacciyar iska sun haɗa da abubuwa masu ƙarfi da ka iya ɗumama yanayi, musamman ma kabon da ozon da kuma mesan, waɗanda suke cutar da lafiya, amma kuma ba su fiye daɗewa ba.
translations.hypothesis: Ci gaba mai ɗorewa Gamsashshen bayani: Ci gaba mai ɗorewa ma'ana ne mai faɗi da ake amfani dashi wajen bayyana manufofi da ayyuka da saka hannun jari da ke ba da fa'ida a yau ba tare da a soke muhalli da zamantakewa da lafiyar mutum a nan gaba ba. Waɗannan manufofin ana kallo su a matsayin masu kyawu saboda suna mai da hankali kan rage tasirin ci gaba ga muhalli. Duk da haka, ana kuma jin amfanin ci gaba mai ɗorewa a faɗin ɓangaren lafiya da walwalar ɗan'adam, wanda ya haɗa da rage gurɓataccen iska da cututtukan da ke da alaƙa da muhalli, da inganta sakamakon lafiya da rage damuwa. Yayin da barazanar sauyin yanayi ke ƙara zama mai mahimmanci, dabarun haɗin gwiwa don ragewa da inganta lafiya da adana kuɗi suna ba da fa'idodi iri-iri ga masu ruwa da tsaki daban-daban. Misali, ayyukan kula da lafiya masu kyau zasu iya samar da fa'idodin lafiyar marasa lafiya da ma'aikata tare da adana makamashi, rage haɗarin yanayi da samun nasarar rage farashi na dogon lokaci. Hukumar Lafiya ta Duniya ta himmatu wajen ci gaba da samar da ci gaba mai ɗorewa a dukkan ayyukanta don taimakawa wajen kare mutanen gobe daga haɗurran lafiya da ke ƙaruwa a yau. Tasiri: Dabarun ci gaba mai ɗorewa da yawa na iya ba da gagarumin nasara ga lafiya da yanayi da muhalli, kuma za a iya ganin amfanin kusan nan da nan. Misali, za a iya cimma manufofin kiwon lafiya da ci gaba da yawa a lokaci guda ta hanyar magance gurbacewar iska, wanda ke da alhakin mutuwar kusan mutane miliyan 7 da ba a lokacin ba a kowace shekara. Gurɓataccen hayaƙi sun haɗa da ƙarfin gajeren zama mai gurbacewar yanayi (SLCPs) - musamman garin baƙin fata da ozoni da methane - wanda suna da haɗari ga lafiya amma suna da ɗan gajeren rayuwar yanayi.

translations.source: Transport policies and investments that favour clean public transport, along with walking and cycling, can have a dramatic impact on air quality. This can reduce multiple health risks at the same time, including stroke, heart attack, lung disease and some cancers. They can also reduce the estimated 1.25 million deaths annually from traffic injury, while also improving access to health services, particularly in densely populated areas. Sustainable development housing policies can further reduce emissions through considerations such as building siting and land use, choices of construction materials, design features and ventilation and energy. WHO response: WHO’s work is guided by the Sustainable Development Goals, particularly Goal 3: “Ensure healthy lives and promote well-being for all at all ages.” The Goals inform projects and policies across the Organization, including guidelines on housing, urban development, transportation systems and health care delivery. For example, the WHO Housing and health guidelines, first published in 2018, highlight the increasing impact of housing conditions on human health in light of urban growth, climate and demographic changes. The guidelines provide Member States, partners and the public with evidence-based recommendations relevant to inadequate living space (crowding), low and high indoor temperatures, injury hazards in the home, and accessibility of housing for people with functional impairments. The Urban Health Initiative (UHI) also focuses on ways for cities to enable good health by catalysing effective action on urban air pollution and short-lived climate pollutants (SLCPs)—saving lives by linking health, environment and sustainable development. WHO also collaborates with the Climate and Clean Air Coalition (CCAC) on the Breathe Life campaign, which aims to cut air pollution and reduce the 7 million premature deaths annually that it causes.
translations.reference: Dokokin sufuri da zuba hannun jarin da ka iya tsaftace hanyoyin sufurin jama'a da kuma tafiyar ƙasa da tuƙa keke na da matuƙar tasiri a kan ingancin iska. Wannan zai taƙaita barazana iri-iri ga lafiya, wanda ya haɗa da shayenwar ɓarin jiki da ciwon zuciya da cututtukan hunhu da kuma kansa. Haka kuma za su iya rage kimanin mace-mace miliyan 1.25 sanadiyyar samun rauni a duk shekara, yayin da kuma za su inganta kaiwa ga kula da lafiya, musamman a wuraren da suke da yawan jama'a. Dokokin Shirin Ci-gaba Mai Ɗorewa na samar da gidaje zai ƙara rage ƙura ta hanyar gine-gine da amfani da filaye da zaɓar kayan gini da tsari da kuma samar da gine-gine na yalwar iska da kuma makamashi. Matakin Hukumar Lafiya ta Duniya: Aikace-aikacen Hukumar Lafiya ta Duniya na tafiya ne bisa manufar Shirin Ci-gaba Mai Ɗorewa, musamman ma manufar ta 3: '' Tabbatar da lafiyar mutane da ƙaruwar walwalar kowa da kowa''. Manufofin na shelanta shiye-shirye da dokoki a hukumar, waɗanda suka haɗa da dokokin gina gidaje da gina birane da tsarin sufuri da samar da kulawa da lafiya. Alal misali, dokokin gina gidaje da kula lafiya na Hukumar Lafiya ta Duniya da aka fara bugawa a 2018, sun yi ƙarin haske a kan ƙaruwar tasirin yanayin gidaje a kan lafiyar mutum a yayin da birane suka bunƙasa, inda sauyin yanayi da yawan jama'a ke sauyawa. Dokokin sun ba wa mambobin ƙasashe da abokan hulɗa da sauran jama'a shawarwari da ke da nasaba da cunkoso da haɗarin cikin gida da kuma samar da gidaje ga mutanen da ke da tawaya. Shi ma Shirin Lafiya a Birane ya mayar da hanakali ne wajen samar da cikakkiyar lafiya a birane, ta hanyar gaggauta ɗaukar matakai a kan guɓacewar iska a birane da kuma abubuwan da ke haifar da ɗumamar yanayi, domin ceto rayuka masu matsalar lafiya da muhalli da ci-gaba mai ɗorewa. Haka kuma Hukumar Lafiya ta yi haɗin gwiwa da Gamayyar ƙungiyar Kula da Sauyin Yanayi da Iska Mai kyau wajen wayar da kai a kan sheƙar numfashi domin rayuwa, wanda manufarsa ita ce kawo ƙarshen gurɓacewar iska da rage mace-macen mutane miliyan 7 da ke haifarwa a duk shekara.
translations.hypothesis: Manufofin sufuri da saka hannun jari da ke ba da fifiko ga tsabtataccen sufuri na jama'a, tare da yin tafiya a ƙafa da keke, na iya haifar da tasiri mai ban mamaki kan ingancin iska. Wannan na iya rage haɗarin kamuwa da cututtuka da yawa a lokaci guda, gami da bugun jini, ciwon zuciya, cututtukan huhu da wasu ciwukan daji. Hakanan suna rage kimanin mutuwar mutane miliyan 1.25 a kowace shekara daga ciwukan ababan hawa, tare da inganta samun damar ayyukan kiwon lafiya, musamman a wuraren da yawan mutane ke zama. Manufofin ci gaba mai dorewa na manufofin gidaje na iya rage fitar da hayaƙi ta hanyar la'akari da abubuwa irin su wurin gina gidaje da amfani da ƙasa, zaɓin kayan gine-gine, fasalin ƙira da iska da makamashi. Amsar WHO: Aikin WHO yana jagorantar Manufofin Ci Gaba Mai Durewa, musamman Manufar 3: "Tabbatar da lafiyayyun rayuka da inganta walwala ga kowa a kowanne lokaci." Manufofin sun sanar da ayyuka da manufofin ƙungiyar, gami da ƙa'idoji kan gidaje, ci gaban birane, tsarin sufuri da isar da kiwon lafiya. Misali, ƙa'idojin gidaje da lafiya na WHO, wanda aka buga na farko a cikin 2018, sun nuna yadda yanayin gidaje ke kara tasiri ga lafiyar ɗan adam bisa la'akari da ci gaban birane, yanayi da sauyin yawan al'umma. Dokokin sun ba wa ƙasashe mambobi, abokanan hulɗa da jama'a shawarwari masu tushe masu dacewa ga ƙarancin wurin zama (cunkoso), ƙanƙara da zafi sosai a cikin gida, haɗarin ciwuka a cikin gida, da samun gidaje ga mutanen da ke da nakasassu. Shirin inganta lafiyar birane (UHI) shi ma ya mayar da hankali kan hanyoyin da birane za su iya samar da lafiya ta hanyar haɓaka ingantaccen aiki kan gurɓataccen iska da ƙanƙarar yanayi mai gajeren zama (SLCPs) - ceton rayuka ta hanyar haɗa lafiya, muhalli da ci gaba mai dorewa. WHO kuma ta haɗa kai da Ƙungiyar Yanayi da Iska Mai Kyau (CCAC) kan gangamin Breathe Life, wanda ke da manufar rage gurɓataccen iska da rage mutuwar gaggawa miliyan 7 da ke faruwa a kowace shekara da ke haddasawa.

translations.source: Syphilis Overview: Syphilis is a bacterial sexually transmitted infection (STI) caused by Treponema pallidum which results in substantial morbidity and mortality, and it is curable. Syphilis is transmitted through sexual contact with the infectious lesions, via blood transfusion or from a pregnant woman to her fetus. Mother-to-child transmission of syphilis is usually devastating to the fetus in cases that were not detected or treated sufficiently early in pregnancy. Maternal syphilis, when untreated, treated late or not treated with penicillin, results in adverse birth outcomes (ABOs) estimated in 50−80% of cases, depending on the stage of syphilis. These ABOs are often severe and include stillbirth (most commonly), neonatal death, prematurity, low birth weight, and congenitally infected infants. Syphilis can be prevented through safer sex practices including the correct and consistent use of condoms. Many people with syphilis do not have any symptoms or have only minor symptoms that go unnoticed. Identifying infection through laboratory tests and treatment of positive cases will prevent further transmission and adverse pregnancy outcomes including congenital syphilis. Screening can be done using rapid tests that can provide results in less than 20 minutes, allowing for immediate treatment.
translations.reference: Tinjere ƙarin bayani: Tinjere cuta ce da ake ɗauka yayin saduwar namiji da mace sakamakon ƙwayar cuta, wadda ke haifar da rashin lafiya da kuma mutuwa, amma ana iya warkewa. Tinjere cuta ce da ke yaxuwa a yayin jima'i, inda ake ɗaukar cuta kuma take yaɗuwa ko dai ta hanyar jin ko kuma daga uwa mai ciki zuwa jaririn da ke cikinta. Yaɗuwar cutar tinjere daga uwa zuwa jariri yawanci yana kassara jaririn, musamman idan ba a gano ba ko kuma an ɗauki mataki a farkon juna-biyun. Idan ba a yi maganin yaɗuwar tinjere daga uwa zuwa jariri ko ba a yi magani da wuri ba ko ma ba a yi maganinta da fenisilin, tana haifar da matsala yayin haihuwa da kimanin kaso 50-80, ya danganta da matakin cutar ta tinjere. Wannan sakamako yawanci yakan tsananta, sannan kuma ya haɗa da jariran da ke mutuwa yayin haihuwa (wanda ya fi yawa) da mutuwa bayan haihuwa da kafin balaga da rashin nauyin jariri da kuma jariran da suka ɗauki cuta daga uwa. Za a iya maganin cutar tinjere ta hanyar yin taka-tsantsan wajen yin jima'i, wanda ya haɗa da yawan yin amfani da kwaroron roba. Mutane da dama da suka kamu da cutar tinjere ba su ganin wasu alamu. Tabbatar da cuta ta hanyar yin gwaji da kuma yin magana zai hana yaɗuwarta da kuma haifar da matsala a yayin haihuwa, wanda ya haɗa da nau'in tinjere da jariri ke ɗauka daga uwa. Za a iya tabbatarwa ta hanyar yawaita yin gwaje-gwaje da za su bayar da sakamako a ƙasa da minti 20, domin yin magani nan take.
translations.hypothesis: Cutar ƙanjamau Gamsashshen bayani: Cutar ƙanjamau wata cuta ce da take yaɗuwa ta hanyar jima'i wacce ke yaɗuwa ta hanyar (STI) wacce ke yaɗuwa ta hanyar Treponema pallidum wanda ke haifar da matsalolin cututtuka da mace-mace, kuma tana warkewa. Ana kamuwa da cutar ƙanjamau ta hanyar jima'i tare da raunuka masu yaɗa cutar, ta hanyar ƙarin jini ko daga mai juna biyu zuwa jaririnsa. Yaɗa cutar ƙanjamau daga uwa zuwa ɗa yawanci na da illa ga tayi a lokutan da ba a gano ba ko ba a yi maganin da isasshen sauri ba a lokacin ɗaukar ciki. Cutar ƙanjamau ta uwa, idan ba a yi maganin ba, ko a yi maganin sa da wuri ko ba a yi maganin sa da penicillin ba, yana haifar da munanan sakamako na haihuwa (ABOs) wanda aka kiyasta a cikin kashi 50-80% na lokuta, ya dogara ga matakin cutar ƙanjamau. Waɗannan ABOs yawanci suna da tsananin matsi kuma sun haɗa da haifar jariri (manya mafi yawan lokuta), mutuwar jariri, haifar jariri kafin lokaci, ƙarancin nauyin haihuwa, da jarirai da suka kamu da cuta tun lokacin haihuwa. Za a iya hana kamuwa da cutar ƙanjamau ta hanyar amfani da hanyoyin jima'i masu aminci wanda ya haɗa da amfani da kwaroron roba yadda ya dace da kuma daidaito. Mutane da yawa da ke fama da cutar ƙanjamau ba su da wani alama ko kuma suna da ɗan ƙaramin alamar da ba a taɓa ganin ba. Gano kamuwa da cuta ta hanyar gwaje-gwajen ɗakin gwaje-gwaje da kuma magance masu kamuwa da cutar zai hana yaɗa cutar da munanan sakamako na juna biyu wanda ya haɗa da cutar ƙanjamau. Za a iya yin gwajin ta hanyar amfani da gwaje-gwaje masu sauri wanda zai iya ba da sakamako a cikin ƙasa da mintuna 20, wanda ke ba da damar yin magani nan take.

translations.source: When untreated, syphilis lasts many years and goes through different stages. Treatment for syphilis is done with injectable penicillin benzathine, with 1 to 3 doses depending on the stage of the disease. Only penicillin can prevent congenital syphilis. Treatment with penicillin has been hampered by periodic and prolonged shortages of benzathine penicillin in numerous countries, including high-, low- and middle-income countries. Symptoms: Many people with syphilis do not present symptoms or do not perceive them. Untreated, syphilis lasts many years and is characterized into different stages. Sexual transmission typically occurs during early stages, i.e., up to 2 years after infection. During the initial phase (primary syphilis), which lasts on average 21 days, a solitary, painless, usually hard and round sore (chancre) appears at the site of inoculation (contact), often in the vagina, penis or anus (but it may also be extra-genital) and may go unnoticed. The chancre heals with or without treatment within 3 to 10 weeks. If untreated, the disease progresses to the secondary stage.
translations.reference: Ida ba a ɗauKi mataki, tinjere kan ɗauki shekaru a jikin mutum, ta hanyar kaiwa matakai daban-daban. Ana maganin cutar tinjere ta hanyar yin allurar fenicilin sau 1 zuwa 3, ya danganta da matakin cutar. Fenicilin ne kawai yake maganin tinjeren da ake ɗauka daga uwa zuwa yaro. Yin magani da fenicilin ya samu tsaiko sakamakon rashin fenicilin benzatayin na tsawon lokaci a ƙasashe da dama, waɗanda suka haɗa da ƙasashe masu yawa da ƙaranci da matsakaicin kuɗin shiga. Alamomi: Mutane da dama da ke fama da cutar tinjere ba su ganin wasu alamomi. Cutar tinjeren da ba yi mata magani ba takan ɗauki shekaru a jikin mutum, inda take xaukar matakai daban-daban. Cutar tana yaxuwa ta hanyar jima'i a mataki farko, wato kusan shekar 2 bayan kawuwa da cutar. A matakin farko, wanda yake ɗaukar kwana 21, inda ita kaɗai kuma mara zafi, wurin kan kawashe yawanci a farji ko zakari ko kuma takashi (ko kuma gaba ɗaya), sannan kuma za a iya kasa gane ta. Ciwon ka iya warkewa ba tare da magani ba a cikin mako 2 zuwa 10. Idan ba a yi magani ba, cutar kan ƙara gaba zuwa wani mataki.
translations.hypothesis: Idan ba ai magani ba, cutar sifilis tana ɗaukar shekaru da dama sannan tana wucewa ta matakai daban-daban. Ana yin maganin cutar sifilis da allurar penicillin benzathine, tare da karɓar magani sau 1 zuwa 3 ya danganta da matakin da cutar ta kai. Penicillin kaɗai ne zai iya hana kamuwa da sifilis a lokacin ɗaukar ciki. An hana maganin cutar sifilis da penicillin sakamakon ƙarancin maganin benzathine penicillin a wasu lokutan da kuma tsawon lokaci a ƙasashe da dama, wanda suka haɗa da ƙasashe masu ƙaranci da matsakaicin da kuma masu yawan kuɗin shiga. Alamomi: Da yawan mutanen da ke fama da sifilis ba sa nuna alamun cutar ko kuma ba sa fahimtar su. Ba ai magani ba, sifilis tana ɗaukar shekaru da yawa kuma tana da yanayi daban-daban. Yaɗa cutar ta hanyar jima'i yawanci yana faruwa ne a farkon matakan, wato har zuwa shekaru 2 bayan kamuwa da cutar. A farkon matakin (sifilis na farko), wanda ke ɗaukar kusan kwanaki 21, wani ciwo mai rauni, ba shi da raɗaɗi, yawanci mai ƙaurin gaske da kuma zagayen ciwo (chancre) yana bayyana a wurin da aka shafa (ta hanyar mu'amala), yawanci a cikin mahaifa, mazakuta ko anal (amma zai iya kuma zama a wajen mahaifa) kuma zai iya zama ba a gano ba. Ciwon chancre na warkewa ne tare da ko ba tare da magani ba a cikin satika 3 zuwa 10. Idan ba ai magani ba, cutar na ci gaba zuwa mataki na biyu.

translations.source: Secondary syphilis is characterized by a rash that can vary widely and mimic other infectious or non-infectious conditions, but characteristically affects the palms and soles. The rash is non-itchy and can be minimal enough to be overlooked. In warm and moist areas of the body, such as the anus and labia, large white or grey raised lesions may develop at the location of the primary chancre (condyloma lata). The symptoms and signs of secondary syphilis spontaneously resolve, even without treatment. Without treatment, the latent stage starts. Latent syphilis presents no clinical symptoms or signs and the treatment is different from the early phase. After years or decades without treatment, neurological and cardiovascular diseases among others may occur. Treatment: Syphilis diagnosis is based on the person’s history, physical examination, laboratory testing and sometimes radiology, as symptoms are not common or noticeable. Identifying asymptomatic infection through laboratory tests and treatment of positive cases will prevent further transmission and adverse pregnancy outcomes, including congenital syphilis. Laboratory tests for syphilis include direct detection of T. pallidum or indirect methods such as serology.
translations.reference: Cutar tinjere nau'i na biyu na siffantauwa ne da fitowar ƙuraje, waɗanda suka bambanta, sannan su haifar da cututtuka masu yaɗuwa ko marasa yaɗuwa, amma yawanci suna shafar tafin hannu da na ƙafa. ƙurajen ba masu ƙaƙayi ba ne, inda za a iya watsi da su. A sassan jikin da suke da lema ko danshi kamar takashi da leɓe, wani farin abu ko ruwan ƙasa kan fito a wurin da ciwon asali yake. Alamomin nau'in tinjere na biyu kan iya ɓacewa, ba tare da magani ba. Idan ba a ɗauki mataki ba, yanayin iya ci gaba. Irin wannan yanayi na cutar tinjere ba shi da wasu alamomi, sannan maganinsa ya bambanta da na lokacin da ya fara. Idan aka ɗauki shekaru ba tare da yin magani ba, yakan haifar da matsalar ƙwaƙwalwa da shanyewar ɓarin jiki da sauransu. Magani: Maganin cutar tinjere ya danganta ne da tarihin mutum da kallon sa a zahiri da gwaji da kuma ɗaukar hoto a wasu lokutan, domin kuwa alamomin ba ɗaya ba ne ko muma ba a gane su. Gano cuta ta hanyar gwaji da kuma yin magani zai hana yaɗuwar cutar da kuma haifar da mutuwar jariri a yayin haihuwa, wanda ya haɗa da nau'in tinjeren da ake ɗauka a yayin haihuwa. Gwajin cutar tinjere ya qunshi gano wurin kai-tsaye ko kuma ta hanyar kaikaice, wadda ta haɗa da ɗaukar jini.
translations.hypothesis: Sanin cutar sifilis na biyu ana gane shi ne ta hanyar ƙuraje da zasu iya bambanta da kuma zama kamar wasu cututtukan masu yaɗuwa ko ma waɗanda ba masu yaɗuwa ba, amma yawanci yana shafar ƙirji da ƙafa. Ƙurajen ba sa da ƙaiƙayi sannan za su iya zama kaɗan da za a iya kauce musu. A wuraren da ke da zafi da danshi a jiki, kamar anal da labia, ƙuraje masu yawa fari ko masu duf da za su iya bayyana a inda yake farawar cutar (condyloma lata). Alamomi da kuma sanadin cutar sifilis na biyu zasu iya warkewa da kansu, ko ba tare da magani ba. Ba tare da magani ba, matakin da ke boyu zai fara. Cutar sifilis da ke boye ba ta da alamun cutar sannan maganin ta ya bambanta da na matakin farko. Bayan shekaru ko shekaru da yawa ba tare da magani ba, cututtukan da suka shafi ƙwaƙwalwa da zuciya da wasu ma za su iya faruwa. Magani: Gano cutar sifilis ya dogara ne a kan tarihin mutum, binciken jiki, gwajin ɗakin gwaje-gwaje da kuma wasu lokutan radiyoloji, saboda alamun cutar ba su da yawa ko a bayyane. Gano cutar sifilis ta hanyar gwaje-gwajen ɗakin gwaje-gwaje da kuma magance masu cutar zai hana yaɗuwar cutar da kuma sakamako mai muni na ɗaukar ciki, wanda ya haɗa da sifilis da ake haifar da jariri da shi. Gwaje-gwajen ɗakin gwaje-gwaje don sifilis sun haɗa da gano T. pallidum kai tsaye ko hanyoyi marasa kai tsaye kamar serology.

translations.source: Rapid screening and diagnostic tests are also available and can provide results in less than 20 minutes, facilitating immediate treatment initiation. WHO recommends syphilis to be treated with injectable penicillin (benzathine penicillin G) with 1 or 3 doses, depending on the stage of the disease. WHO has detailed treatment guidelines for syphilis, and one specifically for the screening and treatment of syphilis in pregnancy. Congenital syphilis There are currently no diagnostic tests for congenital syphilis. All live or stillborn infants of women with syphilis should be examined for evidence of congenital syphilis. Live-born infants should be examined and tested at birth to define treatment requirement. When indicated, also at monthly intervals for 3 months until the infant’s serology are, and remain, negative, as maternal antibodies can be passively transmitted to the baby during pregnancy.
translations.reference: Yawan dubawa da kuma gwaji shi ma ka iya ba da sakamako a ƙasa da minti 20, wanda hakan kan taimaka wajen yin magani nan take a farkon cutar. Hukumar Lafiya ta Duniya ta amince da yin maganin tinjere ta amfani da allurar fenicilin, ta hanyar yin allura biyu zuwa 3, ya danganta da matakin cutar. Hukumar Lafiya ta Duniya ta ƙarin bayani game da matakan magance cutar tinjere, inda ta fayyace wanda za a duba da kuma maganin tinjere a yayin da ake da juna biyu. Cutar tinjeren da ake ɗauka yayin haihuwa A yanzu babu wani gwaji na cutar tinjere da ake ɗauka a yayin haihuwa. Duk rayayyun jarirai da waɗanda suka mutu yayin haihuwa sakamakon cutar tinjere ya kamata duba su ko suna da cutar da ake ɗauka yayin haihuwa. Ya kamata a duba tare da gwajin jariran da suke raye a yayin da aka haife su domin fayyace irin maganin da suke buƙata. A yayin da aka tabbatar da cutar, ya kamata duk bayan wata 3 a riƙa ɗaukar jini , sannan a uwar za ta ci gaba da shan magunguna a lokacin da take da juna har sai cutar ta tafi.
translations.hypothesis: Ana samun gwaje-gwajen gano cutar cikin sauri, kuma suna ba da sakamako a cikin ƙasa da mintuna 20, wanda ke sauƙaƙe farawar jiyya da wuri. Hukumar Lafiya ta Duniya ta ba da shawarar yin maganin cutar mai kama zuciya da allurar penicillin (benzathine penicillin G) sau 1 ko 3, ya danganta da matakin da cutar ta kai. Hukumar Lafiya ta Duniya ta samar da cikakkun ƙa'idojin magani na cutar mai kama zuciya, kuma ɗaya na musamman don gwaje-gwaje da magance cutar mai kama zuciya a lokacin ɗaukar ciki. Cutar mai kama zuciya da ake ɗauka lokacin ɗaukar ciki A halin yanzu babu gwaje-gwajen gano cutar mai kama zuciya da ake ɗauka lokacin ɗaukar ciki. Duk jarirai da suka haifa ko kuma suka mutu lokacin haihuwa na mata masu fama da cutar mai kama zuciya ya kamata a duba su don gano alamun cutar mai kama zuciya da ake ɗauka lokacin ɗaukar ciki. Ya kamata a duba jarirai da aka haifa kuma a gwada su lokacin haihuwa don fayyace buƙatar jiyya. Idan ya kamata, kuma a tsakanin watanni uku har sai gwajin jinin jaririn ya nuna babu cutar, yayin da jikin uwa ke iya yaɗa cutar ga jariri a lokacin ɗaukar ciki.

translations.source: Taeniasis and cysticercosis Overview: Infection with the tapeworm Taenia solium can result in two distinct conditions: taeniasis and cysticercosis. Taeniasis is the intestinal infection with the tapeworm and it occurs when a person eats raw or undercooked, infected pork. Taeniasis has no major impact on human health. However, tapeworm eggs pass in the faeces of the tapeworm carrier and in the absence of a proper sanitation may contaminate the environment. While tapeworm eggs are infective for pigs, T. solium eggs may also infect humans if they are ingested by a person (via the fecal-oral route, or by ingesting contaminated food or water). Ingestion of tapeworm eggs causes infection with the larval parasite in the tissues such as muscles, skin, eyes and the central nervous system (human cysticercosis), with possible devastating effects on health. When cysts develop in the brain, the condition is referred to as neurocysticercosis. Symptoms: Taeniasis is usually characterized by mild and non-specific symptoms associated to an intestinal infection (abdominal pain, nausea, diarrhoea, etc.). These symptoms may continue until the tapeworm dies following treatment, otherwise it may live for years.
translations.reference: Cutar dauɗar ciki da ta cushewar ciki ƙarin bayani: cutar dauɗar ciki na samuwa ne sakamakon abubuwa guda biyu mabambanta: cushewar ciki da cushewar hanji. Cushewar hanji cuta ce ta dauɗar ciki, wadda take samuwa a laokacin da mutum ya ci zallar naman alade ko wanda ba a dafa ko kuma naman aladen da ke da cuta. Cutar cushewar ciki ba ta da wani tasiri a kan lafiya. Sai dai kashin mai dauɗar ciki wanda ba a tsafatace ba ka iya gurɓata muhalli. A yayin da ƙwayaƙwan mcijin ciki ba sa yi wa alade komai, T. solium eggs ka iya illata ɗan'adam, idan mutum bai haɗiyu ba ( ta hanyar baki ko gurɓataccen abinci ko ruwan sha). Rashin narkewar tsutsar jiki na haifar da cuta, inda za samu a cuta a sassan jiki kamar tsokar jiki da fata da idanu da kuma ƙwaƙwalwa, wanda hakan ka iya cutar da lafiya. A yayin da aka samu kumburi a ƙwaƙwalwa, ana kiran wannan yanayi da kumburin ƙwaƙwalwa,. Alamomi: Dauɗar ciki yawanci tana siffantuwa ne da rashin wasu tsayayyun alamomi waɗanda za a iya dangantawa da cutar hanji (ciwon ciki da jin amai da gudawa da sauransu). Waɗannan alamomi za su iya ci gaba har sai tsutsar ta mutu sakamakon shan magani, ko kuma ta ci gaba da rayuwa tsawon shekaru.
translations.hypothesis: Tsutsar 'yar tsagewar ciki da tsutsar 'cutar da ke haifar da 'yar tsagewar ciki Gamsashshen bayani: Kamuwa da tsutsar 'yar tsagewar ciki Taenia solium na iya haifar da yanayi guda biyu daban-daban: taeniasis da cysticercosis. Taeniasis cuta ce ta hanji da tsutsar 'yar tsagewar ciki sannan tana faruwa ne yayin da mutum ya ci naman aladai da ba a dafa sosai, wanda yake ɗauke da cutar. Taeniasis ba ta da wani babban tasiri ga lafiyar mutane. Duk da haka, ƙwai tsutsar 'yar tsagewar ciki na fita ne a bayan mai ɗauke da tsutsar 'yar tsagewar ciki sannan idan babu tsafta mai kyau zai gurɓata muhalli. Yayin da ƙwai ke kamuwa da tsutsar 'yar tsagewar ciki, ƙwai T. solium na iya kuma sa mutane su kamu idan mutum ya sha (ta hanyar hanyar najasa-baki, ko ta hanyar ci ko shan abinci ko ruwan da ke ɗauke da ƙwai). Ciwar ƙwai tsutsar 'yar tsagewar ciki na haifar da kamuwa da cuta tare da 'yar tsutsar a cikin naman mutum kamar tsoka, fata, idanu da kuma tsarin juyayi (cysticercosis na ɗan'adam), tare da illoli ga lafiya. Idan tsutsotsi suka girma a ƙwaƙwalwa, yanayin ana kiran sa da neurocysticercosis. Alamomi: Taeniasis yawanci ana siffanta ta da alamomi masu sauƙi da ba na musamman ba waɗanda suke da alaƙa da cututtukan ciki (ciwon ciki, tashin zuciya, gudawa da sauransu). Waɗannan alamomin na iya ci gaba har sai tsutsar ta mutu bayan yin magani, in ba haka ba zata iya rayuwa tsawon shekaru.

translations.source: For cysticercosis, the incubation period is variable, and infected people may remain asymptomatic for years. In some endemic regions, infected people may develop visible or palpable nodules (a small solid bump or node which is solid that can be detected by touch) beneath the skin. Neurocysticercosis is associated with a variety of signs and symptoms depending on the number, size, stage and location of the pathological changes as well as the host’s immune response and the parasite’s genotype, but it can also be clinically asymptomatic. Symptoms may include chronic headaches, blindness, seizures (epilepsy if they are recurrent), hydrocephalus, meningitis, dementia and symptoms caused by lesions occupying spaces of the central nervous system. Treatment: The treatment of taeniasis by Taenia solium is important to prevent neurocysticercosis and as a tool to assist in controlling or stopping the parasite transmission cycle. The treatment can be done on an individual bases, or as Mass Drug Administration depending on the local circumstances and the control approaches being implemented. Taeniasis can be treated using anthelmintics (Praziquantel, Niclosamide, Albendazole). In neurocysticercosis, since the destruction of cysts may lead to an inflammatory response, specialised treatment of active disease is required and may include long courses with high doses of anthelmintic, as well as supporting therapy with corticosteroids and/or anti-epileptic drugs, and possibly surgery. The dosage and the duration of treatment can vary greatly and depend mainly on the number, size, location and developmental stage of the cysts, their surrounding inflammatory edema, acuteness and severity of clinical symptoms or signs.
translations.reference: Game da cutar cushewar ciki, lokacin yin ƙyanƙyansa kan bambanta, sannan kuma masu fama da matsalar za su ci gaba da kasancewa ba tare da wata alama ba tsawon shekaru. A wasu wuraren da suka fama da annoba, waɗanda suka kamu ka iya siffantuwa da wasu abubuwa da za a iya gani (abun da za iya taɓawa) a ƙasan fata. Kumburin ƙwaƙwalwa na bayyan ne da alamomi iri-iri, ya danganta ga da adadi da girma da mataki da kuma wurin da cutar ta fito da kuma yadda garkuwar jiki ta bayar da kariya da ƙwayar halittar mai cutar, sai dai za ta iya kasancewa ba ta nuna wata alama ba. Alamomin wannan cuta za su iya kasncewa matsanancin ciwo kai da makanta da farfaɗiya da taruwar ruwa a ƙwaƙwalwa da zazzaɓi da cutar mantuwa da kum sauran alamomin da raunin ya fito a ƙwaƙwalwa ya haifar. Magani: Maganin dauɗar ciki na da muhimmanci wajen hana aukuwar cutar kumburi da jan ruwan ƙwaƙwalwa a matasayin wata hanya ta hana ko tsakayar da hana yaɗuwar ƙwayoyin cuta. Za a iya yin magani dangane da yanayin mutane daban-daban ko ta yawan shan magani bisa ga yanayi wuri da kuma hanyar dakatar da yaɗuwar cutar da ka yi amfani da ita. za a iya maganin cutar dauɗar ciki ta hanyar amfani da maganin macijin ciki. Game da matsalar kumburi da jan ruwan ƙwaƙwalwa, fashewar ruwan kan iya yi zafi, ana buƙatar magani cuta na musamman, wanda ka iya ɗaukar matakai masu tsayi da kuma shan maganin macijin ciki ko allura mai yawa da kuma sauran magungunan farfaɗiya da kuma yuwuwar yin aiki. Yawan magani da tsawon lokacin da za a ɗauka ana sha ya danganta da adadi da girma da wuri da kuma matakin kumburin da zafin kumburin da tsininsa da tsananinsa da kuma alamominsa.
translations.hypothesis: Ga cutar cysticercosis, lokacin da cutar ke ɓuya a jikin mutum yana da sauyi, sannan mutanen da suka kamu da cutar za su iya kasancewa ba su da alamonin cutar na tsawon shekaru. A wasu yankunan da suke fama da cutar, mutanen da suka kamu da cutar za su iya samun gano ko taɓa ƙuraje (ƙaramin abu mai ƙarfi ko ƙuraje da ake iya gano ta hanyar taɓa shi) a ƙarƙashin fata. Neurocysticercosis yana da alaƙa da nau'ikan alamomi da alamun cuta da yawa da suka dogara ga adadi, girma, mataki da wurin canje-canjen cutar da kuma martanin rigakafin mai karɓar baƙi da nau'in halittar tsutsar, amma kuma yana iya zama ba tare da alamun cuta ba. Alamun cutar na iya haɗawa da ciwon kai mai tsanani, makanta, farfaɗiya (farfaɗiya idan sun sake dawowa), hydrocephalus, meningitis, dementia da alamun da raunuka ke haifarwa da ke mamaye wuraren tsarin juyayi. Magani: Magance taeniasis ta hanyar Taenia solium yana da mahimmanci don hana neurocysticercosis da kuma a matsayin kayan aiki don taimakawa wajen sarrafa ko dakatar da tsarin yaɗa tsutsar. Za a iya yin maganin a matakin mutum ɗaya, ko a matsayin Ba da Magunguna a Matakin Al'umma ya danganta da yanayin da ke akwai da kuma hanyoyin sarrafawa da ake aiwatarwa. Za a iya magance taeniasis ta hanyar amfani da maganin tsutsar (Praziquantel, Niclosamide, Albendazole). A cikin neurocysticercosis, tunda lalacewar tsutsotsi na iya haifar da martani mai raɗaɗi, ana buƙatar ƙarin magani na cutar da ke aiki da kuma wanda ya haɗa da dogon lokaci tare da manyan adadin maganin tsutsar, da kuma taimakawa wajen warkarwa tare da corticosteroids da /ko magungunan anti-epileptic, da kuma yiwuwar tiyata. Adadin da tsawon lokacin yin maganin zai iya bambanta sosai kuma ya dogara ne da yawa akan adadi, girma, wurin da matakin ci gaba na tsutsotsin, da kuma kumburin da ke kewaye da su, da tsananin yanayin da alamun cutar ke nunu.

translations.source: Tetanus Overview: Tetanus is a serious illness contracted through exposure to the spores of the bacterium, Clostridium tetani, which live in soil, saliva, dust and manure. The bacteria can enter the body through a deep cuts, wounds or burns affecting the nervous system. The infection leads to painful muscle contractions, particularly of the jaw and neck muscle, and is commonly known as “lockjaw”. People of all ages can get tetanus but the disease is particularly common and serious in newborn babies and their mothers when the mother is unprotected from tetanus by the vaccine, tetanus toxoid. Tetanus occurring during pregnancy or within 6 weeks of the end of pregnancy is called maternal tetanus, while tetanus occurring within the first 28 days of life is called neonatal tetanus. The disease remains an important public health problem in many parts of the world, but especially in low-income countries or districts, where immunization coverage is low and unclean birth practices are common. WHO estimates that in 2018 (the latest year for which estimates are available), 25 000 newborns died from neonatal tetanus, 88% reduction from the situation in 2000. Symptoms: Nearly all cases of tetanus occur in people who have never been vaccinated or in adults who have not kept up to date on their booster shots. Signs and symptoms of tetanus appear anytime from 3 to 21 days after tetanus bacteria enter the body through a wound.
translations.reference: Cutar tetanos ƙarin bayan: Ttetanos babbar cuta ce da ake ɗauka daga wasu ƙwayoyin halitta da ke rayuwa a cikin ƙasa da yawu da kuma taki. ƙwayar halittar na shiga jikin mutum ne ta hanyar wani yanka mai zurfi ko ciwo ko ƙonuwa da yake shafar ƙwaƙwalwa. Cutar kan haifar da ciwo a jiki, musamman muƙamuƙi da wuya, wanda aka fi sani da lockjaw. Kowane rukuni na mutane ka iya kamuwa da cutar tetanos, to amma cutar ta fi yawa da tsanani ga jariari da iyayensu, a yayin da uwar ba ta samu kari daga cutar ba ta hanyar allura,. Cutar tetanos da ta kama mai juna biya ko kuma mako 6 kafin haihuwa ana kiran ta da cutar tetano ta uwa, yayin da wadda yaro ya kamu da ita a lokacin da yake da kawana 28 ana kiran ta da tetanos ta lokacin haihuwa. Cutar tetanos na ɗaya daga cikin manyan cututtuka da ke addabar sassa daban-daban na duniya, musamman ƙasashe mara arziki, inda ba a samun wadatar kulawa da garkuwr jiki da yawan al'adun rashin zabta a yayin haihuwa. Hukumar Lafiya ta Duniya ta yi sashe a 2018 cewa (wadda ita ce shekara mafi ƙaranci da aka yi hasashen), kimanin jarirai 25,000 ne ke mutuwa bayan haihuwarsu sakamakon cutar tetanos, inda aka samu raguwar kaso 88% a 2000. Alamomi: Kusan dukkan matsalar cutar tetabos na furuwa ne ga mutanen da ba taɓa yi musu allura ko manyan da ba su sake yin allura bayan wadda suka yi a baya. Alamomin cutar tetanos kan iya bayyana kowane lokaci daga kwana 3 zuwa 21 da shigar ƙwayar cutar jikin mutum ta hanyar rauni da ya ji .
translations.hypothesis: Cutar Tetanus Gamsashshen bayani: Cutar Tetanus cuta ce mai hatsari da ake kamuwa da ita ta hanyar bayyana ga ƙwayar bakteriya, Clostridium tetani, wadda ke rayuwa a cikin ƙasa da suga da ƙura da ƙashin dabbobi. Bakteriyar na iya shiga jiki ta hanyar raunuka ko ciwuka ko ƙuna da ke shafar tsarin juyayi. Kamuwa da cutar na haifar da tsakurewar tsokar jiki mai raɗaɗi, musamman na tsokar leɓe da wuya, kuma gama-gari ana sani da "ƙulla-baki". Mutane na kowane rukunin shekaru na iya kamuwa da cutar Tetanus amma cutar na gama-gari ne kuma mai tsananin illa ga jarirai da haihuwansu yayin da uwa ba ta da kariya daga cutar Tetanus ta hanyar riga-kafi, Tetanus toxoid. Tetanus da yake faruwa yayin ɗaukar ciki ko cikin satittika 6 na ƙarshen ɗaukar ciki ana kiran sa da Tetanus na uwa, yayin da Tetanus da yake faruwa cikin kwanaki 28 na farko na rayuwa ana kiran sa da Tetanus na jarirai. Cutar ta kasance wani muhimmin matsala ga lafiyar al'umma a sassa da dama na duniya, amma musamman a ƙasashe ko gundumomi masu ƙaramin karfi, inda yawan masu samun riga-kafi ke ƙanƙanta kuma amfani da tsaurin tsafta yayin haihuwa abu ne gama-gari. Hukumar Lafiya ta Duniya WHO ta ƙiyasta cewa a shekarar 2018 (shekarar da aka samu ƙididdiga ta ƙarshe), jarirai 25,000 sun mutu ta dalilin Tetanus na jarirai, wato raguwar 88% daga yanayin shekarar 2000. Alamomi: Kusan dukkanin masu kamuwa da cutar Tetanus suna faruwa ne a cikin mutanen da ba a taɓa yi musu riga-kafi ba ko kuma a cikin manya da ba su ci gaba da karɓar allurar ƙarfafa garkuwar jikinsu ba. Alamomi da kuma abubuwan da ke nuna kamuwa da cutar Tetanus na bayyana a kowane lokaci daga kwana 3 zuwa kwana 21 bayan shigar bakteriyar Tetanus a jiki ta hanyar rauni.

translations.source: Most cases occur within 14 days. Symptoms can include: jaw cramping or the inability to open the mouth muscle spasms often in the back, abdomen and extremities sudden painful muscle spasms often triggered by sudden noises trouble swallowing seizures headache fever and sweating changes in blood pressure or fast heart rate.
translations.reference: Yawancin cutar na bayyana ne cikin kwana 21. Alamomin sun ƙunshi: ƙagewar muƙamuƙi da kasa buɗe baki ƙagewar jiki, musamman baya da ciki da tafin hannu da na ƙafa ƙagewar jiki da kuma jin zafi na faruwa ne sakamakon ƙara wahala wajen yin haɗiya suma ciwon kai zazzaɓi da zufa Sauyawar hawan jini ko kuma saurin bugawar zuciya.
translations.hypothesis: Yawancin faruwar cutar yana faruwa a cikin kwanaki 14. Alamun cutar za su iya haɗawa da: tsagewar maƙogoro ko rashin iya buɗe baki. Tsagewar jijiya yawanci a baya, a ciki da ƙashin jiki. Tsagewar jijiya mai raɗaɗi wanda ke faruwa da ƙin santsi. Matsala wajen shaƙa. Faruwar matsalar zuciya. Ciwon kai. Zazzaɓi da kuma zubar da ruwan jini. Canjin yanayin jini ko saurin bugun zuciya.

translations.source: In neonatal tetanus, symptoms include muscle spasms, which are often preceded by the newborn’s inability to suck or breastfeed, and excessive crying. Tetanus is diagnosed on the basis of clinical features and does not require laboratory confirmation. Tetanus requires treatment in a medical facility, often in a referral hospital. People who recover from tetanus do not have natural immunity and can be infected again and therefore need to be immunized. Prevention: Tetanus can be prevented through immunization with tetanus-toxoid-containing vaccines (TTCV), which are included in routine immunization programmes globally and administered during antenatal care contacts. To be protected throughout life, WHO recommends that an individual receives 6 doses (3 primary plus 3 booster doses) of TTCV. The 3-dose primary series should begin as early as 6 weeks of age, with subsequent doses given with a minimum interval of 4 weeks between doses. The 3 booster doses should preferably be given during the second year of life (12–23 months), at 4–7 years of age, and at 9–15 years of age. Ideally, there should be at least 4 years between booster doses. There are many kinds of vaccines used to protect against tetanus: diphtheria and tetanus (DT) vaccinesdiphtheria, tetanus, and pertussis (whooping cough) (DTaP) vaccinestetanus and diphtheria (Td) vaccinestetanus, diphtheria, and pertussis (Tdap) vaccines.
translations.reference: A tetanos ɗin lokacin haihuwa, alamomin kan haɗa da ƙagewar jiki, wanda yawanci ke gabatar kasa tsotsar nonon jariri da kuma yawan kuka. Ana tabbatar da cutar tetanos dangane da alamu ba tare da buƙatar yin gwaji ba. Cutar tetanos na buƙatar kulawar asibiti, musamman tura zuwa wani asibitin. Mutanen da suka samu sauƙi daga cutar tetanos ba su da garkuwar jiki ta halicci, sannan kuma za su iya sake kamuwa, don haka suna buƙatar riga-kafi. Kariya: Za a iya samun kariya daga cutar tetanos ta hanyar yin riga-kafi da alluaran da ke kashe ta, waɗanda ake amfani da su a lokacin shirin zagayen riga-kafi na duniya da yin ta a yayin da ake zuwa duba lafiyar juna-biyu. Idan mutum ba ya so ya kamu da cutar har abada, hukumar Lafiya ta Duniya ta bayar da shawarar cewa, mutum ya riƙa yin allura da ke kashe tetanos sau 6 (na fari 3 da kuma riga-kafi) na alluran da kashe tetanos,. Alluran farko 3 a jere ya kamata a yi su, mako 6 da haihuwa, inda daga bisani bayan yin allurar da mako 4. An fi son yin riga-kafin ta 3 a shekara ta biyu bayan haihuwa (wata 12 zuwa 23) a shekara 4 zuwa 7 da kuma shekara 9 zuwa 15. An fi son a yi aƙalla shekara 4 a tsakanin alluran riga-kafin. Akwai allurai iri daban-daban da za a iya amfani da su wajen samun kariya daga cutar tetanos: allurar kashe tetatnos a lokacin yarinta da ta hana kawuwa da cutar tetanos da alluran hana tari.
translations.hypothesis: A cikin tarin yara, alamun sun haɗa da matsalar tsakure, wanda yawanci yana farawa ne da rashin iya sha ko shayarwa da yaron ya haifa, da kuma kuka mai yawa. Ana gano tarin ta hanyar amfani da alamun cutar, kuma ba shi da buƙatar tabbatar da gwajin ɗakin gwaje-gwaje. Tana buƙatar magani a cibiyar lafiya, yawanci a asibiti mai cike da marasa lafiya. Mutanen da suka warke daga tarin ba su da rigakafi na asali kuma za su iya sake kamuwa da cutar, don haka suna buƙatar yin allurar rigakafi. Riga-kafi: Za a iya hana tarin ta hanyar yin rigakafi da alluran rigakafi na (TTCV), wanda aka haɗa a cikin shirye-shiryen rigakafi na yau da kullum a duk duniya da kuma gudanarwa yayin hulɗar kula da juna biyu. Don samun kariya a gaba ɗaya rayuwa, Hukumar Lafiya ta Duniya ta ba da shawarar cewa mutum ya sami magunguna 6 (3 na farko da 3 na ƙara karfi) na TTCV. Jerin magunguna 3 na farko ya kamata a fara da farko a makonni 6 da haihuwa, tare da ba da ƙarin magunguna tare da ƙaramin tazara na makonni 4 tsakanin magunguna. Ya kamata a ba da ƙarin magunguna 3 a shekara ta biyu (watanni 12-23), a shekaru 4-7, da kuma a shekaru 9-15. A mafi kyau, ya kamata aƙalla shekaru 4 su kasance tsakanin alluran ƙarfafa. Akwai nau'o'in alluran rigakafi da yawa da ake amfani da su don kariya daga tarin: diphtheria da alluran rigakafi na tarin (DT) diphtheria, tarin, da pertussis (whooping cough) (DTaP) alluran rigakafi tarin da diphtheria (Td) alluran rigakafi tarin, diphtheria, da pertussis (Tdap) alluran rigakafi.

translations.source: Neonatal tetanus can be prevented by immunizing women of reproductive age with TTCV, either during pregnancy or outside of pregnancy. Additionally, robust medical practices can also prevent tetanus disease including clean delivery and cord care during childbirth, and proper wound care for surgical and dental procedures.
translations.reference: Za a iya kauce wa kamuwa da cutar tetanos ta lokacin haihuwa, ta hanyar yi wa mata da suka kai shekarun haihuwa riga-kafi da alluran kashe cutar tetanos kodai a lokacin da suke da juna biyu ko bayan haihuwa. Haka kuma, yawan kula da lafiya a-kai-a-kai ka iya hana kamuwa da cutar tetanos, wanda ya haɗa tsafta lokacin haihuwa da kula da lafiyar jariri yayin haihuwa da kula da rauni wajen yin tiyata da kuma aikin haƙori.
translations.hypothesis: Ana iya hana tarin yara ta hanyar yiwa mata masu shekarun haifuwa rigakafi da TTCV, ko da lokacin ɗaukar ciki ko bayan ɗaukar ciki. Bugu da ƙari, ingantattun ayyukan likitanci na iya hana cutar tarin ciki gami da tsafta wajen haihuwa da kula da igiyar haihuwa lokacin haihuwa, da kula da raunuka yadda ya kamata don tiyata da hanyoyin kula da haƙora.

translations.source: Tick-borne encephalitis Overview: Tick-borne encephalitis (TBE) is an important cause of viral infections of the central nervous system in eastern, central, northern and increasingly western European countries, and in northern China, Mongolia, and the Russian Federation. Tick-borne encephalitis virus is a member of the family Flaviviridae. Approximately 10 000–12 000 clinical cases of tick-borne encephalitis are reported each year, but this figure is believed to be significantly lower than the actual total number of clinical cases. The vast majority of infections with the virus result from infected ticks, which often remain firmly attached to the skin for days. On rare occasions, infection can result from consumption of unpasteurized milk from infect goats, sheep or cows. People come in contact with the ticks during outdoor activities in forested areas up to an altitude of about 2000 meters. There is no direct person-to-person transmission. Symptoms: Most infections remain asymptomatic. In case of clinical illness, the incubation period for tick-borne encephalitis lasts 2–28 days (most commonly 7–14 days) and is followed by 1–8 days of general cold symptoms, such as fatigue, headache and general malaise, usually combined with fever of ≥38 °C.
translations.reference: Cutar kumburin ƙwaƙwalwa ƙarin bayani: Cutar ƙwaƙwalwa na ɗaya daga cikin muhimman abubuwan da suke haifar da cuta a ƙwaƙwalwa a gabashi da tsakiya da arewaci kuma yake ci gaba ƙaruwa yammacin ƙasashen Turai, sannan kuma a arwacin China da Mongolia da Ttarayyar Rasha. Nau'in ƙwayar wannan cuta na cikin dangin ƙwayoyin cuta na Filabibiraidi. Kimanin mutane 10,000 zuwa 12,000 ke kamuwa da cutar ƙwaƙwalwa a duk shekara, amma an yi imanin wannan adadi bai kai ainihin adadin da ake samu ba. Mafi yawan wannan cuta da ƙwayar cutar na samuwa ne sakamakon ticks da ya kamu da cuta, wanda yawanci yake kasancewa a jikin fata tsawon kwanaki. A wasu lokutan, ana kamuwa da cutar ta hanyar shan nonon akuya ko tunkiya ko saniya mai cuta da aka sha ba tare da an dafa ba. Mutane kan kamu da cutar kumburin ƙwaƙwalwa a yayin mu'amala a wuraren da suke da daji da nisansa ya kai kimanin mita 2000. Mutane ba su yaɗa cutar a junansu. Alamomi: Yawanci kamuwa da cutar ba ya nuna alama. cutar kumburin ƙwaƙwalwa na ɗaukar kwana 2 zuwa 28 kafin ta fara (Yawanci kwana 7 zuwa 14) sannan kuma da kwana 1 zuwa 8 wanda shi ne alama ta bai-ɗaya, inda alamomi irin su yawan gajiya da ciwon kai da rashin jin daɗin jiki, wanda ya wanci ya haɗa da zazzaɓi wanda zafinsa ya kai 38C.
translations.hypothesis: Cutar da saurayen ke yaɗawa Gamsashshen bayani: Cutar kumburin ƙwaƙwalwa da saurayen ke yaɗawa (TBE) wata muhimmiyar cuta ce da ke yaɗuwa ta hanyar ƙwayar cutar da ke shafar tsarin juyayi a ƙasashen gabas, tsakiya, arewa da yawan ƙasashen yammacin Turai, da kuma arewacin China, Mongolia, da Tarayyar Rasha. ƙwayar cutar kumburin ƙwaƙwalwa da saurayen ke yaɗawa wani ɓangare ne na dangin Flaviviridae. Kusan faruwar cutar kumburin ƙwaƙwalwa da saurayen ke yaɗawa 10 000 zuwa 12 000 a kowace shekara, amma ana ganin wannan adadin ya yi ƙasa da ainihin adadin faruwar cutar. Mafi yawancin kamuwa da cutar ta hanyar ƙwayar cutar na faruwa ne ta hanyar saurayen da ke ɗauke da cutar, wanda yawanci suna sa kai a jikin fatar mutum na tsawon kwanaki.
