translations.source: After an asymptomatic interval of 1–20 days up to 15% of patients experience a second phase of the disease characterized by fever frequently exceeding 40 °C and signs of central nervous system involvement, such as meningitis (e.g. fever, headache, and a stiff neck), encephalitis (e.g., drowsiness, confusion, and sensory disturbances), myelitis or radiculitis. Encephalitis developing during this second phase may result in paralysis, permanent sequelae or death. About 1% of cases with neurological pathologies may die; higher fatality rates have been reported from the Russian federation, which may be related to a different virus subtype. Severity of illness increases with age of the patient, but fatalities have been reported from all age groups. There is no specific treatment for tick-borne encephalitis. Prevention: People can protect themselves from ticks by wearing appropriate clothing, including long trousers and closed footwear, when hiking or camping in countries or areas at risk. The whole body should be inspected daily and attached ticks removed as soon as possible. The consumption of unpasteurized dairy products should also be avoided in those areas. Immunization offers the most effective protection. Currently, there are 4 widely used vaccines of assured quality:
translations.reference: Bayan rashin nuna alama na kwana 1 zuwa 20, kusan kaso 15% na marasa lafiyar sukan fuskanci mataki na biyu na cutar, wanda ake yawan yin zazzaɓi da zafinsa ya wuce 40C da kuma nuna alamun cutar, kamar rashin jin ɗin jiki (da ya haɗa da zazzaɓi da ciwon kai ƙagewar wuya) da sakwarkwacewar ƙwaƙwalwa (kamar yawan bacci da rikicewa da rikicewar hanyoyin hankali) da zafin laka. Zafin ƙwaƙwalwa ka iya haifar da shanyewar ɓarin jiki da wata cutar ko ma mutuwa. Kimanin kaso 1% na matsalar da shafi ƙwaƙwalwa na iya gushewa, inda aka samu rahoton yawan mutuwa a Tarayyar Rasha, wanda za a iya dangantawa da ƙwayoyin cuta iri-iri. Ttsananin cutar na ƙaruwa, amma an samu rahoton samun mace-mace a kowane rukunin shekara. Babu wani takamaiman maganin kumburin ƙwaƙwalwa. Kariya: Mutane za iya samun kariya daga cutar tufafin ƙwaƙwalwa ta hanyar saka tufafin da ya dace, wanda ya haɗa da wando da safa, a yayin zuwa ko zama a ƙasashe ko wuraren da ke fuskantar barazana. Ya kamata a riƙa duba jiki kullum sannan a cire kumburin nan da nan. Ya kamata a guji shan madarar dabbar da ta kamu ba tare da an dafa a waɗannan wwuraren. Riga-kafi ya fi komai saurin yin maganin cutar. A yanzu akwai allurai 4 da suke da inganci yin maganin cutar:
translations.hypothesis: Bayan wani lokaci marar alamun cutar na kwanaki 1-20 har zuwa kaso 15% na marasa lafiya suna fuskantar mataki na biyu na cutar wanda ke da alamun zazzabi da ke yawaita hawa matakin 40 ° C da kuma alamun da ke nuna shigar da tsarin juyayi, kamar ciwon sanqarau (misali, zazzabi, ciwon kai, da kuma kazaƙurar wuya), kumburin ƙwaƙwalwa (misali, gyangyaɗi, ruɗani, da kuma matsalar jin daɗi), kumburin laka ko kumburin jijiya. Ciwon ƙwaƙwalwa da ke tasowa a wannan mataki na biyu na cutar na iya haifar da gurgunjewar ɓarin jiki, raunin da ba za a iya warkewa ba ko ma mutuwa. Kusan kaso 1% na masu fama da cutar da ke da matsalar ƙwaƙwalwa na iya mutuwa; an ba da rahoton mafi girman adadin mace-mace daga tarayyar Rasha, wanda ka iya zama da alaƙa da nau'in ƙwayar cuta daban. Tsananin cutar yana ƙaruwa tare da shekarun mara lafiya, amma an ba da rahoton mace-mace daga dukkan rukunin shekaru. Babu wani takamaiman magani don cutar kumburin ƙwaƙwalwa da ke yaɗuwa ta hanyar cizon sauro. Riga-kafi: Mutane za su iya kare kansu daga cizon sauro ta hanyar sanya tufafi da suka dace, gami da dogon rigar maza da takalmi, yayin yin tafiya ko yawon buɗe ido a ƙasashe ko wuraren da ke cikin haɗari. Ya kamata a duba dukkan jikin yau da kullum da kuma cire kwaron da ke haɗe da su da sauri. Ya kamata a guji amfani da kayan madara da ba a dafa ba a waɗannan wuraren. Alurar riga-kafi tana ba da mafi ingantacciyar kariya. A halin yanzu, akwai alluran riga-kafi 4 da ake amfani da su masu inganci:

translations.source: FSME-Immun and Encepur, manufactured in Austria and Germany respectively, and based on European strains of the virus; and TBE-Moscow and EnceVir, manufactured in the Russian Federation and based on Far-Eastern strains. The 4 vaccines are considered to be safe and effective. In areas where the disease is highly endemic, WHO recommends that vaccination be offered to all age groups, including children. Ticks also transmit Borreliosis (Lyme disease), which is a bacterial infection. TBE vaccination is not effective against this disease, which however is treatable with antimicrobials.
translations.reference: Sun haɗa da allurar FSME-Immun da Encepu, waɗanda ake yi a Austria da Germany, sannan kuma dangane da ƙarfin ƙwayar cutar a Turai da TBE-Moscow da kuma EnceVir, waɗanda da ake yin su a Tarayyar Rasha, sannan dangane da ƙarfinta a can gabashi. Ana ganin allurai 4 sun fi inganci da aminci. Hukumar Lafiya ta Duniya ta bayar da shawarar yin alluran ga kowane rukuni na shekara, da ya haɗa da yara a wuraren da cutar ta zama annoba. Cutar kumburin ƙwaƙwalwa na haifar da cutar Borreliosis, wadda ƙwayar cuta ke haifarwa. Allurar TBE ba ta maganin wannan cuta, wacce za a iya maganinta da maganin da ke kashe ƙwayoyin cuta.
translations.hypothesis: FSME-Immun da Encepur, waɗanda aka ƙera su a ƙasar Ostiriya da Jamus, kuma waɗanda aka samar da su ta hanyar amfani da nau'ukan ƙwayar cutar na Turai; da kuma TBE-Moscow da EnceVir, waɗanda aka ƙera su a ƙasar Rasha kuma waɗanda aka samar da su ta hanyar amfani da nau'ukan Far-Eastern. Ana la'akari da cewa alluran 4 sun kasance masu aminci da tasiri. A wuraren da cutar ta fi yawaita, Hukumar Lafiya ta Duniya ta ba da shawarar cewa a ba da allurar rigakafin ga duk rukunin shekaru, gami da yara. Saurayen halittar 'ticks' suma suna yaɗa cutar Borreliosis (cutar Lyme), wadda cuta ce da take da alaƙa da ƙwayar cuta. Allurar rigakafin TBE ba ta da tasiri a kan wannan cutar, wadda duk da haka ana iya magance ta da magungunan antimicrobials.

translations.source: Tobacco Overview: Nicotine contained in tobacco is highly addictive and tobacco use is a major risk factor for cardiovascular and respiratory diseases, over 20 different types or subtypes of cancer, and many other debilitating health conditions. Every year, more than 8 million people die from tobacco use. Most tobacco-related deaths occur in low- and middle-income countries, which are often targets of intensive tobacco industry interference and marketing. Tobacco can also be deadly for non-smokers. Second-hand smoke exposure has also been implicated in adverse health outcomes, causing 1.2 million deaths annually. Nearly half of all children breathe air polluted by tobacco smoke and 65 000 children die each year due to illnesses related to second-hand smoke. Smoking while pregnant can lead to several life-long health conditions for babies. Heated tobacco products (HTPs) contain tobacco and expose users to toxic emissions, many of which cause cancer and are harmful to health. Electronic nicotine delivery systems (ENDS) and electronic non-nicotine delivery systems (ENNDS), commonly known as e-cigarettes, do not contain tobacco and may or may not contain nicotine, but are harmful to health and undoubtedly unsafe.
translations.reference: Taba sigari Ƙarin bayani: Sinadarin nikotin da ke cikin taba sigari na kama mutane, sannan shan sigari na ɗaya daga cikin manyan matsalolin da ke haifar da shanyewar ɓarin jiki da matsalolin numfashi, inda take haifar fiye da kaso 20% na ire-iren cutar kansa da sauran manyan cututtuka. A kowace shekara, mutane miliyan 8 ne suke mutuwa sakamakon shan taba sigari. Yawan mace-macen da ke da nasaba da taba sigari na faruwa ne a ƙaranci da matsakaicin tattalin arziki, waɗanda su kamfanonin taba sigari suka fin yin tallace-tallace. Haka kuma taba sigari na kashe waɗanda ba sa sha. Masu shaƙar hayaƙin taba sigari na fuskantar barazanar lafiya, inda kimanin mutane miliyan 1,2 ke mutuwa duk shekara. Kusan rabin yara ƙanana na sheƙar iskar da taba sigari ta gurɓata, sannan kuma kimanin yara dubu 65,000 ke mutuwa duk shekara sakamakon cututtuka masu nasaba da shaƙar taba sigari. Shan taba yayin da ake ɗauke da ciki na iya haifar da matsalolin lafiya na har abada ga jarirai. Kayayyakin taba da aka gasa (HTPs) sun ƙunshi taba, kuma suna jefa masu shau haɗuwa da hayaƙi mai guba, waɗanda da yawa daga cikin su ke haifar da cutar kansa kuma suna da illa ga lafiya. Tsarin isar da nicotine na lantarki (ENDS) da tsarin ba da abubuwan da ba na nicotine ba na lantarki (ENNDS), wanda akafi sani da e-cigarettes, basa ƙunshe da taba kuma ƙila su ƙunshi nicotine ko ba su ƙunshi nicotine ba, amma suna da illa ga lafiya kuma babu shakka amfani da su yana da haɗari.
translations.hypothesis: Taba Gamsashshen bayani: Taba tana ɗauke da sinadarin nicotine wanda yake jawo hankali sannan amfani da taba na cikin manyan abubuwan haɗari ga cututtukan zuciya da jijiyoyinta da cututtukan numfashi da nau'ikan cutar daji sama da 20 da wasu matsalolin lafiya da yawa. A kowace shekara, sama da mutane miliyan 8 ne ke mutuwa sakamakon amfani da taba. Mafi yawancin mace-macen da taba ke haddasawa suna faruwa ne a ƙasashe masu ƙaranci da matsakaicin arziƙi, waɗanda yawanci su ne maƙasudin tsoma bakin masana'antar taba da tallace-tallace. Taba zata iya kashe ma wanda ba shi da ta. Bayyanar hayaƙin taba na hannun wasta shi ma yana da illa ga lafiya, yana jawo mace-mace miliyan 1.2 a kowace shekara. Kusan rabin duka yara suna shaƙa iska da hayaƙin taba ke gurɓatawa kuma yara 65 000 ne ke mutuwa a kowace shekara sakamakon cututtukan da ke da alaƙa da hayaƙin taba na hannun wasta. Amfani da taba yayin ɗaukar ciki zai iya haifar da matsalolin lafiya masu yawa da zasu zama na tsawon rayuwar jarirai. Kayayyakin taba masu ɗumi (HTPs) suna ɗauke da taba kuma suna haifar da masu amfani da su ga hayaƙi mai guba, wanda da yawa daga ciki ke haifar da cutar daji kuma suna cutar da lafiya. Na'urorin aika sinadarin nicotine na na'ura (ENDS) da na'urorin aika sinadarin nicotine na na'ura (ENNDS), waɗanda aka fi sani da tabar na'ura, ba sa ɗauke da taba kuma suna iya ɗauke da nicotine ko kuma ba sa ɗauke da shi, amma suna cutar da lafiya kuma tabbas ba su da aminci.

translations.source: However, it is too early to provide a clear answer on the long-term impact of HTPs and/or e-cigarette use. Impact: An estimated 1.3 billion people worldwide use tobacco products, 80% of whom are in low- and middle-income countries. Tobacco use contributes to poverty by diverting household spending from basic needs, such as food and shelter, to tobacco. This spending behaviour is difficult to curb because tobacco is so addictive. It also causes premature death and disability of productive age adults in households thus leading to reduced household income and increased healthcare costs. In addition to the detrimental impact of tobacco on health, the total economic cost of smoking (from health expenditures and productivity losses together) are estimated to be around US$ 1.4 trillion per year, equivalent in magnitude to 1.8% of the world's annual gross domestic product (GDP). Almost 40% of this cost occurred in developing countries, highlighting the substantial burden these countries suffer. Tobacco taxes are applied in part to combat this effect and are seen as the most cost-effective way of curbing tobacco use, particularly among youth and low-income populations. A tax increase that increases tobacco prices by 10% decreases tobacco consumption by about 4% in high-income countries and about 5% in low- and middle-income countries. WHO response: The scale of this human and economic tragedy is shocking, but it’s also preventable.
translations.reference: Sai dai, ya yi wuri a ba da cikakkiyar amsa kan tasirin HTPs da/ko amfani da sigari na dogon lokaci. Tasiri: Kimanin mutane biliyan 1.3 a faɗin duniya suna amfani da kayan sigari, kashi 80% daga cikinsu suna cikin ƙasashe masu ƙarami ko matsakaicin karfi. Yin amfani da taba yana taimakawa wajen ƙaruwar talauci ta hanyar karkatar da kuɗaɗen amfanin gida daga buƙatun dole, kamar abinci da matsuguni, zuwa taba. Wannan halin kashe kuɗi yana da wahala a hana shi saboda taba tana da shiga rai sosai. Haka nan yana haifar da mutuwa da wuri da naƙasa ga manya masu tasowa a gidaje, wanda hakan ke haifar da raguwar kuɗin shiga na gida da ƙarin kashe kuɗi kan kiwon lafiya. Baya ga illar da taba ke yi kan lafiya, an ƙiyasta cewa jimillar kudin da ake kashewa kan shan sigari (daga kuɗaɗen da ake kashewa kan kiwon lafiya da asarar yawan aiki) ya kai dalar Amurka tiriliyan 1.4 a kowace shekara, kwatankwacin kashi 1.8% na ma’aunin GDP na shekara-shekara na duniya. Kusan kashi 40% na wannan kuɗi ya faru ne a ƙasashe masu tasowa, wanda ke nuna babban nauyin da waɗannan ƙasashe ke fama da shi. Ana amfani da wani ɓangare na harajin taba don yaƙar wannan tasirin, kuma ana kallon hakan a matsayin hanya mafi inganci wajen hana shan taba, musamman tsakanin matasa da masu ƙaramin ƙarfi. Ƙarin harajin da ya ƙara farashin taba da kashi 10 cikin 100 yana rage yawan shan taba da kusan kashi 4 cikin 100 a ƙasashe masu ƙarfin tattalin arziƙi da kuma kusan kashi 5 cikin 100 a ƙasashe masu ƙaramin ƙarfi da matsakaicin kuɗin shiga. Martanin ƙuniyar WHO: Girman wannan bala'i ga ɗan adam da na tattalin arziƙi yana da ban tsoro, amma kuma ana iya hana shi.
translations.hypothesis: Duk da haka, yayi wuri a ba da amsa mai ƙayatarwa game da tasirin HTPs da/ko amfani da tabar na’ura mai dogon zango. Tasiri: An kiyasta mutane biliyan ɗaya da ɗigo uku a faɗin duniya suna amfani da kayan taba, inda kashi 80% daga cikinsu ke ƙasashen da suke da ƙaranci da matsakaicin arziƙi. Amfani da taba na ba da gudunmawa ga talauci ta hanyar janyo kashe kuɗi daga abubuwan da ake buƙata, kamar abinci da mazauni, zuwa ga taba. Wannan halin kashe kuɗi yana da wahalar dakatarwa saboda taba ta fi zama mai janyo hankali. Haka kuma yana haifar da mutuwa da lokaci ba daidai ba da nakasar manya masu aikin samar da kuɗi a gidaje wanda hakan ke janyo raguwar kuɗin shiga na gida da kuma ƙaruwar kashe kuɗi a harkar lafiya. Baya ga mummunan tasirin taba ga lafiya, jimillar farashin tattalin arziƙi na shan taba (daga kashe kuɗi a harkar lafiya da asarar samarwa gabaɗaya) an kiyasta ya kai kimanin dalar Amurka tiriliyan ɗaya da ɗigo huɗu a kowace shekara, wanda ya yi daidai da 1.8% na jimlar ababen hawa na ƙasa na shekara-shekara. Kusan kashi 40% na wannan farashin ya faru ne a ƙasashen da ke tasowa, wanda ke nuna babban nauyi da waɗannan ƙasashen ke fuskanta. Ana amfani da harajin taba a wani ɓangare don magance wannan tasirin kuma ana ganin shi a matsayin mafi kyawata hanya ta rage amfani da taba, musamman a cikin matasa da mutanen da ba su da ƙarfin arziki. Ƙarin haraji da ke ƙara farashin taba da kashi 10% yana rage amfani da taba da kusan kashi 4% a ƙasashen da suke da babban karfin arziki da kusan kashi 5% a ƙasashen da suke da ƙaranci da matsakaicin karfin arziki. Amsar WHO: Girman wannan afkuwar ɗan'adam da tattalin arziƙi abun tashin hankali ne, amma kuma za a iya magance shi.

translations.source: Big Tobacco — along with all manufacturers of tobacco products — is fighting to ensure the dangers of their products are concealed, but we are fighting back: In 2003, WHO Member States unanimously adopted the WHO Framework Convention on Tobacco Control (WHO FCTC), the only public health treaty under the auspices of WHO. In force since 2005, it has currently 181 Parties. To help countries implement the WHO FCTC, WHO introduced MPOWER, a package of technical measures and resources, each of which corresponds to at least one provision of the WHO FCTC. MPOWER builds the capacity of countries to implement 6 measures to reduce the demand for tobacco products: monitor tobacco use and prevention policies, protect people from tobacco use, offer help to quit tobacco use, warn about the dangers of tobacco, enforce bans on tobacco advertising, promotion and sponsorship and raise taxes on tobacco.
translations.reference: Big Tobacco - tare da duk masu haɗa kayan sigari - suna yaƙi don tabbatar da cewa sun ɓoye haɗarin hajarsu, amma muma muna yaƙarsu: A shekarar 2003, Ƙasashe Mambobin WHO a jimlace sun amince da Yarjejeniyar Tsarin Taimako ta WHO kan Kula da Taba (WHO FCTC), yarjejeniya kan lafiyar jama'a ɗaya tilo a ƙarƙashin ƙungiyar WHO. Yarjejeniyar da ke aiki tun 2005, a halin yanzu tana da mambobi 181. Don taimaka wa ƙasashe wajen aiwatar da WHO FCTC, WHO ta gabatar da MPOWER, wani ƙunshin matakan da kayayyaki na ƙwarewa, wanda kowanne ya dace da a ƙalla tanadin WHO FCTC guda ɗaya. MPOWER yana haɓaka ƙarfin ƙasashe na aiwatar da matakai 6 don rage amfani da kayan sigari: sa ido kan tsare-tsaren amfani da taba da daƙile wa, kare mutane daga shan taba, ba da taimako kan daina shan taba, gargaɗi game da haɗarin taba, tilasta hana tallan taba, tallatawa da ɗaukar nauyi, da ƙara haraji akan taba.
translations.hypothesis: Babban Tabako - tare da duk masu ƙera kayan tabako - suna yaƙi don tabbatar da cewa haɗarin kayayyakinsu ya ɓuya, amma muna mayar da ƙarfi: A shekarar 2003, ƙasashen da ke Ƙarƙashin Hukumar Lafiya ta Duniya sun amince da Yarjejeniyar Tsarin Hukumar Lafiya ta Duniya kan Sarrafa Taba (WHO FCTC), wadda ita ce kawai yarjejeniyar lafiyar jama'a a ƙarƙashin jagorancin Hukumar Lafiya ta Duniya. Tun daga shekarar 2005, a halin yanzu tana da ƙungiyoyi 181. Don taimakawa ƙasashe su aiwatar da WHO FCTC, WHO ta gabatar da MPOWER, wani kunshin matakai da albarkatu na fasaha, kowanne wanda ya dace da aƙalla wani sharadi na WHO FCTC. MPOWER yana gina ƙarfin ƙasashe don aiwatar da matakai 6 don rage buƙatun kayan taba: sa ido kan amfani da taba da kuma manufofin rigakafi, kare mutane daga amfani da taba, ba da taimako don dena amfani da taba, gargaɗi game da haɗarin taba, dakatar da haramcin tallata taba, haɓakawa da ɗaukar nauyi da kuma ƙara harajin taba.

translations.source: Trachoma Overview: Trachoma is a disease of the eye and the leading infectious cause of blindness worldwide. It is caused by an obligate intracellular bacterium called Chlamydia trachomatis. Infection is transmitted from person to person by direct or indirect transfer of ocular and nasal discharges of infected people; indirect transfer includes carriage on the body of species of flies. Preschool-age children harbour the principal reservoir of infection. Models suggest that an individual requires more than 150 lifetime infections to develop the blinding complications of trachoma. Trachoma is endemic in some of the world’s poorest populations, who live in rural and remote areas and have highly inadequate access to water, sanitation and healthcare. Africa is the most affected continent, but it also has the most widespread control efforts. The disease is also found in Central and South America, Asia, Australia, and the Middle East. As of 2 January 2020, 13 countries had reported achieving elimination goals.
translations.reference: Trachoma Bayani: Trachoma cuta ce ta ido kuma cutar da ke kan gaba wajen jawo makanta a duniya. Ɗaurarrun ƙananan ƙwayoyin cuta da ake kira Chlamydia trachomatis ne ke haifar da ita. Cutar na yaɗuwa ne daga mutum zuwa mutum ta hanyar haɗuwa da ruwan da ke fita daga ido ko hancin mai ɗauke da cutar kai-tsaye ko ba kai-tsaye ba; yaɗuwar da ba ta kai-tsaye ba ta haɗa da ɗaukar cutar a jikin wasu nau’ika na ƙuda. Yaran da ba su kai matakin shiga makaranta ba suna kamuwa da cutar sosaa. Samfuran tsare-tsare sun nuna cewa mutum na buƙatar cututtuka sama da 150 masu haɗari kafin ya haɗu da rikice-rikicen makanta na trachoma. Cutar ta Trachoma na yaɗuwa sosai a wasu daga cikin matalautan duniya, waɗanda ke zaune a yankunan karkara da lunguna, kuma ba su da isasshen ruwa da tsaftar muhalli da tsarin kiwon lafiya. Afirka ce nahiyar da cutar ta fi shafa, amma kuma tafi ko ina ƙoƙarin shawo kan matsalar. Haka nan ana samun cutar a Amurka ta Tsakiya da Amurka ta Kudu da Asiya da Ostiraliya da Gabas ta Tsakiya. Ya zuwa2 ga Janairun 2020, ƙasashe 13 sun ba da rahoton daƙile cutar.
translations.hypothesis: Cutar ido ta Trachoma Gamsashshen bayani: Cutar ido ta Trachoma cuta ce da take kama ido kuma ita ce cutar da take kawo makanta a faɗin duniya. Ana kamuwa da ita ne ta hanyar ƙwayar bakteriya da ke zaune a cikin ƙwayoyin halitta da ake kira Chlamydia trachomatis. Ana kamuwa da cutar ne ta hanyar mu'amala tsakanin mutum da mutum ta hanyar fitar da ruwan ido da hanci na masu cutar kai tsaye ko a kaikaice; yaɗa cutar kai tsaye ya haɗa da ɗaukar nauyin jikin nau'o'in ƙudan da ke yawo a jikin mutum. Yara masu shekarun makarantar ƙaramar aji na ɗaukar nauyin manyan wuraren ajiye cutar. Samfurin ya nuna cewa mutum na buƙatar fiye da kamuwa da cutar sau 150 a rayuwarsa kafin a samu matsalar makanta da cutar idon Trachoma ke janyowa. Ana samun cutar idon Trachoma a cikin mutanen da suke da raunin tattalin arziki a wasu sassan duniya, waɗanda ke zaune a yankunan karkara da nesa kuma ba su da isasshen ruwa, tsaftar muhalli da kiwon lafiya. Nahiyar Afirka ce ta fi fama da cutar, amma kuma tana da mafi kyawun tsarin daƙile yaɗuwarta. Ana kuma samun cutar a tsakiyar Amurka da Kudancin Amurka da Asiya da Ostireliya da Gabas ta Tsakiya. Tun daga ranar 2 ga Janairun 2020, ƙasashe 13 sun ba da rahoton cimma manufar kawar da cutar.

translations.source: In 2019 alone, 92 622 people received surgical treatment for advanced trachoma and 95.2 million were treated with antibiotics. Despite these successes, the disease remains a serious public health concern, with an estimated US$ 8 billion annual loss in productivity due to blindness and visual impairment. Symptoms: Infection is associated with inflammatory changes in the conjunctiva known as “active trachoma”. An individual’s immune system can clear a single episode of infection, but in endemic communities, re-acquisition of the organism occurs frequently. After years of repeated episodes of active trachoma, the inside of the eyelid can become so severely scarred (trachomatous conjunctival scarring) that it turns inwards and causes the eyelashes to rub against the eyeball (trachomatous trichiasis), resulting in constant pain and light intolerance; this and other alterations of the eye can lead to scarring of the cornea. Left untreated, this condition leads to the formation of irreversible opacities, with resulting visual impairment or blindness. The age at which this occurs depends on several factors including local transmission intensity. In very highly endemic communities, it can occur in childhood, though onset of visual impairment between the ages of 30 and 40 years is more typical. Women are blinded up to four times as often as men, probably due to more frequent contact with infected children. Individuals living in the poorest and most remote communities of Africa, Asia, Australia, the Middle East, Central and South America and the Pacific Islands are at risk.
translations.reference: A shekarar 2019 kaɗai, an yi wa mutane 92 622 aikin tiyata don babbar cutar ta trachoma, kuma an yi wa mutum miliyan 95.2 maganin da magungunan kashe ƙwayoyin cuta. Duk da waɗannan nasarorin, cutar ta ci gaba da zama babbar damuwa ga lafiyar jama'a, tare da asarar kusan dalar Amurka biliyan 8 a kowace shekara wurin yin aiki saboda makanta da matsalar gani. Alamomi: Kamuwa da cutar na haɗe da canje-canje na kumburi a cikin conjunctiva da ake kira "trachoma mai aiki". Garkuwar jikin mutum na iya kawar da dunƙulen cutar guda ɗaya, amma a cikin al'ummomin da cutar tayi yawa, sake haɗuwa da ƙwayoyin cutar yana faruwa akai-akai. Bayan shekaru da yawa ana maimaita cutar ta trachoma mai aiki, cikin fatar ido zai iya zama mai tabo mai tsanani (trachomatous conjunctival scarring) har ta juya zuwa ciki tana saka gashin ido yana gogar ƙwayar ido (trachomatous trichiasis), wanda ke haifar da ciwo na kullum da rashin iya kallon haske sosai; wannan da kuma sauran canje-canjen ido na iya haifar da tabon cornea. Idan ba a yi maganin sa ba, yana iya haifar da haɗuwar dusashewar da ba za a iya gyarawa ba, tare da haifar da naƙasar gani ko makanta. Shekarun da wannan ke faruwa ya dogara da abubuwa da yawa, waɗanda suka haɗa da ƙarfin yaɗuwa na cikin gida. A cikin al'ummomin da masu cutar ke da yawa sosai, tana iya faruwa a lokacin yarinta, ko da yake farkon nakasar gani ya fi faruwa tsakanin shekaru 30 zuwa 40. Mata sun fi makanta sau huɗu fiye da maza, mai yiwuwa saboda yawan saduwa da yara masu ɗauke da cutar. Mutanen da ke zaune a cikin mafi talauci kuma mafi nisan al'ummomin Afirka da Asiya da Ostiraliya da Gabas ta Tsakiya da Amurka ta Tsakiya da Amurka ta Kudu da Tsibiran Pacific suna cikin haɗari.
translations.hypothesis: A 2019 kaɗai, mutane 92,622 sun sami kulawar tiyata don magance matakin ciwon ido na baya-bayan nan, kuma an yi maganin miliyan 95.2 tare da maganin riga-kafi. Duk da waɗannan nasarorin, cutar ta kasance babban abin damuwa ga lafiyar jama'a, tare da kimanin asarar biliyan $ 8 a kowace shekara ta haifar da makanta da nakasar gani. Alamomi: Kamuwa da cutar yana da alaƙa da canje-canjen kumburi a cikin conjunctiva wanda aka fi sani da "active trachoma". Garkuwar jiki na mutum na iya kawar da ɗaya daga cikin kamuwa da cutar, amma a cikin al'ummomin da ke fama da cutar, sake samun halittar yana faruwa akai-akai. Bayan shekaru da yawa na sake dawowar ciwon ido mai saurin yaɗuwa, ciki na aljihun ido zai iya zama mai rauni sosai (trachomatous conjunctival scarring) har ya koma cikin da kuma haifar da cizon fatar ido (trachomatous trichiasis), wanda ke haifar da ciwon daina jin haske; wannan da sauran canje-canjen ido na iya haifar da ciwon ido. Idan ba a yi magani ba, wannan yanayin na kai ga samar da ɓoyayyiyar gado mai tsanani, wanda ke haifar da nakasar gani ko makanta. Shekarun da hakan ke faruwa ya dogara ga abubuwa da yawa da suka haɗa da ƙarfin yaɗuwa a cikin gida. A cikin al'ummomi masu fama da cutar, yana iya faruwa a lokacin yarinta, duk da cewa faruwar nakasar gani tsakanin shekaru 30 da 40 ya fi dacewa. Mata na kamuwa da makanta har sau hudu fiye da maza, wataƙila saboda yawan mu'amalinsu da yara masu ɗauke da cutar. Mutanen da ke zaune a cikin al'ummomin da suke da raunin tattalin arziki da nesa a Afirka, Asiya, Ostireliya, Gabas ta Tsakiya, Tsakiya da Kudancin Amurka da Tsibirin Pacific suna cikin haɗari.

translations.source: Treatment: Trachoma can be prevented by limiting environmental risk factors. These include inadequate hygiene, crowded households, inadequate access to water and inadequate access to and use of sanitation. Infections usually begin at an early age and grow less frequent and shorter in duration with increasing age. Infections are most often acquired through family and contact with others with active disease. Repeated infections cause the most serious symptoms of the disease. Trachoma can be eliminated as a public health problem using the SAFE strategy, comprising: Surgery to treat trachomatous trichiasis, the blinding stage of the disease; Antibiotics to clear infection, particularly mass drug administration of the antibiotic azithromycin, which is donated by the manufacturer to national programmes through the International Trachoma Initiative; Facial cleanliness; and Environmental improvement, particularly better access to water and sanitation.
translations.reference: Magancewa: Ana iya kare cutar ta trachoma ta hanyar rage haɗurran da ke da alaƙa da muhalli. Waɗannan sun haɗa da rashin isasshiyar tsafta, da cunkoso a gidaje, da rashin samun isasshen ruwa, da rashin isassu kayan tsaftar muhalli da damar amfani da su. Yawanci cutar na farawa a ƙananan shekaru, kuma tana ƙaranci kuma mafi gaharta idan ana ƙara yawan shekaru. An fi kamuwa da cutar ta hanyar iyali da hulɗa da masu fama da cutar. Maimaita cutar na haifar da mafi girman alamun cutar. Ana iya daƙile cutar ta trachoma a matsayin matsalar lafiyar jama'a ta hanyar amfani da dabarun SAFE, wanda ya ƙunshi: Tiyata don magance trachomatous trichiasis, matakin makanta na cutar; Magungunan kashe ƙwayoyin cuta don kawar da cutar, musamman bayar da maganin nan mai suna azithromycin mai kashe ƙwayoyin cuta da yawa, wanda masana'anta ke bayarwa kyauta ga shirye-shiryen ƙasa ta hanyar International Trachoma Initiative; Tsaftar fuska; da kuma Inganta muhalli, musamman samun damar amfani da ruwa da tsafta mafiya kyawu.
translations.hypothesis: Magani: Za a iya magance cutar 'trachoma' ta hanyar rage haɗurran muhalli. Waɗannan sun haɗa da rashin tsafta, da yawan mutane a gida, da rashin samun isasshen ruwa da rashin samun isasshen tsaftar muhalli da kuma amfani da shi. Yawanci cututtukan suna farawa ne a farkon shekaru kuma suna ƙanƙanta yawan faruwa da gajarta lokacin da shekarun mutum ke ƙaruwa. Yawanci ana kamuwa da cututtukan ta hanyar iyali da kuma mu'amala da wasu da ke da cutar. Sake kamuwa da cutar yana haifar da alamun cutar mafi tsananin gaske. Za a iya kawar da cutar 'trachoma' a matsayin matsalar lafiyar jama'a ta hanyar amfani da dabarar SAFE, wanda ya haɗa da: Aikin tiyata don magance cutar 'trachomatous trichiasis', matakin makanta na cutar; Magungunan rigakafi don magance kamuwa da cuta, musamman rarraba magunguna masu yawa na maganin rigakafi azithromycin, wanda mai ƙera ya ba da gudunmawa ga shirye-shiryen ƙasa ta hanyar shirin International Trachoma Initiative; Tsaftace fuska; da Inganta muhalli, musamman samun ingantaccen ruwa da tsaftar muhalli.

translations.source: WHO adopted the SAFE strategy in 1993 and continues in its mandate to provide leadership and coordination of international efforts to eliminate trachoma as a public health problem.
translations.reference: WHO ta yi amfani da dabarun SAFE a shekarar 1993, kuma tana ci gaba da aikinta na yin jagoranci da daidaita ayyukan ƙasa-da-ƙasa don kawar da cutar ta trachoma a matsayin matsalar lafiyar jama'a.
translations.hypothesis: Hukumar Lafiya ta Duniya ta ɗauki tsarin SAFE a 1993 kuma ta ci gaba da aiwatar da manufarta ta samar da jagoranci da daidaita ƙoƙarin duniya na kawar da cutar ido a matsayin matsalar lafiyar jama'a.

translations.source: Traditional, Complementary and Integrative Medicine Overview: Traditional medicine Traditional medicine has a long history. It is the sum total of the knowledge, skill, and practices based on the theories, beliefs, and experiences indigenous to different cultures, whether explicable or not, used in the maintenance of health as well as in the prevention, diagnosis, improvement or treatment of physical and mental illness. Complementary medicine The terms “complementary medicine” or “alternative medicine” refer to a broad set of health care practices that are not part of that country’s own tradition or conventional medicine and are not fully integrated into the dominant health-care system. They are used interchangeably with traditional medicine in some countries. Herbal medicines Herbal medicines include herbs, herbal materials, herbal preparations and finished herbal products, that contain as active ingredients parts of plants, or other plant materials, or combinations. Impact: The WHO Traditional Medicine Strategy 2014–2023 was developed and launched in response to the World Health Assembly resolution on traditional medicine (WHA62.13).
translations.reference: Magungunan Gargajiya da na Ƙari da Haɗaɗɗun Magunguna Bayani: Maganin gargajiya Maganin gargajiya yana da dogon tarihi. Shi ne jimillar ilimi da ƙwarewa da ayyuka bisa ƙa'idoji da imani da gogewa na cikin gida ga mutane masu al’adu daban-daban, wanda za a iya bayaninsa da wanda ba za a iya ba, wanda ake amfani da su wajen kula da lafiya da kuma rigakafi da gano cuta da ingantawa ko magance rashin lafiyar jiki da ta ƙwaƙwalwa. Maganin Ƙari "Maganin ƙari " ko "maganin madadi " na nufin wani jerin tsarin ayyukan kula da lafiya waɗanda ba sa cikin al'adar ƙasar na kanta ko magungunan gargajiya kuma ba sa cikin gamammen tsarin kula da lafiya. Ana amfani da su a madadin magungunan gargajiya a wasu ƙasashe. Magungunan ganye Magungunan ganye sun haɗa da ganyayyaki da kayan ganyayyaki da gyara ganyayyayki da kuma kayan ganye da aka sarrafa, waɗanda ke ƙunshe da sassan tsirrai ko wasu kayan shuka ko duka. Tasiri: An ƙirƙira kuma an ƙaddamar da Dabarun Magungunan Gargajiya na WHO 2014-2023 don mayar da martani ga ƙudurin Majalisar Lafiya ta Duniya kan magungunan gargajiya (WHA62.13).
translations.hypothesis: Magunguna na gargajiya, na haɗaka da na haɗin gwiwa Gamsashshen bayani: Magungunan gargajiya Magungunan gargajiya suna da dogon tarihi. Shi ne jimillar gaba ɗayan ilimi, da ƙwarewa, da ayyuka da suka dogara ga nazari, da imani, da gogewa na asalin al'adu daban-daban, ko dai masu bayani ko ba su ba, da aka yi amfani da su wajen kiyaye lafiya da kuma rigakafi, da bincike, da ingantawa ko magance cututtukan jiki da na ƙwaƙwalwa. Magungunan haɗaka. Kalmomin "magungunan haɗaka" ko "magungunan wani wuri" suna nufin wani fannonin ayyukan kula da lafiya waɗanda ba wani ɓangare ne na al'adar ƙasar ba ko magungunan gargajiya kuma ba a cikasu cikin tsarin kula da lafiya ba. Ana amfani da su daidai da magungunan gargajiya a wasu ƙasashen. Magungunan shuka Magungunan shuka sun haɗa da shuka, kayan shuka, shirye-shiryen shuka da kayan shuka da aka gama, waɗanda ke ɗauke da sassa na shuka masu aiki, ko wasu kayan shuka, ko haɗakar su. Tasiri: An samar da Tsarin Magungunan Gargajiya na Hukumar Lafiya ta Duniya na shekarar 2014 zuwa 2023 da ƙaddamarwa a matsayin martani ga ƙudurin Majalisar Lafiya ta Duniya kan magungunan gargajiya (WHA62.13).

translations.source: The strategy aims to support Member States in developing proactive policies and implementing action plans that will strengthen the role traditional medicine plays in keeping populations healthy. Addressing the challenges, responding to the needs identified by Member States and building on the work done under the WHO traditional medicine strategy: 2002–2005, the updated strategy for the period 2014–2023 devotes more attention than its predecessor to prioritizing health services and systems, including traditional and complementary medicine products, practices and practitioners. The strategic objectives are: To build the knowledge base for active management of T&CM through appropriate national policies; To strengthen the quality assurance, safety, proper use and effectiveness of T&CM by regulating products, practices and practitioners; To promote universal health coverage by integrating T&CM services into health care service delivery and self-health care. WHO response: The WHO global report on traditional and complementary medicine 2019 was developed to address the gap in reliable, credible and official data from Member States in the area of T&CM. This report reviews global progress in T&CM over the past two decades and is based on contributions from 179 WHO Member States. It provides valuable information for policy-makers, health professionals and the public for capitalizing on the potential contribution of T&CM to health and well-being.
translations.reference: Dabarun na da nufin tallafawa ƙasashe mambobin ƙungiyar wuein samar da tsare-tsare na gaske da aiwatar da tsare-tsaren ayyuka waɗanda za su ƙarfafa rawar da magungunan gargajiya ke takawa wajen kiyaye lafiyar al'umma. Magance ƙalubalen, mayar da martani ga buƙatun da ƙasashe mambobi suka gano, da kuma haɓaka aikin da aka yi a ƙarƙashin dabarun maganin gargajiya na WHO: 2002-2005, dabarun da aka sabunta a lokacin 2014-2023 ya ba da ƙaimi fiye da wanda ya gabace shi don ba da fifiko ga ayyuka da tsare-tsaren kiwon lafiya, waɗanda suka haɗa magungunan gargajiya da na ƙari, da ayyuka masu aiki. Manufofin dabarun su ne: Don gina fage na ilimi don gudanar da aikin T&CM ta hanyar tsare-tsare na ƙasa waɗanda suka dace; Don ƙarfafa tabbatar da inganci da aminci da amfani da T & CM yadda ya dace kuma cikin tasiri ta hanyar kula da magunguna da ayyuka da masu aiki; Don haɓaka shiga ko ina a duniya ta hanyar haɗe ayyukan T&CM cikin gudanar da ayyukan kiwon lafiya da kula da lafiyar kai. Martanin WHO: an samar da rahoton na WHO na duniya game da maganin gargajiya da na ƙari na 2019 don cike giɓin bayanai abin dogaro, sahihi, kuma na hukuma daga Ƙasashe Mambobi na yankin T&CM. Wannan rahoto ya yi duba kan ci gaban duniya a T&CM cikin shekaru ashirin da suka gabata, kuma ya dogara ne kan gudummawar ƙasashe mambobin WHO guda 179. Ya ba da bayanai masu mahimmanci ga masu tsara manufofi, da ƙwararru kan kiwon lafiya, da jama'a don yin amfani da yiwuwar gudummawar T&CM ga lafiya da walwala.
translations.hypothesis: Manufar dabarar ita ce tallafawa ƙasashe mambobi wajen samar da manufofin da za su kawo ci gaba da aiwatar da tsare-tsaren da za su ƙara ƙarfafa rawar da magungunan gargajiya ke takawa wajen kiyaye lafiyar al'umma. Magance ƙalubalen, da amsa buƙatun da ƙasashe mambobi suka gano da kuma ci gaba da aikin da aka yi a ƙarƙashin dabarun magungunan gargajiya na Hukumar Lafiya ta Duniya: 2002-2005, sabon dabarar na tsawon lokacin 2014-2023 ya fi mayar da hankali fiye da wanda ya gabace shi wajen ba da fifiko ga ayyuka da tsarin kiwon lafiya, gami da magunguna da ayyuka da masu aiki da magungunan gargajiya da na haɗaka. Manufofin dabarar sune: Gina tushen ilimi don gudanar da T&CM ta hanyar da ta dace ta hanyar manufofin ƙasa; Don ƙarfafa tabbatar da inganci, aminci, amfani da shi yadda ya kamata da tasirin T&CM ta hanyar daidaita samfura, ayyuka da masu aiki; Don haɓaka ɗaukar hoto na duniya ta hanyar haɗa ayyukan T&CM cikin ayyukan kiwon lafiya da kula da lafiya. Amsar WHO: Rahoton hukumar lafiya ta duniya WHO na shekarar 2019 game da magungunan gargajiya da haɗaka an samar da shi ne don magance giɓin da ake samu a cikin bayanan da za a iya dogara da su, masu inganci da kuma na hukumomi daga ƙasashe mambobi a fannin T&CM. Wannan rahoton ya yi nazarin ci gaban duniya a cikin T&CM a cikin shekaru ashirin da suka gabata kuma ya dogara kan gudummawa daga ƙasashe 179 na WHO. Yana ba da mahimman bayanai ga masu tsara manufofi, ƙwararrun kiwon lafiya da jama'a don yin amfani da yuwuwar gudunmawar T&CM ga lafiya da walwala.

translations.source: Transplantation Overview: Transplantation of human cells, tissues and organs Transplantation of human cells, tissues or organs saves many lives and restores essential functions where no alternatives of comparable effectiveness exist. In 50 years, transplantation has become a successful worldwide practice. However, there are large differences between countries in access to suitable transplantation and in the level of safety, quality, efficacy of donation and transplantation of human cells, tissues and organs. The ethical aspects of transplantation are at the forefront. In particular, the unmet patients’ needs and the shortage of transplants lead to the temptation of trafficking in human body components for transplantation. Human transplantation Human cells and tissues for transplantation can save lives or restore essential functions. For examplea corneal graft can restore sight in corneal blindness;
translations.reference: Dashe Bayani: Dasa tantanin halitta da tishu da gaɓoɓin mutane Dashentantanin halitta ko tishu ko gaɓoɓin jikin mutum na ceton rayuka da yawa kuma yana dawo da ayyuka masu mahimmanci inda babu tasiri madadin su. Cikin shekaru 50, dashe yayi nasara a faɗin duniya. Sai dai akwai babban bambanci tsakanin ƙasashe wajen samun damar dashen da ya dace da kuma matakin aminci da inganci da samun gudummawa da dashen tantanin halitta na ɗan adam da tishu da gaɓoɓi. Abubuwan da suka dace na dashe su ne kan gaba. Musamman, rashin biyan buƙatun marasa lafiya da ƙarancin abin dashe na haifar da yiwuwar fataucin sassan jikin ɗan adam don dasawa. Dashen mutum Tantanin halitta na ɗan adam da tishu don dasawa na iya ceton rayuka ko dawo da ayyuka masu mahimmanci. Misali corneal graft zai iya dawo da gani a makantar corneal;
translations.hypothesis: Kera wasu sassan jiki don saka a jikin wasu. Gamsashshen bayani: Kera wasu sassan jiki don saka a jikin wasu, wato ƙwayoyin halitta da naman mutum da wasu sassan jiki, yana tserar da rayuka da dawo da wasu ayyuka masu muhimmanci, inda babu wasu ayyukan da suke aiki irin haka. A cikin shekaru 50, ƙera wasu sassan jiki don saka a jikin wasu ya zama aiki mai nasara a faɗin duniya. Duk da haka, akwai babban giɓi tsakanin ƙasashe a kan samun damar ƙera wasu sassan jiki da suka dace da matakin tsaro da inganci da tasirin bada gudunmawar da kuma ƙera wasu sassan jiki da ƙwayoyin halitta. Ɓangaren ƙa'idojin ƙere wasu sassan jiki don saka a jikin wasu na gaba-gaba. Musamman, buƙatun marasa lafiya da ba a cika ba da ƙarancin kayan aikin ƙera wasu sassan jiki yana janyo ƙarancin ɗaukar nauyin ɓangarorin jikin mutane don ƙera wasu sassan jiki. Kera wasu sassan jiki don saka a jikin wasu. Ƙwayoyin halitta da naman mutum don ƙera wasu sassan jiki na iya tserar da rayuka ko dawo da wasu ayyuka masu muhimmanci. Misali, ƙera wasu sassan ido na iya dawo da gani ga masu makanta da cutar ido ta korniya;

translations.source: the transplantation of haematopoietic stem cells can cure congenital or acquired diseases including some leukaemias See further information on Haematopoeitic Stem Cells the transplantation of a human heart valve often constitutes the best replacement situation and recipient patients do not require long term anti-coagulation therapy. Xenotransplantation Xenotransplantation, animal to human, defined as living cells, tissues or organs of animal origin and human body fluids, cells, tissues or organs that have ex vivo with these living, xenogeneic materials, has the potential to constitute an alternative to material of human origin and bridge the shortfall in human material for transplantation. Donation: Donations from deceased persons should be developed to their maximum therapeutic potential avoiding, whenever possible, the inherent risks to live donors, as stated in WHO Guiding Principle 3. There is a recognized need for communities, and health professionals, to become better educated about donation and transplantation and that is the key to the success of deceased donation programmes. However, despite the frequent use of materials donated from deceased donors, the donations from living donors are necessary for some types of transplants or to compensate for the limited supply of material available from deceased donors in order to meet patient needs. Living donation is thus practised despite the fact that it involves risks for the donor that may not be negligible. As the procurement of human material for transplantation from deceased or living donors and the subsequent allogeneic transplantation may entail ethical and safety risks for both the recipient and the donor, strict controls and effective oversight should be carried out by the health authorities to protect them.
translations.reference: dashen tantanin halitta na hematopoietic na iya warkar da cututtukan da aka haifi mutum da su ko waɗanda suka samu, waɗanda suka haɗa da wasu daga cikin cutar sankarar bargo. Duba ƙarin bayani akan Tantanin Halitta na Haematopoeitic Sau da yawa dashen bawul na zuciyar ɗan adam yakan zama mafi kyawun yanayin maye gurbi kuma marasa lafiya masu karɓa ba sa buƙatar dogon lokaci na maganin cututtukan sarƙewar jini. Xenotransplantation Xenotransplantation, wato daga dabba zuwa mutum, shi ne rayayyen tantanin halitta ko tishu ko gaɓoɓin asali na dabba da ruwan jikin mutum da tantanin halitta ko tishu ko gaɓoɓin da ke da ex vivo da waɗannan masu ran, da kayan xenogeneic, suna da yiwuwar zama madadin kayan asali na jikin ɗan adam da kuma cike giɓin da ke cikin kayan jikin ɗan adam don dasawa. Gudunmawa: Ya kamata a haɓaka gudummawa daga matattu zuwa iyakar ƙarfinsu don gujewa haɗarin da ke tattare da masu ba da gudummawa gwargwadon iko, kamar yadda aka bayyana a cikin Ƙa’idodin Jagora na 3. Akwai buƙata ga al'ummomi da ƙwararru kan kiwon lafiya ta samun ilimi mai zurfi game da gudummawa da dashe, kuma wannan shi ne mabuɗin samun nasarar shirye-shiryen bayar da gudummawa daga waɗanda da suka mutu. Duk da haka, duk da yawan amfani da kayan da aka ba da gudummawa daga matattu, gudummawar da ake bayarwa daga masu ba da gudummawar rayuwa ya zama dole don wasu nau'ikan dashe ko don rama ƙarancin kayan da ake samu daga masu ba da gudummawar da suka mutu don biyan buƙatun majiyyata. Don haka, ana ba da gudummawar rayuwa duk da cewa tana ƙunshe da haɗari ga mai ba da gudummawa wanda ba za a yi sakaci da shi ba. Yayin da sayan kayan ɗan adam na dashe daga masu bayarwa ga matattu ko masu rai, kuma dashen allogeneic na gaba na iya haifar da haɗari na ɗabi'a da aminci ga duka masu karɓa da mai ba da gudummawa da tsauraran kula da ingantaccen sa ido ya kamata hukumomin lafiya su aiwatar da su don kare su.
translations.hypothesis: Sauyin wuri na ƙwayoyin halittar da ke samar da jini na iya warkar da cututtukan da mutum ya haifi da su ko kuma ya kamu da su wanda ya haɗa da wasu cututtukan da ke haddasa ciwon daji na farko. Ga ƙarin bayani a kan ƙwayoyin halittar da ke samar da jini. Sauyin wuri na zuciyar mutum yawanci shi ne mafi kyawun sauyawa kuma majinyatar ba shi da buƙatar maganin da ke hana ruwan jini. Sauyin wuri daga jikin wani zuwa jikin mutum. Sauyin wuri daga jikin wani zuwa jikin mutum, shi ne sauyin wuri daga jikin dabbobi zuwa jikin mutane, wanda yake nufin ƙwayoyin halitta masu rai, da naman jikin dabbobi da ke samar da ruwan jikin mutum, da ƙwayoyin halitta da naman jikin mutum da suka fito daga waje tare da waɗannan abubuwa masu rai, na iya zama madadin abubuwan da suka fito daga jikin mutum da kuma cike giɓin da ake samu a abubuwan da ake samu daga jikin mutum don sauyin wuri. Tallafi: Ya kamata a bunƙasa tallafin da ake samu daga matattu zuwa mafi kyawarsa ta hanyar magance haɗurran da ke tattare da masu ba da tallafin, kamar yadda yake a ƙa'idar jagorantar WHO ta uku. Akwai buƙatar al'umma da ƙwararrun masana kiwon lafiya su sami ilimi a kan tallafi da kuma sauyin wuri, kuma wannan shi ne babban abin da ke kawo nasarar shirye-shiryen tallafi na matattu. Duk da haka, duk da yawan amfani da kayan da aka ba da gudunmawa daga masu ba da gudunmawar matattu, gudunmawar da masu rayuwa ke bayarwa yana da mahimmanci don wasu nau'ikan sauyawa ko don daidaita ƙarancin kayan da ake samu daga masu ba da gudunmawar matattu don biyan buƙatun marasa lafiya. Don haka ana aiwatar da ba da gudunmawar rayuwa duk da cewa yana ƙunshe da haɗari ga mai ba da gudunmawar wanda ba a iya ƙin la'akari da shi ba. Kamar yadda samun kayan mutum don sauya wuri daga masu ba da gudunmawar matattu ko masu rayuwa da kuma sauyin wuri na gaba na allogeneic na iya haifar da haɗari na ɗabi'a da aminci ga duka masu karɓar da mai ba da gudunmawa, ya kamata hukumomin kiwon lafiya su gudanar da tsauraran lura da sa ido don kare su.

translations.source: The Guiding Principles mandate optimal care for donors and recipients. The transparent oversight of the health authorities over donation and transplantation activities is also essential to increase the trust of the public in the system. In addition, the decision to be a donor is often based on the understanding that a contribution to the availability of transplant resources may someday benefit the health needs of the donor’s family. If we are prepared to receive a transplant should we need one, then we should be ready to give Ethics: WHO Guiding Principles on Human Cell, Tissue and Organ Transplantation In 1987 the fortieth World Health Assembly, concerned at the trade for profit in human organs, initiated the preparation of the first WHO Guiding Principles on Transplantation, endorsed by the Assembly in 1991 in resolution WHA44.25. These Guiding Principles have greatly influenced professional codes and practices as well as legislation around the world during almost two decades. After a consultation process that took several years, the Sixty-third World Health Assembly adopted resolution WHA63.22 on 21 May 2010, endorsing the updated WHO Guiding Principles and identifying areas of progress to optimize donation and transplantation practices. The Declaration of Istanbul Professionals of donation and transplantation from all regions, through many of their organizations and institutions, are endorsing the Declaration of Istanbul on organ trafficking and transplant tourism developed under the leadership of the Transplantation Society and the International Society of Nephrology in May 2008.
translations.reference: Ƙa'idodin Jagora sun ba da umarni mai kyakkyawar kulawa ga masu bayarwa da masu karɓa. Sa ido a fili na hukumomin lafiya kan ayyukan bayar da agaji da ayyukan dashe yana da matuƙar muhimmanci wajen ƙara amincewar jama'a kan tsarin. Bugu da ƙari, sau da dama yanke shawarar zama mai bayarwa ya dogara ne kan fahimtar cewa gudummawar da aka samu don samar da dashen zai iya amfanar da buƙatun lafiyar iyalin mai bayarwa. Idan mun shirya karɓar dasshe idan muna da buƙatar hakan, to ya kamata mu kasance a shirye don bayarwa Ɗa'a: Ƙa'idodin Jagora na WHO kan Dashen Tantanin halitta da Tishu da Gaɓoɓin Jiki A 1987, Majalisar Kiwon Lafiya ta Duniya ta arba'in, ta damu da kasuwanci don riba kan sassan jikin mutum, ta fara shirye-shiryen Ƙa'idodin Jagora na farko na WHO game da dashe, wanda Majalisar ta amince da shi a 1991 a ƙuduri na WHA44.25. Waɗannan Ƙa'idodin Jagora sun yi tasiri sosai ga ƙa'idodin ƙwararru da ayyuka da kuma dokoki a duk duniya cikin kusan shekaru ashirin. Bayan tuntuɓa wadda ta ɗauki shekaru da yawa, Majalisar Kiwon Lafiya ta Duniya ta Sittin da Uku ta amince da ƙuduri na WHA63.22 a ranar 21 ga Mayu 2010, tare da amincewa da sabunta Ƙa'idodin Jagororanci na WHO da gano wuraren ci gaba don inganta ayyukan ba da gudummawa da dasawa. Sanarwar Istanbul Ƙwararru na ba da gudummawa da dasawa daga dukan yankuna, ta hanyar ƙungiyoyi da cibiyoyi da yawa, suna goyon bayan Sanarwar Istanbul game da fataucin sassan jiki da yawon shaƙatawa da aka bunƙasa a ƙarƙashin jagorancin ƙungiyar dashe da kuma Ƙungiya Nephrology ta Ƙasa-da-ƙasa a watan Mayun 2008.

translations.source: Travel and health Overview: International travel can pose various risks to health, depending on the characteristics of both the traveller and the travel. Travellers may encounter sudden and significant changes in altitude, humidity, microbes, and temperature, which can result in ill-health. In addition, serious health risks may arise in areas where accommodation is of poor quality, hygiene and sanitation are inadequate, medical services are not well developed and clean water is unavailable. International travel is on the rise, as millions of people travel for professional, social, recreational and humanitarian purposes each year. All travellers must prepare for the variety of health risks they can be exposed to in unfamiliar environments before, during and after they travel. People planning to travel should seek advice on the potential hazards in their chosen destinations and understand how best to protect their health and minimize the risk of acquiring disease. Forward planning, appropriate preventive measures and careful precautions can protect the health of travellers, and minimize the risks of accident and of acquiring disease. Although the medical profession and the travel industry can provide extensive help and sound advice, it remains the traveller’s responsibility to seek information, to understand the risks involved and to take the necessary precautions to protect their health while travelling. translations.reference: Tafiya da lafiya Taƙaitaccen Bayani: Tafiya tsakanin ƙasashe na iya barazana na haɗari daban-daban ga lafiya, wanda ya danganta da yanayin matafiyin da ita tafiyar. Matafiya na iya haɗuwa da mahimman canje-canje a lokaci guda a cikin ladabi da yanayin zafi da ƙwayoyin halitta da zafin jiki waɗanda zasu iya haifar da rashin lafiya. Bugu da ƙari, munanan haɗarurruka ga lafiya na iya fitowa a cikin wuraren da babu wadata da ingancin tsaftar jiki da muhalli, ayyukan likitanci ba a tsara su da kyau ba haka kuma babu tsaftataccen ruwa. Tafiya tsakanin ƙasashe na ƙaruwa, yadda ya zama miliyoyin mutane ke tafiya don aiki, zamantakewa, nishaɗi da kuma dalilai na aikin jin ƙaidalilai kowace shekara. Dole ne dukkanin matafiya su shirya don nau'ikan haɗari ga lafiya da za a iya samu cikin yanayin da ba a sani ba a kafin da yayin da kuma bayan tafiya. Ya kamata mutane da ke shirin tafiya su nemi shawara kan haɗarin da za su iya samu a wurin da zasu je kuma su fahimci hanyar da zasu kare lafiyarsu da kuma yadda zasu rage haɗarin kamuwa da cuta. Shirin gaba sune, matakan da suka dace da taka tsantsan na iya kare lafiyar matafiya, kuma suna rage haɗarin haɗari da samun cuta. Kodayake masana'antar likitanci da masana'antar tafiye-tafiye na iya samar da taimako mai yawa da kuma shawara kyau, ya kasance da alhakin matafiya ne neman bayanai da fahimtar haɗarurrukan da ke ƙunshe da kuma ɗaukan matakan kariya da suka dace don kiyaye lafiyarsu yayin tafiya. Haɗari: Yayin tantance haɗarurrukan lafiya na tafiya ƙasashen a duniya, ya kamata matafiya da ma'aikatan kiwon lafiya suyi la'akari da waɗannan manyan abubuwan da za a kawo:
translations.hypothesis: Harkar tafiye-tafiye da lafiya Gamsashshen bayani: Tafiye-tafiye zuwa ƙasashen duniya na iya haifar da haɗurran lafiya daban-daban, ya danganta da yanayin matafiyi da kuma yanayin tafiyar. Matafiya na iya fuskantar canje-canje masu yawa da gaggawa a yanayin iska da yanayin zafi da ƙanana ƙwayoyin cuta da kuma yanayin yanayin zafi, wanda hakan na iya haifar da rashin lafiya. Bugu da ƙari, haɗurran lafiya masu yawa na iya haifar da matsala a wuraren da wuraren kwancin ba su da inganci da tsafta da kuma rashin tsaftar muhalli da rashin ingancin ayyukan lafiya da rashin samun ruwa mai tsafta. Harkar tafiye-tafiye zuwa ƙasashen duniya na ƙara yawa, yayin da miliyoyin mutane ke tafiye-tafiye don aikin yi da zamantakewa da nishaɗi da ayyukan jin-ƙai a kowace shekara. Duk matafiya dole su shirya matsalolin lafiya da yawa da za su iya fuskanta a wuraren da ba su saba da su ba kafin da yayin da kuma bayan su yi tafiya. Mutanen da ke shirin yin tafiya ya kamata su nemi shawara game da haɗurran da ke tattare da wuraren da suka zaɓa su fahimci yadda za su kare lafiyarsu da rage haɗarin kamuwa da cuta. Shirya tafiya da matakan riga-kafi da kuma kiyaye kai da kulawa zai kare lafiyar matafiya, da rage haɗurran haɗari da kamuwa da cuta. Duk da cewa aikin likitanci da masana’antar tafiye-tafiye na iya ba da taimako mai yawa da kuma shawarar da ta dace, ya kasance nauyin matafiyi ne ya nemi bayanai, don fahimtar haɗurran da ke tattare da shi da kuma ɗaukar matakan da suka dace don kare lafiyarsa yayin da yake tafiya. Haɗari: Yayin da ake ƙimanta haɗurran lafiya na tafiye-tafiye zuwa ƙasashen duniya, matafiya da ƙwararrun masana kiwon lafiya ya kamata su yi la'akari da waɗannan abubuwa masu muhimmanci:
