translations.source: It also hurts the economic and social health of their families, communities, and countries. While some women are more at risk than others, violence can happen to any woman, in any country – regardless of culture, religion or economic status. Gender inequality including harmful gender norms are key drivers of violence against women. Violence can negatively affect women’s physical, mental, sexual, and reproductive health. It is associated with increased risk of injuries, depression, anxiety disorders, unplanned pregnancies, sexually transmitted infections, HIV and many other health problems. Children who grow up in families where there is violence may suffer a range of behavioural and emotional disturbances. These can lead to mental and development problems and also be associated with perpetrating or experiencing violence later in life. WHO response: WHO plays a key role in bringing attention to and responding to violenceagainst women as a public health and gender equality issue through: Research and evidence-building to highlight the magnitude of violence against women, its risk factors and consequences, and to identify effective interventions for prevention and response. Developing guidelines and tools, setting norms and standards for an effective health response to violence against women.
translations.reference: Haka kuma yana shafar tattalin arziƙi da lafiyar iyali da al’umma da ma ƙasashen da ake samun hakan. Kodayake da wasu matan sun fi wasu fuskantar wannan barazana, sai dai cin zarafi abu ne da kowacce mace na iya fuskanta a kowacce ƙasa ba tare da la’akari da al’ada ko addini ko yanayin tattalin arziƙi ba. Rashin daidaito na jinsi da wasu al’adu game da jinsi su ne musabbabin cin zarafin mata. Cin zarafi kan iya illata mata a zahiri ko a baɗili ko fuskar saduwa ko lafiyar mahaifarsu. Ana alaƙanta hakan da ƙaruwar ciwuka na fili da cutar damuwa da larura ta yawan fargaba da samun juna biyu da kamuwa da cututtuka masu yaɗuwa da HIV da sauran matsaloli na lafiya. Yaran da suka taso a gidajen da ake fuskantar cin zarafi kan gamu da matsaloli da kan shafi ɗabi’arsu. Wannan kan shafi tsarin bunƙasa tunani da kuma ke tasiri wajen fuskanta ko aikata cin zarafin a rayuwar mutum. Matakin Hukumar Lafiya ta Duniya: Hukumar Lafiya ta Duniya ta taka muhimmiyar rawa wajen jan hankali ga abin da ya shafi cin zarafin mata a matsayin lamari da ya shafi lafiya da rashin daidaito na jinsi ta hanyar: Bincike da tattara hujjoji wajen nuna girman matsalar cin zarafin mata da illolinta da sakamakonta da kuma zaƙulo sahihan hanyoyin kai ɗauki domin hana afkuwar hakan da tallafawa. Samar da tsari na cigaba da ƙirƙirar dokoki da cimma matsaya ingantacciya wajen duba lafiyar matan da suka fuskanci cin zarafi.
translations.hypothesis: Hakan yana raunana lafiyar tattalin arziƙi da zamantakewa ga iyalansu, al'ummarsu, da ƙasashensu. Yayin da wasu mata ke fuskantar barazanar kamuwa da cutar fiye da wasu, cin zarafi na iya faruwa ga kowane mata, a kowace ƙasa - ba tare da la'akari da al'ada, addini ko matsayin tattalin arziƙi ba. Rashin daidaiton jinsi wanda ya haɗa da munanan ɗabi'un jinsi sune manyan abubuwan da ke haifar da cin zarafi ga mata. Cin zarafi na iya yin illa ga lafiyar jiki, da ta ƙwaƙwalwa, da ta jinsi, da ta haifuwa. Yana da alaƙa da haɗarin samun raunuka, da damuwa, da cututtukan damuwa, da ɗaukar ciki ba tare da tsari ba, da cututtukan da ake ɗauka ta hanyar jima'i, da HIV da wasu matsalolin lafiya da yawa. Yara da suka fara girma a cikin iyalai inda ake cin zarafi na iya fuskantar matsalolin halayya da tunani. Waɗannan za su iya haifar da matsalolin ƙwaƙwalwa da ci gaba kuma su yi daidai da cin zarafi ko fuskantar cin zarafi a gaba a rayuwa. Amsar WHO: WHO tana taka rawa wajen janyo hankali da kuma ɗaukar mataki kan cin zarafi ga mata a matsayin al'amarin lafiyar jama'a da kuma daidaiton jinsi ta hanyar: Bincike da gina shaidu don nuna girman cin zarafin da ake yi wa mata, da haɗurran sa da sakamako, da kuma gano ingantattun matakai don rigakafi da ɗaukar mataki. Samar da jagorori da kayan aiki, da kafa ƙa'idoji da ma'auni don ingantaccen matakin kiwon lafiya ga cin zarafi ga mata.

translations.source: Strengthening country capacity of health systems and providers to prevent and respond to violence against women. Encouraging leadership in health systems and building political will to address violence against women through advocacy and partnerships. The WHO 13th General Programme of Work (GPW) includes violence against women as part of its contribution to Sustainable Development Goal (SDG) 5 on gender equality and women’s empowerment (specifically, SDG 5.2 on the elimination of violence against women and girls). At the World Health Assembly in May 2016, Member States endorsed a global plan of action on strengthening the role of the health systems in addressing interpersonal violence, in particular against women and girls and against children.
translations.reference: Inganta tsarin kiwon lafiya na ƙasa wajen magance da tallafa wa batun cin zarafin mata. Ƙarfafa wa shugabanni guiwa ta fuskar tsarin kiwon lafiya da ƙarfafa musu wajen ɗaukar matakai na wayar da kai da haɗin guiwa game da matsalar cin zarafin mata. Hukumar Lafiya ta Duniya ta sanya cin zarafin mata a cikin Kudin Muradan Ayyukanta karo 13 (GPW) a matsayin wani ɓangare na Manufofin Samar da Cigaba Mai Ɗorewa (SDG) na batu kan daidaiton jinsi da tallafa wa mata (musamman, SDG 5.2, kawo ƙarshen cin zarafin mata da yara mata) A yayin Taron Ƙoli Hukumar Lafiya na Duniya da aka yi a watan Mayun 2016, mambobin hukumar sun nunaA yayin Taron Ƙoli Hukumar Lafiya na Duniya da aka yi a watan Mayun 2016, mambobin hukumar sun nuna goyon bayansu ga matakin inganta kiwon lafiya wajen magance cin zarafi na tsakanin mutane musamman ga mata da yara mata da ƙananan yara.
translations.hypothesis: Ƙarfafa ƙarfin ƙasa na tsarin kiwon lafiya da masu samarwa don hana da kuma ɗaukar mataki kan cin zarafin mata. Ƙarfafa jagoranci a cikin tsarin kiwon lafiya da gina ra'ayin siyasa don magance cin zarafin mata ta hanyar ba da shawara da haɗin gwiwa. Shirin Babban Aikin WHO na 13 (GPW) ya haɗa da cin zarafin mata a matsayin wani ɓangare na gudunmawar sa ga Manufar Ci Gaba Mai Ɗorewa (SDG) 5 kan daidaiton jinsi da ƙarfafa mata (musamman, SDG 5.2 kan kawar da cin zarafin mata da yara mata). A Taron Kiwon Lafiya na Duniya a watan Mayun 2016, ƙasashe mambobin taron sun amince da wani shirin aiki na duniya kan ƙarfafa rawar da tsarin kiwon lafiya ke takawa wajen magance cin zarafin mutane, musamman a kan mata da yara mata da kuma a kan yara.

translations.source: Wildfires Overview: Wildfires are increasing around the globe in frequency, severity and duration, heightening the need to understand the health effects of wildfire exposure. The risk of wildfires grows in extremely dry conditions, such as drought, heat waves and during high winds.Wildfire smoke is a mixture of hazardous air pollutants, such PM2.5, NO2, ozone, aromatic hydrocarbons, or lead. In addition to contaminating the air with toxic pollutants, wildfires also simultaneously impact the climate by releasing large quantities of carbon dioxide and other greenhouse gases into the atmosphere. With climate change leading to warmer temperatures and drier conditions and the increasing urbanization of rural areas, the fire season is starting earlier and ending later. Wildfire events are getting more extreme in terms of acres burned, duration and intensity, and they can disrupt transportation, communications, water supply, and power and gas services. Impact: Wildfires that burn near populated areas can have significant impact on the environment, property, livestock and human mortality and morbidity depending on the size, speed and proximity to the fire, and whether the population has advanced warning to evacuate. Wildfire smoke is a mixture of air pollutants of which particulate matter (PM) is the principal public health threat. PM2.5 from wildfire smoke is associated with premature deaths in the general population, and can cause and exacerbate diseases of the lungs, heart, brain/nervous system, skin, gut, kidney, eyes, nose and liver. It has also been shown to lead to cognitive impairment and memory loss.
translations.reference: Gobarar daji Taƙaitaccen bayani: yawan ƙaruwar afkuwar gobarar daji abu ne da ke nuni da buƙatar fahimtar ƙalubale na lafiya da wutar daji ke da shi ga waɗanda ya ritsa da su. Illar wutar daji na ƙaruwa matuƙa a wuri da ke ƙamfar ruwa kamar inda ake da ƙarancin ruwan sama da tsananin zafi da iska mai ƙarfi. Hayaƙin wutar daji na ɗauke da sinadai masu guba da ke gurɓata iska kamar PM2.5 da ozone da hydrocarbon ko lead. Sannan, game da batun gurɓata iska da sinadarai masu guba, gobarar daji a lokaci guda na shafar sauyin yanayi ta hanyar fitar da iska ga sararin samaniya a matsayin hayaƙin da ke ɗauke da kabon-dai-oksida da sauran nau'ikan iska da ke cuɗanya da zafi. La'akari da sauyin yanayi da ke kan gaba wajen ɗumama yanayi da yanayi bushewar wuri da ƙaruwar ɗabi'ar mai da ƙauyuka birane, akwai yuwuwar gobarar na iya fara ruruwa da wuri da kuma ɗaukar lokaci mai ɗan tsawo. afkuwar gobarar daji na cikgaba da tsananta ta hanyar ƙone kadada mai yawa da irin lokaci da ƙarfin da gobarar ke da shi wanda tana iya kawo cikas ga harkokin sufuri da sadarwa da samar da ruwan sha da samar da makamashi da iskar gas. Tasiri: gobarar daji da ke ƙone wurare masu cukowar al'umma zai iya shafar muhalli da dukiya da dabbobi da ɗabi'u da kamuwa da cutattuka duk da ya danganta da girman wurin da sauri da kusanci da gobarar da kuma yuwuwar samun gargaɗi na barin wurin da abin ka iya faruwa. hayaƙin gobarar daji haɗe yake da batun gurɓata iska wanda ya sanya ta ɗaya daga cikin lura a fannin lafiyar al'umma. ana alaƙanta mutuwar fuju'a ta mutane da sinadarai masu girman PM2.5 da ake samu a cikin iskar gobarar daji wanda kuma ke taɓarɓara cutattukan da suka shafi hunhu da na zuciya da tsarin zubin ƙwaƙwalwa da jijiyoyi da fata da hanji da ƙoda da idanu da hanci da hanta. sannan bincike ya tabbatar da cewa takan iya shafar sashen tunanin abin da aka saba yi na ƙwaƙwalwa da mantuwa.
translations.hypothesis: Wutar daji Gamsashshen bayani: Wutar daji na ƙaruwa a faɗin duniya a yawan faruwa da tsananin faruwa da tsawon lokacin faruwar su, wanda ke ƙara buƙatar fahimtar illolin lafiya na bayyanar wutar daji. Haɗarin wutar daji na ƙaruwa a cikin yanayi mai tsananin bushe, kamar fari, tsananin zafi da yayin iska mai ƙarfi. Huda wutar daji wani wari ne na gurɓatattun iska, kamar su PM2.5, NO2, ozone, aromatic hydrocarbons, ko gubar dalma. Baya ga gurɓata iska da sinadaran guba, wutar daji tana kuma haifar da illa ga yanayi ta hanyar sakin sinadarin carbon dioxide da wasu sinadaran mai haifar da guba a cikin iska. Da sauyin yanayi ke haifar da yanayin zafi da bushe da kuma ƙaruwar birane a yankuna masu nisa, lokacin wutar yana farawa da wuri kuma yana ƙarewa da wuri. Al'amuran wutar daji suna ƙara tsananin yanayi ta ɓangaren filin da aka ƙona, da tsawon lokaci da ƙarfi, kuma suna iya daƙile sufuri, sadarwa, samar da ruwa, da kuma wutar lantarki da gas. Tasiri: Wutar daji da ke ƙanƙama wuraren da ke da mutane za ta iya haifar da babban illi ga muhalli, da dukiya, da dabbobi da mace-mace da ciwuka ga mutane ya danganta da girman wutar da saurin da nisan da wutar, da kuma ko an ba mutanen isasshen gargaɗi kafin a bar wurin. Huda wutar daji wani wari ne na gurɓatattun iska wanda sinadarin particulate matter (PM) shi ne babban barazanar lafiyar jama'a. PM2.5 daga hayaƙin wutar daji yana da alaƙa da mutuwar mutane ba akan lokacin da ya kamata ba a cikin al'umma gaba ɗaya, kuma yana iya haifar da cututtuka da ƙara tsananin ciwon huhu, zuciya, ƙwaƙwalwa/juyayi, fata, hanji, ƙoda, idanu, hanci da hanta. Haka kuma an nuna cewa yana haifar da nakasar ƙwaƙwalwa da kuma mantauwa.

translations.source: Firefighters and emergency response workers are also greatly impacted by injuries, burns and smoke inhalation, particularly at high concentrations. More interdisciplinary research is warranted to understand the latent and long-term health effects of wildfire exposure on vulnerable populations (children, older people, pregnant people, chronically ill people), particularly for geographic areas enduring repeated and cyclical exposure to these wildﬁre events. WHO Response: The magnitude of the physical and human costs from wildfires can be reduced if adequate emergency prevention, preparedness, response and recovery measures are implemented in a sustainable and timely manner. Working with Member States, WHO helps to build resilient and proactive health systems that can anticipate the needs and challenges during emergencies, so that we can be more likely to reduce risks and respond effectively when needed. WHO works with partners in preparing, preventing, detecting, responding and recovering from emergencies and disasters, including environmental exposures, such asimplementing early warning systems and issuing health and air quality advisories; containing the release of hazardous materials; assessing health needs of the community and infrastructure damage; restoring primary care services, like immunization, child and maternal health, and mental health; strengthening human resources for disaster management; collecting, analysing and disseminating information related to emergencies and disasters that are likely to occur in a region; establishing and managing stocks of relief supplies and equipment;
translations.reference: Masu kashe gobarar dajin da jami'an kai ɗauki na gamuwa da raunuka da shaƙar iska da yawa. bincike a fannoni daban-daban ya nuna irin tasirin na dogon lokaci da gobarar daji ke da shi ga lafiyar masu fama da ita (yara da tsofaffi da masu juna biyu da masu fama da cuta mai tsanani) musamman a wurare da ake yawan samun afkuwar gobarar daji akai-akai. Matakin Hukumar Lafiya ta Duniya: za a iya rage yadda gobarar daji ke shafar al'umma idan aka samar da wadatattun hanyoyin magance ta da gaggawa da zaman ko-ta-kwana da tabbatar da matakan kai ɗauki a kan lokaci ba tare da wata gazawa ba. Yin aiki tare da ƙasashen mambobin Hukumar Lafiya ta Duniya wajen taimaka musu su samar da tabbataccen tsarin kiwon lafiya da zai uta fuskantar ƙalubale na gaggawa da ka iya tasowa ta yadda za a iya rage haɗari da kai dauki a lokacin da ya dace. Hukumar Lafiya ta Duniya na yin aiki da masu haɗin guiwa wajen shiryawa da magancewa da ganowa da farfaɗowa daga yanayi na gaggawa ko annoba, har ma da jan hankalin al'umman da ke fuskantar barazanar gobarar ta hanyar gargaɗinsu a kan lokaci da ba shawarwari na kiwon lafiya da na ingancin matsayin iskar da ake shaƙa.; Ba da bayanai na abubuwa masu haɗari da duba matakin kiwon lafiya da al'umma ke buƙata da na kayan more rayuwar da aka yi asara.; Maido da kiwon lafiya a matakin farko kamar rigakafi da inganta lafiyar mata da ƙananan yara da lafiyar ƙwaƙwalwa da kula da al'umma wajen magance afkuwar annobar.; Ƙarfafar shirin mutane don bada kulawa kan afkuwar ibtila’i.; ƙarɓa da yaɗa bayanai masu alaƙa da yanayi na buƙatar gaggawa da annoba da ake hasashen suna iya faruwa a wani yanki; assasa da kula da kayan tallafi da sauran kayayyaki.;
translations.hypothesis: Masu kashe gobara da ma'aikatan bada agajin gaggawa suma suna gamuwa da ciwuka da ƙuna da shaƙewa, musamman a wuraren da suke da yawan hayaƙi. Ana buƙatar ƙarin bincike a kan fannoni daban-daban don fahimtar illolin da keɓanta da na dogon lokaci na hatsarurrukan wutar daji ga mutanen da suka fi saurin fuskanta (yara da tsofaffi da mata masu ciki da masu fama da ciwuka masu tsanani), musamman a wuraren da suke fama da sake dawowar wutar daji akai-akai. Matakan Hukumar WHO: Ana iya rage girman asarar rayuka da ta kayan amfani da wutar daji idan aka samar da isassun matakan riga-kafi da shiri da kai agaji da farfaɗowa a bisa tsari mai ɗorewa kuma a kan lokaci. Aiki tare da ƙasashe, Hukumar Lafiya ta Duniya WHO tana taimakawa wajen gina tsarin kiwon lafiya mai ƙarfi da zai iya fuskantar buƙatu da ƙalubale a lokacin buƙatu, ta yanda za mu iya rage haɗari da kuma kai ɗauki a kan lokaci. Hukumar Lafiya ta Duniya WHO tana aiki tare da abokan hulɗa wajen shiri da riga-kafi da gano da kai ɗauki da farfaɗowa daga matsalolin da suka faru da bala'i, wanda ya haɗa da hatsarurrukan muhalli, kamar aiwatar da tsarin gargaɗi na wuri da bayar da shawarwari na lafiya da ingancin iska; daƙile fitar da abubuwa masu hatsari; kimanta buƙatun al'umma da ababen more rayuwa; dawo da ayyukan kiwon lafiya na matakin farko, kamar rigakafi da lafiyar yaro da ta uwa, da lafiyar ƙwaƙwalwa; ƙarfafa albarkatun ɗan'adam don kula da bala'i; tattara da nazari da rarraba bayanai masu alaƙa da agajin gaggawa da bala'i waɗanda za su iya faruwa a wani yanki; kafa da sarrafa kayan tallafi da kayan aiki;

translations.source: calling for emergency funding to support health action; and developing national policies, recommendations and national emergency response plans.
translations.reference: Yin kira wajen samar da kuɗin tallafawa wajen ɗaukar mataki na kiwon lafiya; da samar da tsare-tsare na ƙasa da shawarwari da tsara yadda za a ba da agajin gaggawa a mataki na ƙasa.
translations.hypothesis: Kiran tallafin kuɗi na gaggawa don tallafawa ayyukan kiwon lafiya; da Samar da manufofin ƙasa, shawarwari da tsare-tsaren gaggawa na ƙasa.

translations.source: Women's health Overview: Being a man or a woman has a significant impact on health, as a result of both biological and gender-related differences. The health of women and girls is of particular concern because, in many societies, they are disadvantaged by discrimination rooted in sociocultural factors. For example, women and girls face increased vulnerability to HIV/AIDS. Some of the sociocultural factors that prevent women and girls to benefit from quality health services and attaining the best possible level of health include: unequal power relationships between men and women; social norms that decrease education and paid employment opportunities; an exclusive focus on women’s reproductive roles; and potential or actual experience of physical, sexual and emotional violence. While poverty is an important barrier to positive health outcomes for both men and women, poverty tends to yield a higher burden on women and girls’ health due to, for example, feeding practices (malnutrition) and use of unsafe cooking fuels (COPD).
translations.reference: Kiwon lafiyar mata Taƙaitaccen bayani: kasancewa namiji ko mace abu ne mai muhimmanci ga batun lafiya saboda irin bambance-bambance da ke samu na halitta. Lafiyar mata da ƙananan yara mata na da muhimmanci domin a wasu al'ummatan sukan rasa gata saboda bambanci da ke da alaƙa da al'ada ta rayuwar yau da kullum. Ga misali mata da ƙananan yara mata na fuskantar barazanar kamuwa da HIV/AIDS. wasu daga ciki dalilai masu alaƙa da al'ada ta yau da kullum da ke daƙile mata daga samun ingantaccen kulawa ta lafiya sun hada da: bambancin iko da ke akwai tsakanin maza da mata; Tsarin zamantakewa da ke daƙile ilimi da batun damarmaki na aikin da za a biya mutum; Ba wa ɓangaren batun rawar mata wajen haihuwa muhimmanci; da da kuma fuskantar cin zarafi na sarari ko na fannin saduwa ko na imoshan. Duk da talauci na taka rawa wajen kawo cikas ga samun ingantaccen kiwon lafiya ga maza da mata; mata da ƙananan yara mata sun fi fuskantar ƙalubalen talauci, ga misali ɓangaren cin abinci (rashin wadataccen abinci) da amfani da abin girki masu illa (COPD).
translations.hypothesis: Lafiyar mata Gamsashshen bayani: Zama namiji ko mace yana da tasiri sosai ga lafiya, sakamakon bambance-bambance tsakanin halitta da jinsi. Lafiyar mata manya da yara ita ce babban abin damuwa saboda, a al'ummomi da yawa, ana nuna musu bambanci ta hanyar wariyar da ke da tushe a cikin abubuwan al'ada da zamantakewa. Misali, mata manya da yara suna fuskantar haɗari sosai na kamuwa da cuta mai karya garkuwar jiki. Wasu daga cikin abubuwan al'ada da zamantakewa da ke hana mata manya da yara samun damar yin amfani da ingantattun ayyukan kiwon lafiya da kuma samun mafi kyawata matakin samun lafiya sun haɗa da: rashin daidaiton alaƙar iko tsakanin namiji da mata; ƙa'idojin zamantakewa da ke rage ilimi da damarmakin samun aiki mai albashi; mai da hankali gaba ɗaya kan rawar da mata ke takawa wajen haifar 'ya'a; da kuma yuwuwar ko ainihin gogewa na cin zarafin jiki, jima'i da tunani. Yayin da talauci ya kasance babban toshewar samun kyakkyawan sakamako na kiwon lafiya ga duka maza da mata, talauci na daɗaɗɗa ya fi zama nauyi ga lafiyar mata manya da yara saboda, misali, ɗabi'un cin abinci (rashin cin abinci mai gina jiki) da amfani da makamashin girki mara aminci (COPD).

translations.source: Yaws (Endemic treponematoses) Overview: Yaws is a chronic skin infection characterized by papillomas (noncancerous lumps) and ulcers. It is caused by the bacterium Treponema pallidum subspecies pertenue, which belongs to the same group of bacteria that causes venereal syphilis. Yaws primarily affects children aged under 15 years who live in poor communities in warm, humid and tropical forested areas of Africa, Asia, Latin America and the Pacific islands. The majority of affected populations live rural areas, far from health services. Poverty, low socio-economic conditions and poor personal hygiene facilitate the spread of yaws. Although there are over 80 000 cases of yaws each year, experts believe the disease can be controlled and ultimately eradicated for several reasons. First, it only occurs in humans, not animals, making control much easier. It is also easy to treat with readily available drugs and has already been eliminated in some countries, including India. The remaining pockets of yaws infection, although usually in remote places, means further spread is less likely with proper surveillance and control measures.
translations.reference: cutar fata (Endemic treponematoses) Taƙaitaccen bayani: cutar fata ta Yaws cutar fata ce mai tsananin gaske da ke da yanayi na kumburi da gyambo (ciwo). Bakteriyar da ake kira Treponema Pallidum ce ke haifar da wannan cutar fata wacce aka sanya ta cikin kashin baktariyar da ke haifar da sifilis da ake samu ta hanyar saduwa. cutar fata ta Yaws ta fi shafar yara 'yan ƙasa da shekaru 15 da ke rayuwa cikin talauci a wuri mai yanayin zafi a yankin Afirka da Asiya da Latin America da tsibirin Fasifik. Mafi yawan waɗanda ke kamuwa da cutar na rayuwa ne a ƙauyuka da ke da nisa da wuraren kiwon lafiya. Talauci da yanayi na rashin abin hannu da rashin tsabta ne ke taimakawa wajen yaɗuwar cutar fata ta Yaws. duk da akwai rahotanni 80000 na kamuwa da cutar fata ta Yaws a duk shekara, masana sun yi amanna cewa za a iya magance cutar da ma kawar da ita saboda da dalilai masu yawa. Da farko dai ana samun cutar ne a cikin bil'Adama ba dabba ba wanda ke nuna sauƙin magance cutar. Za a iya magance cutar cikin sauƙi ta hanyar amfani da magunguna da tuni akwai su kamar yadda aka yi nasarar kawar da cutar a wasu ƙasashe kamar Indiya. Wasu 'yan ƙalilan da ke da cutar na zaune a keɓantattun wurare wanda hakan ke nuna sauƙin daƙile yaɗuwarta idana aka yi amfani da matakai na bibiya da kulawa.
translations.hypothesis: Cutar Yaws (Endemic treponematoses) Gamsashshen bayani: Cutar Yaws cuta ce mai tsananin gajeren da take da alaomin ƙuraje da ciwon fata. Ana kamuwa da ita ne ta hanyar ƙwayar cutar Treponema pallidum subspecies pertenue, wadda take cikin rukunin ƙwayoyin cutar da ke haifar da cutar ƙaiƙayin jiki. Yawanci cutar Yaws tana shafar yara 'yan kasa da shekaru 15 da ke zaune a cikin al'ummomi masu fama da talauci a wurare masu zafi, zafi da wuraren da ke da bishiyoyi a Afirka, Asiya, Latin Amurka da tsibirin Pacific. Mafi yawancin mutanen da suka kamu da cutar suna zaune a yankunan karkara, nesa da wuraren kiwon lafiya. Talauci, matsalolin tattalin arziƙi da rashin tsafta na jiki suna taimakawa wajen yaɗuwar cutar Yaws. Duk da akwai fiye da 80 000 mutanen da ke fama da cutar Yaws a kowace shekara, masana sun yi imanin za a iya shawo kan cutar sannan a kawar da ita gaba ɗaya saboda dalilai da yawa. Na farko, tana faruwa ne kawai ga mutane, ba ga dabbobi ba, wanda hakan ya sanya shawo kan ta ya zama mai sauƙi. Haka kuma yana da sauƙin wajen magancewa ta hanyar amfani da magunguna da ake samu, kuma tabbas an kawar da ita a wasu ƙasashen, wanda suka haɗa da Indiya. Ragowar cutar Yaws, duk da cewa yawanci a wurare masu nisa, yana nufin wataƙila ba zai ci gaba da yaɗuwa ba tare da sa ido da matakan shawo kan cutar ba.

translations.source: Symptoms: There are two stages of yaws infection. The early stage is when the patient is infectious and can spread the disease to others. In this stage, a papule (a noncancerous, outward-growing lump) develops at the site of infection. This papule is full of the organisms and may persist for 3–6 months followed by natural healing. Without treatment, this is followed by disseminated skin lesions over the body. Bone pain and bone lesions may also occur. The second stage is noninfectious and typically appears five years after infection. It is characterized by disabling consequences of the nose, bones and palmar/plantar hyperkeratosis (thickening). After a field diagnosis based on these symptoms, the disease can be confirmed by examining a sample from a skin legion under a special type of microscope (darkfield examination). Blood tests are not typically used because yaws is closely related to the bacterium that causes syphilis and the two diseases will show the same result.
translations.reference: Alamomin kamuwa: Akwai matakai biyu na kwamuwa da cutar fata ta Yaws. mataki na farko shi ne matakin da mai larurar ke ɗauke da cutar kuma zai iya yaɗawa ga sauran mutane. a wannan mataki a kan samu ɓullowar ƙurji (wanda bai shafi kansa ba da ke ɓullowa kamar ƙurji) wanda ke fara girma da zarar mutum ya kamu da shi. ƙurjin yana dauke da ƙwayar cutar da kuma kan ɗauki watanni 3-6 ana maganinsa. Idan kuma ba a ɗauki mataki na magani ba, yana cigaba da yaɗuwa ne a kan fatar zuwa sauran sassan jiki. ana iya fara jin raɗaɗi daga cikin ƙashi da musayar lafiyayyen ƙashi da wani. mataki na biyu shi ne matakin da cutar ba za ta iya yaɗuwa ba wanda hakan na faruwa ne kusan shekaru biyar da kamuwa da cutar. ana iya fayyace cutar da ƙandarewar hanci da ƙashi da tafin hannu/dunduniya (kaurara). bayan nazarin alamomin cutar, za a iya tabbatar da cutar ne kawai idan aka haska fatar da wata nau'in nau'irar ganin ƙwaƙwaf ta musamman (darkfield examination). ba cika amfani da gwajin jini ba saboda cutar fata ta yaws na da alaƙa da bakteriyar da ke haifar da cutar sifilis, don haka sakamako ɗaya za a samu na cututtukan biyu.
translations.hypothesis: Alamomi: Akwai matakai biyu na kamuwa da cutar yaws. Matakin farko shi ne lokacin da mara lafiyar ke yaɗa cutar kuma zai iya yaɗa cutar zuwa wasu. A wannan matakin, ana samun papule (kumburi mai girma wanda ba ciwo ba ne) a wurin da aka kamu da cutar. Wannan papule yana cike da ƙwayoyin halitta kuma zai iya ɗaukar watanni 3-6 kafin ya warke da kansa. Ba tare da magani ba, wannan yana haifar da raunuka a jikin mutum. Zazabin ƙasusuwa da raunukan ƙasusuwa na iya faruwa. Mataki na biyu ba na yaɗuwa ba ne kuma yawanci yana bayyana shekaru biyar bayan kamuwa da cutar. Ana siffanta shi da illolin nakasa na hanci, ƙasusuwa da palmar/plantar hyperkeratosis (thickening). Bayan binciken da aka gudanar bisa la'akari da waɗannan alamun, za a iya tabbatar da cutar ta hanyar duba samfurin daga raunin fata a ƙarƙashin wata dabba ta musamman (binciken darkfield). Ba a yawan amfani da gwajin jini ba saboda yaws yana da alaƙa da ƙwayar bakteriya da ke haifar da cutar ƙaiƙayin jiki kuma cututtukan biyu za su nuna sakamako iri ɗaya.

translations.source: Treatment: There is currently no vaccine for yaws. Health education and improved personal hygiene are the most important tactics for prevention. Two antibiotics can be used to treat yaws. A single oral dose of azithromycin (30 mg/kg, maximum 2 g) is the recommended treatment. Benzathine penicillin (single intramuscular dose) at 0.6 million units (children aged under 10 years) and 1.2 million units (people aged over 10 years) can be used for patients with suspected clinical treatment failure after azithromycin, or patients who cannot be treated with azithromycin. This treatment will result in complete clinical healing in 95% of cases but patients should be re-examined 4 weeks after receiving the antibiotics. A review of the historic documents from 1950s shows that over 90 countries and territories were endemic for yaws. Only 14 out of the 90 countries and territories have recent data on yaws based on the routine surveillance system; however, these figures may just be an indication of the presence of the disease and not its full extent. Ghana, Papua New Guinea and the Solomon Islands report over 10 000 cases per year. Ecuador and India appear to have interrupted transmission.
translations.reference: Magani: A yanzu ba babu wata rigakafi ta cutar fata ta yaws. Ilimantarwa da inganta tsabtar jiki su ne muhimman dabarun da ake amfani da su na kariya. ana iya amfani da nau'o'in antibayotik guda biyu wajen maganin cutar fata ta yaws. an yi ba da shawarar amfani da maganin sha na azithromycin (30 mg/kg, maximum 2 g). za a iya amfani da maganin Benzathine penicillin (ta hanyar allura sau ɗaya) a kan waon 0.6 (ga yara 'yan ƙasa da shekaru 10) da awon 1.2 (ga yara 'yan sama da shekaru 10) ga marasa lafiya da ake zargin gazawar maganin da aka ɗora su a kai bayan azithromycin ko marasa lafiyar da laurarsu ta fi ƙarfin azithromycin. wannan mataki na magani sai warkar kashi 95% na masu cutar, sai dai akwai buƙatar sake duba su bayan mako 4 da karɓar antibiyotik ɗin. wani bincike ya nuna bayanan da suka gabata daga 1950 cewa ƙasashe 90 da yankuna suna fama da cutar fata ta yaws. kuma 14 cikin 90 na ƙasashen ne ke da bayanan na kusa-kusa a kan cutar fata ta yaws idan aka yi la'akari da tsarin bibiyar cutar, duk da cewa waɗannan al'ƙaluma ka iya zama manuniya ce ta wanzuwar wannan cutar, sai dai an rage mata ƙarfi. Ƙasashen Ghana da Papua New Guineada Tsibirin Solomon sun tabbatar da cewa suna samun sama masu cutar 10000 a kowacce shekara. Ƙasashen Ecuado da India sun yi nasarar daƙile yaɗuwar cutar.
translations.hypothesis: Magani: A halin yanzu babu allurar riga-kafi ga cutar yaws. Ilimin kiwon lafiya da kuma ingantaccen tsafta shi ne mafi muhimmancin hanyoyin riga-kafi. Za a iya amfani da magungunan riga-kafi guda biyu don magance cutar yaws. Ana ba da shawarar yin amfani da maganin azithromycin (30 mg/kg, mafi girma 2 g) a matsayin magani. Ana iya amfani da Benzathine penicillin (magani ɗaya na intramuscular) a 0.6 miliyan units (yara 'yan ƙasa da shekaru 10) da kuma 1.2 miliyan units (mutane 'yan sama da shekaru 10) ga marasa lafiya da ake zargin maganin cutar bai yi tasiri ba bayan shan azithromycin, ko kuma marasa lafiya da ba za a iya magance su da azithromycin ba. Wannan maganin zai haifar da warkewa gaba ɗaya a cikin kashi 95% na masu kamuwa da cutar, amma ya kamata a sake duba marasa lafiya makonni 4 bayan karɓar maganin riga-kafi. Binciken takardu daga shekarun 1950 ya nuna cewa sama da ƙasashe da yankuna 90 suna fama da cutar yaws. Ƙasashe da yankuna 14 cikin 90 ne ke da sabbin bayanai game da cutar yaws bisa tsarin sa ido na yau da kullum; duk da haka, waɗannan alƙaluman na iya zama nuni da kasancewar cutar ba kuma cikakkiyar ma'anarta ba. Ghana, Papua New Guinea da Tsibirin Solomon sun ba da rahoton samun faruwar cutar fiye da 10 000 a kowace shekara. Ecuador da Indiya sun bayyana an katse yaɗuwar cutar.

translations.source: Yellow fever Overview: Yellow fever is a viral disease that is transmitted to humans by the bites of infected mosquitoes. It is prone to epidemics and is preventable with a vaccine. These day-biting mosquitoes breed around houses (domestic), in forests or jungles (wild), or in both habitats (semi-domestic). Yellow fever is a high-impact, high-threat disease, with a risk of international spread, representing a potential threat to global health security. There are 3 types of transmission cycles: Sylvatic (or jungle) yellow fever spreads when monkeys are bitten by wild mosquitoes that pass the virus on to other monkeys and humans. Intermediate yellow fever spreads when semi-domestic mosquitoes infect both monkeys and people. This is the most common type of outbreak in Africa. Urban yellow fever can cause large epidemics when infected people introduce the virus into heavily populated areas with high mosquito density and where people have little immunity. Occasionally, infected travellers have exported cases to countries that are free of yellow fever.
translations.reference: Zazzaɓin masassara ko shawara Taƙaitaccen bayani: zazzaɓin masassara ko shawara cuta ce da 'yan Adam ke kamuwa da ita ta hanayr ciwon sauri. akwai yuwuwar yaɗuwarsa kuma ana iya magance ta ta hanyar rigakafi. waɗannan sauraye da ke cizo na iya hayayyafa a kusa da muhallan mutane (domestic) da dazuka (wild) da kuma duka muhallan biyu (semi-domestic). masassara ko shawara zazzaɓi ne mai tasiri kuma cuta mai illar gaske da ke da yuwuwar yaɗuwa a duniya wanda ake kallo a matsayin barazana ga kiwon lafiya a duniya. akwai hanyoyi 3 na hanyoyin yaɗuwar cutar: Sylvatic; cutar na yaɗuwa ne ta hanyar ciwon da sauraye ke yi wa birrai wanda daga nan ne suke yaɗa wa sauran birrai da mutane. zazzaɓin masassara ko shawara tsakanin halittu biyu na yaɗuwa ne a lokacin da sauraye suka harbi birrai da mutane. wannan nau'i ne na cuta ake yawan samun ɓarkewarsa a yankin Afirka. Zazzaɓin masassara na iya yaɗuwa a birane idan mutanen da suka harbu tare da yaɗa ta a wuraren da ke da yawan sauraye a kuma muhallin da mutane ke da ƙarancin kariya daga cutar. a wasu lokutan matafiya ne yaɗa wannan zazzaɓi na masassara a ƙasashen da ba su da ita.
translations.hypothesis: Zazzaɓin cizon rani Gamsashshen bayani: Zazzaɓin cizon rani cuta ce da ƙwarin da ke ɗauke da cutar ke yaɗa ta zuwa ga mutane ta hanyar cizon mutum. Yana da saurin zama annoba kuma ana iya magance shi da allurar riga-kafi. Waɗannan saurayen masu cizon mutane da daddare suna haifar da yara a kusa da gidaje (na cikin gida), a daji (na waje), ko a duka wuraren (kusan na cikin gida). Zazzaɓin cizon rani cuta ce mai saurin yaɗuwa da ka iya haifar da barazana ga lafiyar duniya. Akwai nau'ikan yaɗuwar cutar guda 3: Nau'in Sylvatic (ko daji) zazzaɓin cizon rani na yaɗuwa yayin da saurayen daji suka ciji birai da ke ɗauke da cutar ta hanyar yaɗa ta zuwa ga wasu birai da mutane. Matsakaicin zazzaɓin cizon rani na yaɗuwa yayin da saurayen da ke zaune da mutane suka yaɗa cutar ga duka birai da mutane. Wannan shi ne mafi yawan nau'in ɓarkewar cutar a Afirka. Zazzaɓin cizon rani na birane na iya haifar da manyan annoba yayin da mutanen da suka kamu da cutar suka shigar da cutar zuwa wuraren da ke da mutane da yawa da yawan sauraye da kuma inda mutane ba su da kariya. A wasu lokutan, matafiya da suka kamu da cutar sun fitar da cutar zuwa ƙasashen da ba su da cutar zazzaɓin cizon rani.

translations.source: However, the disease can only spread easily to a new country if there are mosquito species able to transmit it, specific climatic conditions, and the animal reservoir needed to maintain it. Symptoms: Yellow fever can present with a wide range of symptoms and severity. Once contracted, the yellow fever virus incubates in the body for 3–6 days. Many people do not experience symptoms, but when these do occur, the most common are fever, muscle pain with prominent backache, headache, loss of appetite, and nausea or vomiting. In most cases, symptoms disappear after 3–4 days. A small percentage of patients enter a second, more toxic phase within 24 hours of recovering from initial symptoms. High fever returns and several body systems are affected, usually the liver and kidneys. In this phase, people are likely to develop jaundice (yellowing of the skin and eyes, hence the name yellow fever), dark urine, and abdominal pain with vomiting. Bleeding can occur from the mouth, nose, eyes, or stomach. Half of these patients die within 7–10 days.Yellow fever is difficult to diagnose, especially during the early stages.
translations.reference: kodayake, ƙwayar cutar na yaɗuwa cikin sauƙi ne a ƙasashen da ke da nau'in wannan sauro wanda ke iya yaɗa cutar, ko wani yanayi da kuma yawan dabbobin da ke iya ajiye ƙwayar cutar. Alamomin kamuwa da cutar: zazzaɓin masassara na da alamomin mabambanta. da zarar mutum ya kamu, ƙwayar cutar na ƙyanƙyashewa a jikinsa ne tsakanin kwanaki 3-6. Wasu mutane ba za sa jin alamun kamuwa, amma idan hakan ta faru, mafi yawan alamun da mutum ke ji shi ne zazzaɓi, zugi tare da ciwon baya da ciwon kai da rashin son cin abinci da jin hararwa ko yin amai. A mafi yawancin lokuta akan nemi alamun zazzaɓin a rasa bayan kwanaki 3-4. wasu daga cikin marasa lafiya suna shiga mataki na biyu kuma mafi haɗari bayan awanni 24 daga daina jin alamomin farko. Zazzaɓi mai zafi na dawowa da kuma ke shafar sassan jiki da dama kamar hanta da ƙodoji. A wannan mataki, akwai yuwuwar mutane su fuskanci sauyin launi a wani sashe na jiki (sauyawar launin fata da ƙwayar idanu zuwa launin rawaya wanda hakan ya sa ake kiran cutar da 'yellow fever') da bawali mai launin baƙi da ciwon ciki da hararwa. Ana iya samun zubar jini daga baki da hanci da idanu ko ciki. Rabin waɗannan marasa lafiya sun mutu a cikin kwananki 7-10.cutar zazzaɓin yana da wuyar ganewa,musamman a lokacin farkon matakan.
translations.hypothesis: Duk da haka, cutar na iya yaɗuwa cikin sauƙi zuwa ƙasa mai kyau idan akwai ire-iren saurayen da ke yaɗa ta, yanayin yanayi na musamman, da kuma wurin ajiyar dabbobi da ake buƙata don kiyaye shi. Alamomi: Zazzaɓin cizon sauro na iya bayyana da alamomi da yawa da tsananin su. Da zarar an kamu da cutar, ƙwayar cutar zazzaɓin cizon sauro tana ƙyanƙyasa a jiki na kwanaki 3-6. Mutane da yawa ba sa fuskantar alamun cutar, amma idan waɗannan suka faru, gama garin su ne zazzaɓi, ciwon tsoka tare da ciwon baya mai zafi, ciwon kai, rashin son cin abinci, da tashin zuciya ko amai. A mafi yawan lokuta, alamun cutar suna dafawa bayan kwanaki 3-4. Ƙaramin kaso na marasa lafiya na shiga mataki na biyu, mai saurin gaske a cikin awanni 24 na farfadowa daga alamun farko. Zazzaɓi mai yawa yana dawowa kuma tsarin jiki da yawa na samun illa, yawanci hanta da ƙoda. A wannan matakin, mutane na iya kamuwa da ciwon hanta (canjin launin fata da idanu zuwa yalo, don haka ake kiran zazzaɓin yalo), fitsari mai duhu, da ciwon ciki tare da amai. Za a iya samun zubar jini daga baki, hanci, idanu, ko ciki. Kashi biyu na waɗannan marasa lafiya suna mutuwa a cikin kwanaki 7-10. Zazzaɓin cizon sauro yana da wahalar gano, musamman a farkon matakan.

translations.source: More severe cases can be confused with severe malaria, leptospirosis, viral hepatitis (especially fulminant forms), other haemorrhagic fevers, infection with other flaviviruses (such as dengue haemorrhagic fever) and poisoning. Polymerase chain reaction (PCR) testing in blood and urine can sometimes detect the virus in early stages of the disease. In later stages, testing to identify antibodies is needed (IgM). Treatment: Yellow fever infections can cause serious illness and can be fatal in severe cases. Early supportive treatment in hospitals improves survival rates. There is currently no specific anti-viral drug for yellow fever, but specific care to treat dehydration, fever, and liver and kidney failure improves outcomes. Associated bacterial infections can be treated with antibiotics. Patients need to stay under mosquito nets during the day to limit the risk of spreading to others through mosquito bites. Vaccination is the single most important measure for preventing yellow fever. The prevention of outbreaks can only be achieved if the majority of the population is immunized.
translations.reference: Za'a iya rikitar da lamura masu tsanani tare da matsanancin zazzabin cizon sauro, leptospirosis, hepatitis na kwayar cuta (musamman nau'ikan fulminant), sauran zazzabi na haemorrhagic, kamuwa da wasu flaviviruses (kamar zazzabin haemorrhagic na dengue) da guba. Gwajin polymerase{PCR} a cikin jini da fitsari wani lokaci na gano ƙwayar cutar a farkon matakan cutar. A cikin matakai na gaba, ana buƙatar gwaji don gano ƙwayoyin cutar (IgM). Matakin magance cutar:kamuwa da zazzaɓin masassara na iya haifar da mummunar cuta kuma na iya zama mai kisa a lokuta masu tsanani. tallafin magani na farko a asibitoci yana inganta ƙimar rayuwa. A halin yanzu babu wani takamaiman maganin rigakafin ƙwayar cuta don zazzaɓi, amma takamaiman kulawa don magance rashin isashshen ruwa a jiki, zazzabi, da gazawar hanta da koda yana inganta sakamako. Ana iya magance ƙwayoyin cuta masu alaƙa da maganin rigakafi. Marasa lafiya suna buƙatar zama a gidan sauro da rana don irage haɗarin yadawa ga wasu ta hanyar cizon sauro. Alurar riga kafi ita ce hanya mafi mahimmanci don hana zazzabi. Za a iya hana barkewar cutar ne kawai idan an yiwa yawancin jama'a allurar rigakafi.
translations.hypothesis: Ana iya rikice matsanancin cutar da cutar zazzaɓin cizon sauro mai tsanani, leptospirosis, ciwon hanta mai saurin yaɗuwa (musamman nau'ikan fulminant), sauran zazzaɓi masu zubar da jini, kamuwa da cuta tare da wasu ƙwayoyin cuta masu kama da su (kamar zazzaɓin dake saurin zubar da jini) da kuma guba. Gwajin polymerase chain reaction (PCR) a cikin jini da fitsari wani lokacin yana iya gano ƙwayar cutar a matakan farko na cutar. A matakan baya, ana buƙatar gwaji don gano antibodies (IgM). Magani: Cutar zazzaɓin cizon sauro na iya haifar da rashin lafiya mai tsanani kuma yana iya kasancewa mai kisa a cikin yanayi mai tsanani. Tallafin kulawa da magani a matakin farko a asibitoci yana inganta yawan tsira da mutane. A halin yanzu babu wani takamaiman maganin rigakafi na cutar zazzaɓin cizon sauro, amma kulawa ta musamman don magance rashin ruwa, zazzaɓi, da ciwon hanta da ƙoda yana inganta sakamako. Ana iya magance matsalolin da ke da alaƙa da cutar bakteriya tare da maganin antibiotics. Marasa lafiya na buƙatar su kasance a ƙarƙashin gidajen saurayen da rana don rage haɗarin yaɗa cutar zuwa wasu ta hanyar cizon da sauraye ke yi. Alurar rigakafi ita ce mafi muhimmin mataki guda ɗaya don hana zazzaɓin cizon sauro. Za a iya samun nasarar hana ɓarkewar cutar idan aka yi allurar rigakafi ga mafi yawan al'umma.

translations.source: The yellow fever vaccine is safe and affordable, and a single dose provides life-long immunity against the disease. People who recover from yellow fever infection are also protected for life. Read more about the yellow fever vaccine. Mosquito control can also help to prevent yellow fever and is vital in situations where vaccination coverage is low or the vaccine is not immediately available. Mosquito control includes eliminating sites where mosquitoes can breed and killing adult mosquitoes and larvae by using insecticides in areas with high mosquito density. Community involvement through activities, such as cleaning household drains and covering water containers where mosquitoes can breed is an important and effective way to control mosquitoes.
translations.reference: Maganin cutar zazzabin shawara yana da aminci kuma mai araha, kuma kashi ɗaya na alluran rigakafi yana ba da rigakafi na tsawon rayuwa daga cutar. Mutanen da suka warke daga kamuwa da cutar zazzaɓi kuma suna da kariya har tsawon rayuwars. ƙara karantawa game da allurar rigakafin zazzaɓin cizon sauro. Kula da sauro na iya taimakawa wajen hana zazzabin rawaya kuma yana da mahimmanci a cikin yanayin da allurar rigakafi ba ta da yawa ko kuma ba a samun rigakafin nan da nan. Kula da sauro ya haɗa da kawar da wuraren da sauro ke hayayyafa da kashe manya sauro da tsutsa ta hanyar amfani da maganin kashe kwari a wuraren da ke da yawan sauro. Shigar da al'umma ta hanyar ayyuka, kamar tsaftace magudanar ruwa da kuma rufe kwantena na ruwa inda sauro ke iya hayayyafa hanya ce mai mahimmanci kuma mai inganci don magance sauro.
translations.hypothesis: Allurar rigakafin cutar shawara ba ta da illa sannan ta sauƙin kuɗi, kuma allura ɗaya tana ba da kariya ta tsawon rayuwar mutum daga cutar. Mutanen da suka warke daga kamuwa da cutar shawara suma an kare su na rayuwarsu. Karanta ƙarin bayani game da allurar rigakafin cutar shawara. Kula da sauraye zai iya taimakawa wajen hana cutar shawara kuma yana da mahimmanci a cikin yanayin da aka samu ƙarancin allurar rigakafi ko kuma allurar rigakafin ba ta samuwa nan da nan. Kula da sauraye ya haɗa da kawar da wuraren da sauraye ke iya haifar da jarirai da kuma kashe manyan sauraye da ƙudaje ta hanyar amfani da maganin ƙwari a wuraren da ke da yawan sauraye. Shigo da al'umma ta hanyar ayyuka, kamar su tsaftace maɓuɓɓugar gidaje da kuma rufe ƙunjarin ruwa inda sauraye ke iya haifar da jarirai hanya ce mai mahimmanci da tasiri ta kula da sauraye.

translations.source: People with medical needs are “left behind in pain” reveals new report The World Health Organization (WHO) has published a new report on access to morphine for medical use, which describes how the global distribution of morphine, as a vital pain medicine, is unequal and does not fulfil the medical need. The report, titled “Left behind in pain”, highlights the problems in access to this essential medicine and offers actions to improve safe access through balanced policy. Despite morphine being an effective and relatively low-cost medicine for relieving strong pain, listed since 1977 in the first edition of the WHO Model list of Essential Medicines, the disparity in access across countries is stark. There is a 5- to 63-fold difference in the estimated median consumption of morphine between high-income countries and lower income countries. Consumption pattern varies significantly across countries of similar wealth; it does not correspond to medical need, as indicated by the estimated number of days people are in pain or suffer with severe shortness of breath for people with a terminal illness. This data echoes that of the 2018 Lancet Commission which described the lack of access to pain relief medication as ‘one of the most heinous, hidden inequities in global health’ with the richest 10% of countries possessing 90% of distributed morphine-equivalent opioids. “Leaving people in pain when effective medicines are available for pain management, especially in the context of end-of-life care, should be a cause of serious concern for policy-makers,” says Dr Yukiko Nakatani, WHO Assistant Director-General for Medicines and Health Products. “We must urgently advocate for safe and timely access to morphine for those in medical need through balanced policy, everywhere.”
translations.reference: An bar mutanen da ke da buƙatar kulawar likita a baya cikin raɗaɗi, sabon rahoto ya bayyana. Hukumar Lafiya ta Duniya (WHO) ta fitar da wani sabon rahoto kan samun damar yin amfani da sinadarin morphine a matsayin magani, wanda ya bayyana yadda rarraba morphine a duniya a matsayin maganin raɗaɗi mai mahimmanci, bai daidaita ba kuma baya biyan bukatun likita.B50. Rahoton, mai taken "cikin raɗaɗi", yana nuna matsalolin samun damar yin amfani da wannan magani mai mahimmanci tare da bayyana hanyoyin samar da shi cikin ta hanyar daidaitattun manufofi. Duk da cewa morphine magani ne mai inganci kuma mai sauƙin farashi don kawar da raɗaɗi mai ƙarfi, wanda aka jera tun 1977 a cikin wallafar WHO ta farko na jerin samfuran Mahimman Magunguna, rarrabuwar kai a cikin ƙasashe yana da ƙarfi. Akwai bambanci ninki 5 zuwa 63 a kiyasin matsakaicin yawan amfani da morphine tsakanin ƙasashe masu samun kuɗin shiga da ƙasashe masu ƙaramin karfi. Yanayin amfani ya bambanta sosai a cikin ƙasashe masu irin wannan arziki; Bai dace da buƙatun kiwon lafiya ba, kamar yadda ƙiyasin adadin kwanakin da mutane ke fama da raɗaɗi ko fama da matsanancin ƙarancin numfashi ga masu fama da rashin lafiyan da ba na tashi ba. Wadannan bayanan sun yi daidai da na Hukumar Lancet ta 2018 wacce ta bayyana rashin samun damar yin amfani da magungunan rage jin zafi a matsayin daya daga cikin rashin adalci mafi muni, a harkar kiwon lafiya ta duniya tare da 10% mafiya arzikin ƙasashe da ke daukar kashi 90% na morphine da aka rarraba. daidai opioids. Barin mutane cikin raɗaɗi a lokacin da ake samun ingantattun magunguna don magance raɗaɗin ciwo, musamman a yanayin kula da lafiya na karshen rayuwa, ya kamata ya zama abin damuwa ga masu tsara manufofi, in ji Dokta Yukiko Nakatani, Mataimakin Daraktan WHO. -Gabaɗaya don Magunguna da Kayayyakin Lafiya. Dole ne mu yi kira da gaggawa a samar da morphine kan lokaci ga waɗanda ke cikin buƙatun likita ta hanyar madaidaitan manufofi, a ko'ina.
translations.hypothesis: Mutanen da ke da buƙatar kula da lafiya "an bar su a cikin ciwo" rahoton sabon ya bayyana Hukumar Lafiya ta Duniya (WHO) ta buga sabon rahoton kan samun morphine don amfani da shi a magani, wanda ke bayyana yadda rarraba morphine a duniya, a matsayin muhimmin maganin rage raɗaɗi, ba daidaito ba ne kuma ba ya biyan buƙatar magani. Rahoton, mai taken “An bar a cikin ciwo”, ya nuna matsalolin samun wannan muhimmin magani da kuma matakan inganta samunsa cikin aminci ta hanyar daidaiton tsari. Duk da cewa morphine magani ne mai inganci kuma mai rahusa don rage raɗaɗi mai ƙarfi, da aka lissafa tun 1977 a cikin bugun farko na Jerin Samfurin WHO na Mahimman Magunguna, bambanci a samunsa a cikin ƙasashe ya yi yawa. Akwai bambanci mai yawa tsakanin ƙasashe masu ƙarfin siyan magani da ƙasashe masu ƙaramin ƙarfin siyan magani na amfani da maganin morphine. Yanayin amfani da magani ya bambanta sosai a tsakanin ƙasashe masu ƙarfin siyan magani da ƙasashe masu ƙaramin ƙarfin siyan magani. Ba shi da alaƙa da buƙatar magani, kamar yadda adadin kwanakin da mutane ke ciwon ko fama da matsanancin rashin numfashi ga mutanen da ke fama da cutar da ke kusa da mutuwa ya nuna. Wannan bayanan yana jinjinawa rahoton 2018 na Hukumar Lancet wanda ya bayyana rashin samun maganin rage raɗaɗi a matsayin 'ɗaya daga cikin manyan ha'daddun da aka ɓoye a cikin kiwon lafiya na duniya' tare da kasashe 10% mafi arziƙi suna da 90% na rarraba maganin morphine-equivalent opioids. "Sake barin mutane a cikin ciwo yayin da akwai ingantattun magunguna don magance ciwon, musamman a cikin yanayin kulawa da ƙarshen rayuwa, ya kamata ya zama abin damuwa ga masu tsara manufofi," in ji Dokta Yukiko Nakatani, Mataimakiyar Darakta Janar ta WHO kan Magunguna da Kayayyakin Kiwon Lafiya. "Dole ne mu yi gaggawar neman aminci da samun maganin morphine a kan lokaci ga waɗanda ke buƙatar kulawar lafiya ta hanyar daidaiton tsari, a ko'ina."

translations.source: Reasons for the disparity Access to morphine for medical use is influenced by many interacting factors including enablers related to good governance, reliable/efficient procurement and supply processes, resource availability and capacity-building activities, along with barriers related to overly restrictive legislation and policies, inadequate service provision, and misinformed attitudes and perception. Given different country contexts, enablers, barriers and priorities for action vary; a stakeholder survey presented in this report, with respondents from 105 WHO Member States, confirms this variation. For example, irregular supply of morphine and other strong opioids at health facilities due to limited financing were commonly noted as a barrier in low- and middle-income countries compared to high-income countries. More than a third of respondents across all regions also noted barriers arising from legislative and regulatory factors while recognizing the importance of a legislative and regulatory framework in achieving safe access. Unduly restrictive requirements could hamper patient access because they impede the flow of supply or make prescribing and dispensing difficult for health-care professionals. It is important to note that concerns about the potential harmful effects of opioids are valid, such as their potential to lead to opioid use disorder. For this reason, a certain amount of caution about the potential harms of opioid use (e.g. use in chronic non-cancer pain) is important for public health insofar as its use is well-informed and proportionate to risks. Such concerns should not undermine the benefits of opioid use when clinically indicated and when used safely by trained professionals. Opportunities for actionThe report presents a complementary set of areas for action that aim to improve safe access to morphine.
translations.reference: Dalilan banbance-banbance Damar samun morphine a matsayin magani yana da alaƙa da abubuwa da dama da suka haɗa da shugabanci nagari, ingantaccen sayayya da hanyoyin samar da kayayyaki, wadatar albarkatu da ayyukan haɓaka iya aiki, tare da shamakain da ke da alaƙa da ƙaƙƙarfan dokoki da manufofi, ƙarancin bayar da kulawa, da rashin fahimtar halaye da fahimta. Duba da yanayin ƙasashe daban-daban, abubuwan da ke samar da dama da tsaiko da fifiko wajen mahimmancin ɗaukar mataki sun bambanta; wani binciken masu ruwa da tsaki da aka gabatar a wannan rahoto, mai masu amsa tambayoyi daga mambobin ƙasashen WHO guda 105, ya tabbatar da wannan bambancin. Misali, ana ɗaukar rashin samar da sinadarin morphine da sauran magungunan opioid masu karfi a wuraren kiwon lafiya saboda ƙarancin kuɗaɗe a matsayin wani shamakai a ƙasashe masu ƙaramin karfi da matsakaicin kuɗin shiga idan aka kwatanta da ƙasashe masu tasowa. Fiye da kashi ɗaya bisa uku na waɗanda suka amsa tambayoyi a duk faɗin yankuna sun bayyana cewa dalilan dake kawo cikas sun shafi dokoki da ƙa'idoji, a yayin da suka fahimci muhimmancin tsarin doka da ƙa'ida wajen samar da dama cikin aminci. ƙayyadaddun buƙatu na babu gaira babu dalili na iya kawo cikas ga majiyyaci wajen samun dama saboda suna hana samarwa ko rubutawa da rarrabawa ga ma'aikatan kiwon lafiya. Yana da kyau a lura cewa damuwa game da yuwuwar illolin magungunan opioid abu ne mai tushe, kamar yuwuwar su na haifar da matsalolin dakr da alaƙa da amfani da opioids. Saboda wannan dalili, ɗaukan wani mataki na taka tsantsan game da yuwuwar cutarwar amfani da opioid (misali amfani a cikin ciwon daji na yau da kullun ba tare da ciwon daji ba) yana da mahimmanci ga lafiyar jama'a matuƙar an san amfaninsa daidai yake da haɗarinsa. Kada ire-iren waɗannan damuwa su lalata fa'idojin amfani da magungunan opioid lokacin da lafiya ta buƙaci hakan da lokacin amfani da su ta hanyar ƙwararrun ma'aikata. Damar daukar mataki: Rahoton ya gabatar da wasu jerin ɓangarorin ɗaukar matakai da nufin inganta damar samun morphine.
translations.hypothesis: Dalilan bambanci Samun maganin morphine don amfani da shi a magani yana da tasirin abubuwa da yawa da suka haɗa da abubuwan da suka shafi shugabanci, da ingantattun hanyoyin siyan kaya da samarwa, da wadatar albarkatu da ayyukan gina jiki, tare da shinge-shingensu da suka shafi dokoki da tsare-tsaren da ke da tsaurin gaske, da ƙarancin samar da hidima, da halaye da fahimtar marar fahimta. Bayar da misalan yanayin ƙasashe daban-daban, da abubuwan da ke taimakawa, da shinge-shingensu da abubuwan da suka fi muhimmanci don ɗaukar mataki sun bambanta; wani bincike na masu ruwa da tsaki da aka gabatar a wannan rahoton, tare da masu amsa tambayoyi daga ƙasashe 105 na WHO, sun tabbatar da wannan bambanci. Misali, rashin daidaiton samar da morphine da sauran magunguna masu ƙarfi a cibiyoyin kiwon lafiya saboda ƙarancin kuɗi an gano shi a matsayin shinge a ƙasashe masu ƙaranci da matsakaicin kudin shiga idan aka kwatanta da ƙasashe masu babban kudin shiga. Fiye da kaso uku na masu amsa tambayoyi a duk yankuna sun kuma lura da shinge-shingensu da ke samuwa daga dokoki da ƙa'idoji yayin da suke fahimtar mahimmancin tsarin doka da ƙa'idoji wajen samun aminci. Buƙatu masu tsauri da ba ta da dalili za su iya kawo cikas ga samun mara lafiya saboda suna hana samar da kayayyaki ko su sanya rubuta magani da bayar da shi ya yi wa ƙwararrun ma'aikatan lafiya wahala. Yana da muhimmanci a lura cewa, damuwar game da illar da magunguna masu raunin da ake samu a cikin su na da inganci, kamar irin su yuwuwar su haifar da cutar da ake samu ta amfani da magani ba bisa ƙa'ida ba. Saboda wannan dalili, wani ma'auni na kiyaye kai game da illar da ake samu ta amfani da magani (misali, amfani a matsayin maganin ciwon da ba na kansa ba) yana da mahimmanci ga lafiyar al'umma har ma inda ake amfani da shi yadda ya kamata kuma ya dace da haɗarurruka. Ba a kamata waɗannan damuwoli su lalata amfanin amfani da magani a lokacin da likita ya nuna buƙatar amfani da shi da kuma lokacin da ƙwararrun masana suka yi amfani da shi yadda ya kamata. Damarmakin ɗaukar mataki Rahoton ya gabatar da wani ƙarin jerin wuraren da za a ɗauki mataki wanda ke da nufin inganta samun aminci ga morphine.

translations.source: These include implementing small-scale regional or state-wide programmes on improving access to morphine for medical use with a package of essential services and products for palliative care that is formulated according to the WHO Model List of Essential Medicines and the WHO Essential Package of Palliative Care. They also include improving governance, streamlining procurement and supply processes to address any inefficiency, improving resourcing such as stable funding, enhancing competent skill sets of the health workforce, and raising awareness about both the benefits and potential harms of opioid use. The success of these actions will hinge on collaboration and cooperation among all stakeholders at national, regional, and global levels.
translations.reference: Waɗannan sun haɗa da aiwatar da ƙananan shirye-shirye na yankuna da na jihohi kan haɓaka damar yin amfani da morphine wajen kiwon lafiya tare da mahimman ayyuka da kayayyaki don kulawa da jin daɗi, wanda aka tsara akan Jerin Kayayyakin WHO na Mahimman Magunguna da Muhimman Ƙunshin Lafiya na Kulawar WHO. Har ila yau, sun haɗa da inganta tsarin mulki, daidaita sayayya da hanyoyin samar da kayayyaki don magance duk wani tasgaro, inganta kayan aiki kamar samar da kuɗaɗe, samar da ƙwarewa a ma'aikatar kiwon lafiya, da wayar da kan jama'a game da fa'idodi da illar amfani da opioid. Nasarar waɗannan ayyukan za ta ta'allaƙa ne kan haɗin gwiwa da haɗin kai tsakanin dukkan masu ruwa da tsaki a matakan ƙasa, yanki da duniya baki ɗaya.
translations.hypothesis: Waɗannan sun haɗa da aiwatar da ƙananan shirye-shirye na yanki ko na ƙasa baki ɗaya kan inganta damar yin amfani da morphine don amfani da magani tare da fakitin muhimman ayyuka da samfuran kulawar tallafi wanda aka tsara ta hanyar WHO Model List of Essential Medicines da WHO Essential Package of Palliative Care. Har ila yau, sun haɗa da inganta shugabanci, da daidaita tsarin da tsarin samarwa don magance duk wani rashin inganci, da inganta albarkatu kamar ingantaccen tallafi, da haɓaka ƙwarewar ƙwarewa na ma'aikatan kiwon lafiya, da wayar da kai game da fa'idodi da illolin yin anfani da opioids. Nasarar waɗannan ayyukan za ta dogara ne akan haɗin gwiwa da haɗin gwiwa tsakanin dukkan masu ruwa da tsaki a matakan ƙasa, yanki, da duniya.

translations.source: Small islands agree bold plan of action on noncommunicable diseases and mental health Today, the 2023 Bridgetown Declaration on Noncommunicable Diseases (NCDs) and Mental Health was launched, to address some of the world’s deadliest diseases in Small Island Developing States (SIDS), which are especially at risk. The Declaration is a key outcome of the SIDS Ministerial Conference on Noncommunicable Diseases (NCDs) and Mental Health, running from 14 to 16 June, co-hosted by the World Health Organization (WHO), the Pan American Health Organization (PAHO) and the Government of Barbados. SIDS are disproportionately impacted by NCDs – which cause 74% of all deaths globally – due to their reliance on imported food, commercial influences and the climate crisis. A new WHO report shows that 8 of the 15 countries with more than a 30% risk of premature death from cardiovascular disease, cancer, diabetes, or chronic respiratory disease are SIDS. The 10 countries with the highest obesity rates globally are all SIDS in the Pacific, where over 45% of adults live with obesity. Mental health conditions are common in SIDS countries, affecting an estimated 15.2% of the population in the Caribbean and 11.2% of the population in the Pacific. People with mental health conditions face a higher risk of premature mortality, including from unaddressed physical health conditions and from suicide. Stigma, specialized staff shortages and the impact of climate change contribute to a challenging situation in SIDS that requires immediate attention. The 2023 Bridgetown Declaration outlines bold steps to address the range of social, environmental, economic and commercial issues that lead to NCDs and mental health conditions.
translations.reference: Ƙananan tsibirai sun amince kan babban shirin ayyuka kan cututtukan da ba sa yaɗuwa da cututtukan ƙwaƙwalwa. A yau, an ƙaddamar da sanarwar Bridgetown na 2023 akan Cututtukan da ba sa yaɗuwa (NCDs) da Lafiyar Ƙwaƙwalwa, don magance wasu cututtukan masu tsanani a duniya a cikin Ƙananan Tsibirai masu tasowa (SIDS), musamman waɗanda ke cikin haɗari. Sanarwar ita ce mahimmiyar sakamako na taron ministocin SIDS kan cututtukan da ba sa yaɗuwa (NCDs) da lafiyar ƙwaƙwalwa, wanda ke gudana daga ranar 14 zuwa 16 ga Yuni, wanda Hukumar Lafiya ta Duniya (WHO), da kuma Pan American Health Organisation (PAHO) suka shirya. Gwamnatin Barbados. NCDs na da matuƙar tasiri ga SIDS, wanda hakan ke haifar da kashi 74% na duk mace-mace a duniya saboda dogaro da abincin da ake shigowa da su daga waje, tasirin kasuwanci da kuma rikicewar yanayi. Wani sabon rahoton na WHO ya bayyana cewa 8 daga cikin ƙasashe 15 da ke da fiye da kashi 30 cikin dari na haɗarin mutuwa da wuri daga cututtukan zuciya, ciwon daji, ciwon sukari, ko cututtukan numfashi na yau da kullun sune SID. Ƙasashe 10 da ke da mafiya yawan masu fama da cutar ƙiba a duniya duk SID ne a cikin Pasifik, inda sama da kashi 45% na manya ke rayuwa da cutar ƙiba. Matsalolin lafiyar ƙwaƙwalwa ya zama ruwan dare a cikin ƙasashen SIDS, wanda ya shafi kimanin kashi 15.2 na yawan jama'ar Caribbean da kashi 11.2 na yawan jama'ar Pasifik. Mutanen da ke fama da matsalar lafiyar ƙwaƙwalwa suna fuskantar haɗarin mutuwa da wuri, rashin samun isasshen kulawa ta lafiyar jiki gami da kuma yunkurin kashe kawunansu. Abin kunya, ƙarancin ƙwararrun ma'aikata da tasirin sauyin yanayi suna ba da gudummawa wajen fuskantar ƙalubale a cikin SIDS wanda ke buƙatar kulawa da gaggawa. Sanarwar Bridgetown ta 2023 ta zayyana ƙwararan matakai don magance matsalolin zamantakewa, muhalli, tattalin arziki da kasuwanci waɗanda ke haifar da NCDs da yanayin lafiyar hankali.
translations.hypothesis: Ƙananan tsibirai sun amince da babban shirin aiwatarwa kan cututtukan da ba a ɗauka da lafiyar ƙwaƙwalwa A yau, an ƙaddamar da Sanarwar Bridgetown ta 2023 kan Cututtuka Marasa yaɗuwa (NCDs) da Lafiyar Ƙwaƙwalwa, don magance wasu daga cikin cututtukan da suka fi kisa a cikin ƙananan tsibirai masu tasowa (SIDS), waɗanda ke cikin haɗari musamman. Sanarwar ita ce babban sakamako na Taron Ministoci na SIDS kan Cututtuka Marasa yaɗuwa (NCDs) da Lafiyar Ƙwaƙwalwa, wanda ya gudana daga 14 zuwa 16 Yuni, tare da haɗin gwiwa daga Hukumar Lafiya ta Duniya (WHO), Hukumar Lafiya ta Pan American (PAHO) da Gwamnatin Barbados. SIDS suna fuskantar matsala da NCDs - wanda ke haifar da 74% na duk mace-mace a duniya - saboda dogaro da abinci mai shigo da shi, tasirin kasuwanci da rikicin yanayi. Wani sabon rahoton WHO ya nuna cewa 8 daga cikin ƙasashe 15 da ke da fiye da 30% haɗarin mutuwa da wuri daga cututtukan zuciya, kansa, ciwon siga, ko cututtukan numfashi masu naci su ne SIDS. Ƙasashe 10 da ke da mafi girman adadin masu kiba a duniya dukkansu SIDS ne a cikin Pacific, inda sama da 45% na manya ke rayuwa tare da kiba. Matsalolin lafiyar ƙwaƙwalwa gama gari ne a cikin ƙasashen SIDS, wanda ke shafar kusan kashi 15.2% na yawan jama'a a Caribbean da kashi 11.2% na yawan jama'a a Pacific. Mutanen da ke da matsalar lafiyar ƙwaƙwalwa suna fuskantar babban haɗarin mutuwa da wuri, gami da daga yanayin lafiyar jiki da ba a magance ba da kuma kashe kai. Neman bambanci, ƙarancin ƙwararrun ma'aikata da tasirin sauyin yanayi suna ba da gudunmawa ga yanayi mai ƙalubale a cikin SIDS wanda ke buƙatar kulawa ta gaggawa. Sanarwar Bridgetown ta 2023 ta bayyana manyan matakai don magance kewayen matsalolin zamantakewa, muhalli, tattalin arziƙi da kasuwanci da ke haifar da NCDs da yanayin lafiyar ƙwaƙwalwa.

translations.source: Developed through an inclusive process led ‘for’ and ‘by’ SIDS, the declaration highlights that NCDs and mental health conditions cannot be properly addressed without responding to the climate crisis. “Bold action for our climate, good health, and well-being relies on redressing and reorganizing global financing to unlock billions in investment, while making it less punishing for developing countries to pay their debts,” said Her Excellency Mia Amor Mottley, Prime Minister of Barbados. “Funding for climate change adaptation and mitigation in the most vulnerable countries is also key, with noncommunicable diseases and mental health accounted for.” "The challenges faced by Small Island Developing States are interconnected and multifaceted. Climate change, environmental degradation, social and economic inequalities, and the commercial determinants of health exacerbate the burden of NCDs and mental health conditions," said Dr Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, WHO Director-General. "Despite their limited resources and geographical constraints, these nations have shown remarkable resilience in the face of adversity. Together, we must forge a path that is based on equity, resilience, and sustainability. We must strengthen health systems, enhance prevention and early detection measures, and prioritize the integration of NCD and mental health services into primary health care. "The Director-General also pledged that WHO would work to mobilize financial resources to develop climate resilient, environmentally sustainable health-care facilities in the SIDS. WHO will also continue to advocate for ‘loss and damage’ funding for climate change adaptation and mitigation investments in lower income countries.
translations.reference: Ta hanyar gamammiyar tsari da SID ta jagoranta, sanarwar ta nuna cewa ba za a iya magance NCDs da matsalolin lafiyar ƙwaƙwalwa yadda ya kamata ba, ba tare da magance rikicin yanayi ba. Ɗaukan ƙwararan matakai da suka dace a game da yanayi, lafiya da kuma walwalarmu, ya dogara ne kan gyaran tsarin tafiyar da kuɗaɗe a duniya, don samar da biliyoyin hanyoyin zuba hannun jari, da rage wa ƙasashe masu tasowa nauyin biyan basussukan da ake bin su. Firayim Ministan Barbados. Bayar da kuɗi ga ƙasashe masu rauni don daidaitawa da sauyin yanayi abu ne mai muhimmanci, tare da ƙididdige cututtuka marasa yaɗuwa da lafiyar ƙwaƙwalwa. Ƙalubalen da Jihohin masu tasowa a Kananan Tsibirai ke fuskanta, suna da alaƙa da juna, da fuskoki daban-daban. Sauyin yanayi, lalacewar muhalli, rashin daidaiton zamantakewa da tattalin arziki, da kuma hanyoyin kasuwanci na kiwon lafiya suna ƙara tsananta nauyin NCDs da yanayin lafiyar ƙwaƙwalwa," in ji Dr Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, Darakta-Janar na WHO. Duk da ƙarancin albarkatun da suke da shi da kuma matsalar yanki, wadannan al’ummomi sun nuna matukar jajircewa wajen fuskantar matsaloli. Tare, dole ne mu samar da hanyar da ta ginu akan daidaito, juriya, da ɗorewa. Dole ne mu ƙarfafa tsarin kiwon lafiya, haɓaka matakan kariya da ganowa da wuri, da kuma ba da fifiko ga haɗin gwiwar NCD da ayyukan kula da lafiyar ƙwaƙwalwa a cikin kiwon lafiya na farko. Darakta-Janar ɗin ya kuma yi alƙawarin cewa WHO za ta yi aiki don tattara kuɗaɗe don bunƙasa yanayin juriya, wuraren kula da lafiya masu ɗorewa a cikin SIDS. WHO za ta kuma ci gaba da bayar da shawarwari don samar da kuɗaɗe na asara da lalacewa don daidaita canjin yanayi da rage saka hannun jari a ƙasashe masu ƙaramin karfi.
translations.hypothesis: An samar da shi ta hanyar haɗakar tsari wanda SIDS ke jagoranta, sanarwar ta nuna cewa ba za a iya magance NCDs da yanayin lafiyar ƙwaƙwalwa ba tare da magance matsalar yanayi ba. "Tabbatar da ɗaukar mataki kan yanayarmu, lafiya, da walwala ya dogara ne kan gyara da sake fasalin tallafin kuɗi na duniya don buɗe biliyoyi a cikin saka hannun jari, yayin da ake sanya ƙarancin hukunci ga ƙasashen da ke tasowa don biyan basussukansu," in ji Her Excellency Mia Amor Mottley, Firministan ƙasar Barbados. "Samar da kuɗi don daidaita canjin yanayi da ragewa a cikin ƙasashen da suka fi fuskantar barazanar shi ma na da mahimmanci, tare da rashin cututtuka masu yaɗuwa da lafiyar ƙwaƙwalwa da aka lissafa." "Matsalolin da ƙananan tsibirai masu tasowa ke fuskanta suna da alaƙa da juna kuma suna da fa'ida mai yawa. Canjin yanayi, lalacewar muhalli, rashin daidaito na zamantakewa da tattalin arziƙi, da abubuwan da ke da tasiri ga lafiya suna ƙara nauyin NCDs da yanayin lafiyar ƙwaƙwalwa," in ji Dokta Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, Darakta Janar na WHO. "Duk da rashin kayan amfani da iyaka, waɗannan ƙasashe sun nuna juriyar gaske a yayin fuskantar mawuyacin hali. A tare, dole ne mu samar da hanyar da ta dogara da daidaito, juriya, da ɗorewa. Dole ne mu ƙarfafa tsarin kiwon lafiya, inganta rigakafi da matakan saurin gano cuta, da ba da fifiko ga haɗakar ayyukan NCD da lafiyar ƙwaƙwalwa cikin kula da lafiya a matakin farko. "Babban Daraktan ya kuma yi alƙawarin cewa WHO za ta yi aiki don tattara kuɗi don haɓaka kayayyakin kiwon lafiya masu jure yanayi, da kuma dorewar muhalli a cikin SIDS. WHO za ta ci gaba da ba da shawara ga 'asara da lalata' don daidaita canjin yanayi da saka hannun jari na ragewa a ƙasashe masu ƙaramin karfi.

translations.source: As part of agreeing the Declaration, SIDS signed up to undertake a suite of actions, covering areas such as engaging all of society, accelerating implementation, securing investments, aligning across governments and accounting for progress. The conference also showcased specific commitments by SIDS on NCDs and mental health, including to improve access to mental health care in primary care facilities, update tobacco control legislation to cover e-cigarettes and vaping, and reduce populations’ salt and sugar intake. These commitments align with WHO’s ‘best buys’ – a set of cost-effective, evidence-based interventions to tackle NCDs. The list of best buys was recently updated at the World Health Assembly in May to include secondary prevention for rheumatic fever, acute and long-term management of asthma and chronic obstructive pulmonary disease as well as several interventions for cervical, breast, colorectal, liver and childhood cancer, and the comprehensive treatment of cancer for those living with HIV. “SIDS in the Americas remain overwhelmingly vulnerable to NCDs. This Ministerial Conference comes at a unique time and will be key to amplifying the voice and needs of SIDS, bringing NCDs and mental health to the forefront of our priority list,” said Dr Jarbas Barbosa, PAHO Director, and WHO Regional Director for the Americas. “To build on this momentum, we must act now. PAHO is ready to support accelerated implementation of interventions in our region, including mainstreaming care for these conditions into primary health services and taking advantage of innovations such as digital health tools.” SIDS countries have a track record of driving global decision-making; their Port of Spain and SAMOA pathway agreements paved the way for the first-ever UN political declaration on NCDs in 2018. The conference and the Declaration will inform and shape forthcoming UN General Assembly High-Level Meetings on universal health coverage in September 2023 and on NCDs in 2025.
